Hume was equally dubious about matter. Who guarantees that there is a permanently existing world of solid objects? All we know are our own sensations of such a world. Repeated sensations of a chair do not prove that a chair actually exists. Space and time are but a manner and order in which ideas occur to us. Similarly, causality is but a customary connection of ideas. Neither space nor time nor causality is an objective reality. We are deluded by the force and firmness of our sensations into believing in such realities. The existence of an external world with fixed properties is really an unwarranted inference; the origin of our sensations is inexplicable. Whether they arise from external objects or the mind itself or God, we cannot say.

人本身不过是一个孤立的知觉集合，即感觉与观念的集合，只以这种形式存在。自我是不同知觉的一束。任何感知自身的尝试，都只能导向一个知觉。其他所有人，以及所谓外部世界，都只是某个人的知觉，无法保证它们存在。

Man himself is but an isolated collection of perceptions, that is, sensations and ideas. He exists only as such. The ego is a bundle of different perceptions. Any attempt to perceive one’s self leads only to a perception. All other men and the supposed external world are just the perceptions of any one man, and there is no assurance that they exist.

因此，不可能有关于永久、客观物理世界的科学规律；这类规律只表示对感觉的便利概括。而且，因果性观念不是基于科学证明，只是由于“事件”通常次序频繁出现而形成的心智习惯，因此我们无法知道，过去感知的序列未来是否重复。由此，休谟剥去了自然规律的必然性、永恒性与不可违抗性。

Hence there can be no scientific laws concerning a permanent, objective physical world; such laws signify merely convenient summaries of sensations. Moreover, since the idea of causality is based not on scientific proof but merely on a habit of mind resulting from the frequent occurrence of the usual order of “events,” we have no way of knowing that sequences perceived in the past will recur in the future. Thus Hume stripped away the inevitability of the laws of nature, their eternahty and their inviolability.

休谟摧毁了外部世界遵循固定数学规律的学说，也就摧毁了代表实在的逻辑演绎结构的价值。但数学还包含关于数和几何的定理，它们从被认为是数与几何图形真理的命题中无可怀疑地推出。休谟不拒绝公理，却选择削弱公理及演绎结果的地位。公理来自对假定物理世界的感觉。定理确实是公理的必然结果，但不过是公理的展开重复。它们是演绎，却只是对公理中隐含陈述的演绎，是重言式。因此，公理与定理中都没有真理。

By destroying the doctrine of an external world following fixed mathematical laws, Hume had destroyed the value of a logical deductive structure which represented reality. But mathematics also contains theorems about number and geometry which follow indubitably from supposed truths about numbers and geometrical figures. Hume did not reject the axioms, but chose to deflate them and the results obtained by deduction. As for the axioms, they come from sensations about the presumed physical world. The theorems are indeed necessary consequences of the axioms but they are no more than elaborated repetitions of the axioms. They are deductions but deductions of statements implicit in the axioms. They are tautologies. Thus there are no truths in the axioms or the theorems.

因此，休谟通过否定真理存在，回答人如何获得真理这一根本问题：人不能达到真理。他的工作不仅贬低科学与数学的努力和成果，还挑战理性本身的价值。否定人最高能力，令大多数十八世纪思想家反感。数学及人类理性的其他表现，成就太多，不能作为无用之物抛弃。休谟哲学如此违背、冒犯大多数十八世纪思想家，又与数学和科学的非凡成功如此不相容，因此必须反驳。

Hume, then, answered the fundamental question of how man obtains truths by denying their existence; man cannot arrive at truths. Hume’s work not only deflated the efforts and results of science and mathematics, but challenged the value of reason itself. Such a denial of man’s highest faculty was revolting to most eighteenth-century thinkers. Mathematics and other manifestations of human reason had accomplished too much to be cast aside as useless. Hume’s philosophy was so contrary and repugnant to most intellectuals of the eighteenth century and so much at odds with the remarkable successes of mathematics and science that a refutation was called for.

历来最受尊崇、或许也最深刻的哲学家伊曼努尔·康德，接受了挑战。但仔细考察他的思考结果，并不更令人宽慰。在《未来形而上学导论》（1783）中，他似乎站在数学家与科学家一边：“我们可以确信地说，某些纯粹先验综合认识，即纯数学与纯物理学，实际存在且已被给予；因为双方都包含被彻底承认为绝对确定……却又独立于经验的命题。”在《纯粹理性批判》（1781）中，他开篇的话更令人放心。他肯定数学的一切公理与定理都是真理。但他问自己，为什么愿意接受这些真理？经验本身无疑不能证实它们。如果能回答数学这门科学本身如何可能这一更大问题，就能回答前一个问题。他的答案是，我们的心智具有空间与时间的形式。空间与时间是知觉方式——他称为直观——心智依据它们看待经验。我们依照这些心智形式，感知、组织并理解经验。经验嵌入其中，如面团嵌入模具。心智把这些方式施加于接受的感官印象，使感觉落入内置模式。空间直观源于心智，因此心智自动接受该空间的某些性质。直线是两点间最短路径、三点确定一个平面，以及欧几里得平行公理等原理，被康德称为先验综合真理，属于我们的心智装备。几何学只探索这些原理的逻辑结果。心智按照自己的“空间结构”看待经验，这本身意味着经验将符合基本原理与定理。我们以为在外部世界中感知的秩序与理性，是心智与思维方式施加于它的。

The most revered and perhaps the deepest philosopher of all times, Immanuel Kant, took up the challenge. But the outcome of Kant’s cogitations when carefully examined was not much more comforting. In his Prolegomena to Any Future Metaphysics (1783), Kant did seem to take the side of the mathematicians and scientists: c‘We can say with confidence that certain pure a priori synthetical cognitions, pure mathematics and pure physics, are actual and given; for both contain propositions which are thoroughly recognized as absolutely certain . . . and yet as independent of experience.” In his Critique of Pure Reason (1781), Kant started out with even more reassuring words. He affirmed that all axioms and theorems of mathematics were truths. But why, Kant asked himself, was he willing to accept such truths? Surely experience itself did not validate them. The question could be answered if one could answer the larger question of how the very science of mathematics is possible. Kant s answer was that our minds possess the forms of space and time. Space and time are modes of perception—Kant called them intuitions— in terms of which the mind views experience. We perceive, organize, and understand experience in accordance with these mental forms. Experience fits into them like dough into a mold. The mind imposes these modes on the received sense impressions and causes these sensations to fall into built-in patterns. Since the intuition of space has its origin in the mind, the mind automatically accepts certain properties of this space. Principles such as that a straight line is the shortest path between two points, that three points determine a plane, and the parallel axiom of Euclid, which Kant called a priori synthetic truths, are part of our mental equipment. The science of geometry merely explores the logical consequences of these principles. The very fact that the mind views experience in terms of the “spatial structure” of the mind means that experience will conform to the basic principles and the theorems. The order and rationality that we think we perceive in the external world are imposed on it by our minds and our modes of thinking.

康德既然从人脑细胞中制造空间，就看不出为什么不把它造为欧几里得式。他无法设想另一种几何，于是确信不可能有另一种。因此，欧几里得几何规律并非宇宙固有，宇宙也不是上帝如此设计的；这些规律是人组织并合理化感觉的机制。对于上帝，他说，上帝的本性在理性知识之外，但我们应当信仰他。康德在几何上的轻率，超过了哲学上的大胆：他从未离开东普鲁士故乡柯尼斯堡四十英里以上，却自以为能决定世界的几何。

Since Kant manufactured space from the cells of the human brain he could see no reason not to make it Euclidean. His inability to conceive of another geometry convinced him that there could be ny other. Thus the laws of Euclidean geometry were not inherent in the universe nor was the universe so designed by God: the laws were man s mechanism for organizing and rationalizing his sensations. As for God, Kant said that the nature of God fell outside of rational knowledge but we should believe in Him. Kant’s boldness in philosophy was surpassed by his rashness in geometry, for despite never having been more than forty miles from his home city of Konigsberg in East Prussia he presumed he could decide the geometry of the world.

科学的数学规律又如何？既然一切经验都依据空间与时间的心智框架把握，数学必定适用于一切经验。在《自然科学的形而上学基础》（1786）中，康德把牛顿定律及其结果视为自明。他声称已证明，牛顿运动定律可从纯粹理性推出，而且这些规律是自然可理解的唯一假定。他说，牛顿给予我们如此清楚的“宇宙结构洞见，它将永远不变”。

What about the mathematical laws of science? Since all experience is grasped in terms of the mental framework of space and time, mathemat ics must be applicable to all experience. In his Metaphysical Foundations of Natural Science (1786) Kant accepted Newton’s laws and their consequences as self-evident. He claimed to have demonstrated that Newton’s laws of motion can be derived from pure reason and that these laws are the only assumptions under which nature is understandable. Newton, he said, gave us so clear an “insight into the structure of the universe that it will remain unchanged for all time.”

更一般地，康德认为，科学世界是一个由心智依空间、时间、因果与实体等天赋范畴，排列并控制的感官印象世界。心智中备有家具，来客必须适应。感官印象确实源于真实世界，但遗憾的是，这个世界不可知。实际之物只能通过感知心智提供的主观范畴来认识。因此，永远不会有欧几里得几何与牛顿力学之外的方式组织经验。经验扩大、新科学形成时，心智不从新经验中归纳出新原理，而是调用原先未使用的隔间，解释新经验。心智的洞察能力被经验点亮。这解释了相较已知数百年的其他真理，某些真理，如力学规律，为何较晚才得到认识。

More generally, Kant argued that the world of science is a world of sense impressions arranged and controlled by the mind in accordance with innate categories such as space, time, cause and effect, and substance. The mind contains furniture into which the guests must fit. The sense impressions do originate in a real world, but unfortunately this world is unknowable. Actuality can be known only in terms of the subjective categories supplied by the perceiving mind. Hence there never would be a way other than Euclidean geometry and Newtonian mechanics to organize experience. As experience broadens, as new sciences are formed, the mind does not formulate new principles by generalizing from these new experiences; rather, unused compartments of the mind are called into use to interpret these new experiences. The mind’s power of vision is lit up by experience. This accounts for the relatively late recognition of some truths, such as, for example, the laws of mechanics, compared with others known for many centuries.

这里仅略加提示的康德哲学，颂扬理性；但他赋予理性的职责，是探索人类心智的深处，而非自然。经验作为知识的必要要素得到适当认可，因为外部世界的感觉提供了由心智组织的原料。而数学仍保持其地位，揭示心智的必然规律。

Kant’s philosophy, barely intimated here, glorified reason; however, he assigned to it the role of exploring not nature but the recesses of the human mind. Experience received due recognition as a necessary element in knowledge, since sensations from the external world supply the raw material which the mind organizes. And mathematics retained its place as the discloser of the necessary laws of the mind.

数学是一套先验真理，这正是数学家愿意听到的。但大多数没有充分注意康德如何得出这一结论。他认为数学所断言的并非物理世界固有，而来自人类心智，这本应使所有数学家停下来思考。我们的心智是否都预制得能对感觉作出相同组织？对空间感觉的组织是否必然是欧几里得式？我们怎么知道？数学家与物理学家不同于康德，仍相信外部世界受独立于人类心智的规律支配。世界按照理性设计，人只揭示设计，并用它预测外部世界将发生什么。

That mathematics was a body of a priori truths the mathematicians were attuned to hear. But most did not pay enough attention to how Kant arrived at this conclusion. His doctrine that what mathematics asserts is not inherent in the physical world but comes from man’s mind should have given pause to all mathematicians. Are all our minds prefabricated so as to make the same organization of our sensations, and is that organization of spatial sensations necessarily Euclidean? How do we know this? Unlike Kant, mathematicians and physicists still believed in an external world subject to laws independent of human minds. The world was rationally designed and man merely uncovered that design and used it to predict what would happen in that external world.

康德的学说与影响，既有解放作用，也有限制作用。他强调心智能在我们永远无法真正认识的世界中组织经验，为与当时坚定维持的结构相反的新结构铺路。但他坚持心智必然依欧几里得几何规律组织空间感觉，妨碍人们接受任何相反观点。如果他更多注意同时代数学工作，至少可能不会如此坚持心智必须以欧几里得形式组织空间感觉。

Kant s doctrines and influence had both a liberating and a restrict-mg effect. By emphasizing the power of the mind to organize experiences in a world we shall never truly know, he paved the way for new structures contrary to those so firmly maintained in his time. But by insisting that the mind necessarily organizes spatial sensations in accordance with the laws of Euclidean geometry he hindered the acceptance of any contrary views. Had Kant been paying more attention to contemporary work in mathematics, he might at least have been less insistent that the mind must organize spatial sensations in the Euclidean format.

人们忽视甚至否认上帝是宇宙立法者，加上康德认为规律内在于人类心智结构的观点，引来了神圣建筑师的反应。上帝决定惩罚康德派，尤其是那些自负、骄傲、过度自信的数学家。他于是鼓励非欧几里得几何的发展，这一创造摧毁了人类自以为自足、全能的理性之成就。

Indifference to and even dismissal of God as the law-maker of the universe, as well as the Kantian view that the laws were inherent in the structure of the human mind, brought forth a reaction from the Divine Architect. God decided that He would punish the Kantians and especially those egotistic, proud, and overconfident mathematicians. And He proceeded to encourage non-Euclidean geometry, a creation that devastated the achievements of man’s presumably self-sufficient, all-powerful reason.

虽然到1800年，上帝的存在越来越不被感受到，休谟等少数激进哲学家又否定一切真理，但当时数学家仍相信数学本身及自然数学规律的真理性。在数学各分支中，欧几里得几何最受尊崇，不仅因它最先以演绎建立，也因两千多年来，其定理被发现与物理事实完全一致。“上帝”所攻击的，恰恰就是欧几里得几何。

Though by 1800 God’s presence was less and less felt and though a few radical philosophers such as Hume had denied all truths, the mathematicians of that time still believed in the truth of mathematics proper and of the mathematical laws of nature. Among the branches of mathematics, Euclidean geometry was most venerated, not only because it was the first to be deductively established but also because for over two thousand years its theorems had been found to be in perfect accord with the physical facts. It was precisely Euclidean geometry that “God” attacked.

欧几里得几何的一条公理曾使数学家有些困扰，不是因为他们怀疑其真理性，而是因为其措辞。这就是平行公理，或常称欧几里得第五公设。按欧几里得的表述，它说：

One axiom of Euclidean geometry had bothered mathematicians somewhat, not because there was in their minds any doubt of its truth but because of its wording. This was the parallel axiom or, as it is often referred to, Euclid’s fifth postulate. As Euclid worded it, it states:

如果一条直线［图4.1］与两条直线相交，使同侧内角之和小于两个直角，那么这两条直线延长后，将在同侧内角之和小于两个直角的那一侧相交。

If a straight line [Fig. 4.1] falling on two straight lines makes the interior angles on the same side less than two right angles, then the two straight lines if extended will meet on that side of the straight line on which the angles are less than two right angles.

即若角1与角2之和小于180°，直线a与b延长得足够远后就会相交。

That is, if angles 1 and 2 add up to less than 180° then lines a and b if produced sufficiently far will meet.

图4.1

Figure 4.1

欧几里得有充分理由如此表述公理。他本可断言，若角1与角2之和为180°，则直线a与b永不相交，即a与b平行。但他显然不敢假定存在永不相交的无穷直线。经验当然不能保证无穷直线的行为，而公理被认为是关于物理世界的自明真理。不过，他确实根据平行公理与其他公理，证明了平行线的存在。

Euclid had good reasons to word his axiom in this manner. He could have asserted instead that if the sum of the angles 1 and 2 is 180° then the lines a and b will never meet, that is, the lines a and b would be parallel. But Euclid apparently feared to assume that there could be infinite lines which never meet. Certainly experience did not vouch for the behavior of infinite straight lines, whereas axioms were supposed to be self-evident truths about the physical world. However, he did prove the existence of parallel lines on the basis of his parallel axiom and the other axioms.

欧几里得表述形式的平行公理，被认为有些过于复杂，缺少其他公理的简单性。显然，甚至欧几里得也不喜欢自己的版本，因为他先证明了所有不用这一公理能证明的定理，才开始使用它。

The parallel axiom in the form stated by Euclid was thought to be somewhat too complicated. It lacked the simplicity of the other axioms. Apparently even Euclid did not like his version of the parallel axiom because he did not call upon it until he had proved all the theorems he could without it.

一个相关问题，虽没困扰许多人，最终却成为关键，是能否确信物理空间中存在无穷直线。欧几里得谨慎地只规定，有限线段可以按需要延长，因此延长后的线段仍有限。尽管如此，他确实暗示无穷直线存在，因为若它们有限，就不能在任一给定情境中延长到所需程度。

A related problem, which did not bother many people but ultimately came to the fore as a vital concern, is whether one can be sure of the existence of infinite straight lines in physical space. Euclid was careful to postulate only that one can extend a finite line segment as far as necessary, so that even the extended segment was still finite. Nevertheless Euclid did imply the existence of infinite straight lines for, were they finite, they could not be extended as far as necessary in any given context.

甚至在希腊时代，数学家就开始尝试解决平行公理的问题。尝试有两类：第一，以看似更自明的陈述取代平行公理；第二，试图从欧几里得其他九条公理推出它。若能做到，欧几里得的陈述就成为定理，不再可疑。两千多年间，几十位主要数学家，更不用说次要者，从事过这两类努力。这段历史漫长而技术性强，我们不重述其大部分，因为很容易查阅，也与本书不特别相关*。

Even in Greek times the mathematicians began efforts to resolve the problem presented by Euclid’s parallel axiom. Two types of attempts were made. The first was to replace the parallel axiom by a seemingly more self-evident statement. The second was to try to deduce it from the other nine axioms of Euclid; were this possible Euclid’s statement would be a theorem and so no longer questionable. Over two thousand years many dozens of major mathematicians, to say nothing of minor ones, engaged in both types of efforts. The history is long and technical and most of it will not be reproduced here because it is readily available and not especially relevant/'

*可参见罗伯托·博诺拉《非欧几里得几何》（Non-Euclidean Geometry），1906年首次以意大利语出版，英文译本由Dover Publications于1955年重印。

"This history can be found in Roberto Bonola: Non-Eudidean Geometry, first published in Italian in 1906, Dover Publications reprint of the English translation, 1955.

图4.2

Figure 4.2

许多替代公理中，或许应提到一个，因为今天中学通常学习的就是它。这个平行公理版本由约翰·普莱费尔（1748—1819）于1795年提出：过不在直线ℓ上的给定点P（图4.2），在P与ℓ所在平面内，有且仅有一条直线不与ℓ相交。所有提出的替代公理，虽看似比欧几里得版本简单，细察后却并不更令人满意。其中许多，包括普莱费尔公理，都断言空间中无限遥远处发生什么。另一方面，不直接涉及“无穷”的替代公理，例如存在两个相似但不相等的三角形，也被发现是相当复杂的假定，绝不优于欧几里得自己的平行公理。

Of the many substitute axioms perhaps one should be noted because it is the one we usually learn in high school today. This version of the parallel axiom, which is due to John Playfair (1748-1819) and was proposed by him in 1795, states: Through a given point P not on a line ℓ (Fig. 4.2) there is one and only one line in the plane of P and ℓ which does not meet ℓ. All of the substitute axioms that were proposed, though seemingly simpler than Euclid’s version, proved on closer examination no more satisfactory than Euclid’s. Many of them, including Playfair s, made assertions about what happens indefinitely far out in space. On the other hand the substitute axioms which did not involve “infinity” directly, for example, the axiom that there exist two similar but unequal triangles, were seen to be rather complex assumptions and by no means preferable to Euclid’s own parallel axiom.

第二类解决平行公理问题的努力，即试图从其他九条公理推出欧几里得的断言，其中最重要的，由耶稣会教士、帕维亚大学教授杰罗拉莫·萨凯里（1667—1733）作出。他的想法是，采用一条与欧几里得公理根本不同的公理，可能得到与欧几里得另一条定理相矛盾的定理。这种矛盾将意味着，否定平行公理的那条公理——唯一有问题的公理——为假，因此欧几里得平行公理必为真，即其他九条公理的结果。

Of the second group of efforts to solve the problem of the parallel axiom, those which sought to deduce Euclid’s assertion from the other nine axioms, the most significant was made by Gerolamo Saccheri (1667-1733), a Jesuit priest and professor at the University of Pavia. His thought was that if one adopted an axiom that differed essentially from Euclid’s then one might arrive at a theorem that contradicted another of Euclid’s theorems. Such a contradiction would mean that the axiom denying Euclid’s parallel axiom, the only axiom in question, is false and so the Euclidean parallel axiom must be true, that is, a consequence of the other nine axioms.

按与欧几里得公理等价的普莱费尔公理来看，萨凯里首先假定*，过P点（图4.3）没有与ℓ平行的直线。从这条公理与欧几里得采用的其他九条公理，萨凯里确实推出了矛盾。然后，他尝试第二种，也是唯一其他可能的选择：过P点，至少有两条直线p与q，无论延长多远都不与ℓ相交。他继续证明许多有趣定理，直到得到一条看来如此奇异、如此令人反感的定理，以至于他断定它与此前确立的结果矛盾。因此，萨凯里认为自己有理由断定，欧几里得平行公理确实是其他九条公理的结果，并把书名定为《欧几里得免除一切瑕疵》（Euclides ab omni naevo vindicatus，1733）。然而，后来数学家认识到，第二种情况下他实际上并未获得矛盾，平行公理问题仍悬而未决。寻找可接受的平行公理替代品，或证明欧几里得断言必为其他九条公理之结果的尝试，如此众多却徒劳，以至于1759年达朗贝尔把平行公理问题称为“几何基础的丑闻”。

In view of Playfair’s axiom, which is equivalent to Euclid’s, Saccheri assumed first* that through the point P (Fig. 4.3) there are no lines parallel to ℓ. And from this axiom and the other nine that Euclid adopted Saccheri did deduce a contradiction. Saccheri tried next the second and only other possible alternative, namely, that through the point P there are at least two lines p and q that no matter how far extended do not meet ℓ. Saccheri proceeded to prove many interesting theorems until he reached one which seemed so strange and so repugnant that he decided it was contradictory to the previously established results. Saccheri therefore felt justified in concluding that Euclid’s parallel axiom was really a consequence of the other nine axioms and so entitled his book, Euclides ab omni naevo vindicatus (Euclid Vindicated from All Fault, 1733). However, later mathematicians realized that Saccheri did not really obtain a contradiction in the second case and the problem of the parallel axiom was still open. The efforts to find an acceptable substitute for the Euclidean axiom on parallels or to prove that the Euclidean assertion must be a consequence of Euclid’s nine other axioms were so numerous and so futile that in 1759 D’Alembert called the problem of the parallel axiom “the scandal of the elements of geometry.”

*以下描述对萨凯里的程序略作修改。

*The description that follows is a minor modification of Saccheri s procedure.

数学家逐渐开始正确理解欧几里得平行公理的地位。格奥尔格·S.克吕格尔（1739—1812）后来是赫尔姆施泰特大学教授；他熟悉萨凯里的书及许多其他为平行公理辩护的尝试，在1763年博士论文中作出非凡观察：人们接受平行公理为真时的确信，基于经验。这首次提出经验而非自明性证实公理的思想*。他怀疑欧几里得断言能否被证明。此外，他认识到萨凯里并未得到矛盾，只得到奇异结果。

Gradually the mathematicians began to approach the correct understanding of the status of Euclid’s parallel axiom. In his doctoral dissertation of 1763 Georg S. Kliigel (1739-1812), later a professor at the University of Helmstadt, who knew Saccheri’s book and many other attempts to vindicate the parallel axiom, made the remarkable observation that the certainty with which men accepted the truth of the Euclidean parallel axiom was based on experience. This observation introduced for the first time the thought that experience rather than self-evidence substantiated the axioms.’' Kliigel expressed doubt that the Euclidean assertion could be proved. Moreover, he realized that Saccheri had not arrived at a contradiction but merely at results that were strange.

克吕格尔的论文启发约翰·海因里希·兰伯特（1728—1777）研究平行公理。在《平行线理论》（1766年写成，1786年出版）中，他像萨凯里一样，考虑两种替代可能。他也发现，假定过P点没有与l平行的直线（图4.3），会导致矛盾。但与萨凯里不同，他没有断言自己从过P点至少有两条平行线的假定中得到了矛盾。而且，他认识到，任何不会导致矛盾的假说集合，都提供一种可能的几何。这种几何即使与物理图形关系不大，仍是有效的逻辑结构。

Kliigel’s paper suggested work on the parallel axiom to Johann Heinrich Lambert (1728-1777). In his book Theory of Parallel Lines (written in 1766 and published in 1786), Lambert, somewhat like Saccheri, considered the two alternative possibilities. He, too, found that the assumption of no lines through P parallel to l (Fig. 4.3) led to a contradiction. However, unlike Saccheri, Lambert did not conclude that he had obtained a contradiction from the assumption of at least two parallels through P. Moreover, he realized that any collection of hypotheses which did not lead to contradictions offered a possible geometry. Such a geometry would be a valid logical structure even though it might have little to do with physical figures.

*牛顿也曾提出这一主张，但未加重视，而且它被忽略了。

-Newton had also made this assertion but he did not stress it and it was ignored.

图4.3

Figure 4.3

兰伯特，以及高斯的老师、哥廷根教授亚伯拉罕·G.凯斯特纳（1719—1800）等人的工作，值得强调。他们确信，欧几里得平行公理不能从其他九条公理证明，即它独立于其他公理。此外，兰伯特确信，可以采用与欧几里得公理矛盾的替代公理，建立逻辑一致的几何，尽管未断言其适用性。因此，这三人都认识到非欧几里得几何存在。

The work of Lambert and other men such as Abraham G. Kastner (1719-1800), a professor at Gottingen who was Gauss’s teacher, warrants emphasis. They were convinced that Euclid’s parallel axiom could not be proven on the basis of the other nine Euclidean axioms; that is, it is independent of Euclid’s other axioms. Further, Lambert was convinced that it is possible to adopt an alternative axiom contradicting Euclid’s and build a logically consistent geometry, though he made no assertions about the applicability of such a geometry. Thus all three recognized the existence of a non-Euclidean geometry.

研究欧几里得平行公理问题的最杰出数学家，是高斯。哥廷根普遍知道确立这一公理的努力徒劳无功，因此他充分了解。事实上，他的老师凯斯特纳完全熟悉这段历史。多年后，1831年，高斯告诉朋友舒马赫，早在1792年（当时十五岁），他就已理解可能有一种不满足欧几里得平行公设的逻辑几何。但直到1799年，他仍试图从其他更可信假定推出平行公设；虽然能够设想其他逻辑上的非欧几里得几何，他仍相信物理空间的几何是欧几里得几何。然而，1799年12月17日，他致信朋友、数学家沃尔夫冈·鲍耶：

The most distinguished mathematician who worked on the problem posed by Euclid’s parallel axiom was Gauss. Gauss was fully aware of the vain efforts to establish Euclid’s parallel axiom because this was common knowledge in Gottingen. In fact the history of these efforts was thoroughly familiar to Gauss’s teacher Kastner. Many years later, in 1831, Gauss told his friend Schumacher that as far back as 1792 (Gauss was then fifteen) he had already grasped the idea that there could be a logical geometry in which Euclid’s parallel postulate did not hold. But even up to 1799 Gauss still tried to deduce Euclid’s parallel postulate from other more plausible assumptions and he still believed Euclidean geometry to be the geometry of physical space though he could conceive of other logical non-Euclidean geometries. However, on December 17, 1799, Gauss wrote to his friend and fellow mathematician Wolfgang Bolyai:

至于我，我的工作已有一些进展。然而，我选择的道路根本不通向我们追求的目标［推导平行公理］，即你向我保证已经达到的目标。它似乎反而迫使我怀疑几何本身的真理性。确实，我遇到过许多会被大多数人视为证明［从其他公理推出欧几里得平行公理］的东西；但在我看来，它们几乎什么也没证明。例如，如果我们能说明，可能存在面积超过任意给定面积的直边三角形，那么我就准备绝对严格地证明整个［欧几里得］几何。

As for me I have already made some progress in my work. However, the path I have chosen does not lead at all to the goal which we seek [deduction of the parallel axiom], and which you assure me you have reached. It seems rather to compel me to doubt the truth of geometry itself. It is true that I have come upon much which by most people would be held to constitute a proof [of the deduction of the Euclidean parallel axiom from the other axioms]; but in my eyes it proves as good as nothing. For example, if we could show that a rectilinear triangle is possible, whose area would be greater than any given area, then I would be ready to prove the whole of [Euclidean] geometry absolutely rigorously.

大多数人无疑会让这作为公理成立；但我不！事实上，可能无论把三角形三个顶点放得多远，面积始终低于某个界限。

Most people would certainly let this stand as an axiom; but I, no! It would indeed be possible that the area might always remain below a certain limit, however far apart the three angular points of the triangle were taken.

约自1813年起，高斯发展自己的非欧几里得几何，最初称为反欧几里得几何，随后称星界几何，最后称非欧几里得几何。他确信其逻辑一致，并相当确定它可能适用。

From about 1813 on Gauss developed his non-Euclidean geometry, which he first called anti-Euclidean geometry, then astral geometry, and finally non-Euclidean geometry. He became convinced that it was logically consistent and rather sure that it might be applicable.

1824年11月8日，高斯致信朋友弗朗茨·阿道夫·陶里努斯（1794—1874）：

In a letter to his friend Franz Adolf Taurinus (1794-1874) of November 8, 1824, Gauss wrote:

［三角形］内角和小于180°的假定，导向一种奇特几何，与我们的［欧几里得］几何颇为不同，却彻底一致；我已将它发展到完全满意的程度。其定理看似悖谬，对外行甚至荒唐，但冷静、持续的思考表明，其中根本没有不可能之处。

The assumption that the angle sum [of a triangle] is less than 180° leads to a curious geometry, quite different from ours [Euclidean] but thoroughly consistent, which I have developed to my entire satisfaction. The theorems of this geometry appear to be paradoxical, and, to the uninitiated, absurd, but calm, steady reflection reveals that they contain nothing at all impossible.

1829年1月27日，高斯致信数学家兼天文学家弗里德里希·威廉·贝塞尔，再次肯定平行公设不能基于欧几里得其他公理证明。

In his letter to the mathematician and astronomer Friedrich Wilhelm Bessel of January 27, 1829, Gauss reaffirmed that the parallel postulate could not be proved on the basis of the other axioms in Euclid.

我们不讨论高斯创立的具体非欧几里得几何。他未完成完整的演绎表述，而已经证明的定理，与我们即将在罗巴切夫斯基和鲍耶工作中遇到的很相似。他在致贝塞尔信中说，或许永远不会发表这一主题的发现，因为害怕嘲笑，或用他的话说，害怕彼奥提亚人的喧嚣；这是指那个以愚钝著称的希腊部族。须记住，少数数学家虽逐渐接近非欧几里得几何工作的结局，整个思想界仍受欧几里得几何是唯一可能几何的信念支配。我们所知的高斯非欧几里得几何工作，来自致友人书信、1816与1822年《哥廷根学术通报》（Göttingische gelehrte Anzeigen）中的两篇短评，以及死后在其文稿中发现的1831年笔记。

We shall not discuss the specific non-Euclidean geometry that was created by Gauss. He did not finish a full deductive presentation, and the theorems he did prove are much like those we shall encounter shortly in the work of Lobatchevsky and Bolyai. He said in his letter to Bessel that he probably would never publish his findings on this subject because he feared ridicule or, as he put it, he feared the clamor of the Boeotians, a reference to a proverbially dull-witted Greek tribe. One must remember that though a few mathematicians had been gradually reaching the denouement of the work in non-Euclidean geometry the intellectual world at large was still dominated by the conviction that Euclidean geometry was the only possible geometry. What we do know about Gauss’s work in non-Euclidean geometry is gleaned from his letters to friends, two short reviews in the Gottingiscke gelebrte Anzeigen of 1816 and 1822, and some notes of 1831 found among his papers after his death.

在创立非欧几里得几何方面，比高斯获得更多荣誉的两人，是罗巴切夫斯基与鲍耶。实际上，他们的工作是先前创新思想的尾声，但由于发表了系统的演绎著作，通常被赞为创始者。俄国人尼古拉·伊万诺维奇·罗巴切夫斯基（1793—1856）在喀山大学学习，1827—1846年任该校教授与校长。自1825年起，他在许多论文与两部书中，表达关于几何基础的观点。约翰·鲍耶（1802—1860）是沃尔夫冈·鲍耶之子，匈牙利军官。他发表了二十六页论文《绝对空间的科学》，讨论他称为绝对几何的非欧几里得几何，作为父亲两卷本《勤学青年数学基础试论》（Tentamen juventutem studiosam in elementa Matheseos）第一卷的附录。该书1832—1833年出版，晚于罗巴切夫斯基的发表，但鲍耶似乎到1825年已形成自己的非欧几里得几何思想，并确信新几何不自相矛盾。在1823年11月23日致父亲信中，他写道：“我作出了如此奇妙的发现，连我自己也沉醉于惊讶之中。”

The two men who receive more credit than Gauss for the creation of non-Euclidean geometry are Lobatchevsky and Bolyai. Actually their work was an epilogue to prior innovative ideas but because they published systematic deductive works they are usually hailed as the creators of non-Euclidean geometry. Nikolai Ivanovich Lobatchevsky (1793- 1856), a Russian, studied at the University of Kazan and from 1827 to 1846 was professor and rector there. From 1825 on he presented his views on the foundations of geometry in many papers and two books. Johann Bolyai (1802-1860), son of Wolfgang Bolyai, was a Hungarian army officer. He published a twenty-six-page paper, “The Science of Absolute Space,” on non-Euclidean geometry, which he called absolute geometry, as an appendix to the first volume of his father s two-volume book Tentamen juventutem studiosam in elementa Matheseos (Essay on the Elements of Mathematics for Studious Youths). Though this book appeared in 1832-33 and therefore after publications by Lobatchevsky, Bolyai seems to have worked out his ideas on non-Euclidean geometry by 1825 and was convinced by that time that the new geometry was not self-contradictory. In a letter to his father dated November 23, 1823, Johann wrote, “I have made such wonderful discoveries that I am myself lost in astonishment.”

高斯、罗巴切夫斯基与鲍耶认识到，欧几里得平行公理不能从其他九条公理证明，要建立欧几里得几何，必须加上一条关于平行线的公理。既然这是独立事实，那么至少在逻辑上，可以采用与它矛盾的陈述，并发展新公理体系的结果。

Gauss, Lobatchevsky, and Bolyai had realized that the Euclidean parallel axiom could not be proved on the basis of the other nine axioms and that some additional axiom about parallel lines was needed to found Euclidean geometry. Since this last was an independent fact it was then at least logically possible to adopt a contradictory statement and develop the consequences of the new set of axioms.

这些人所创造的技术内容相当简单。可以看看罗巴切夫斯基的工作，因为三人大致做了同样的事。他大胆拒绝欧几里得平行公理，采用实际上萨凯里曾采用的假定。给定直线AB与点P（图4.4），过P的所有直线相对于AB分为两类：与AB相交者，以及不相交者。后一类中有两条直线p与q，构成两类的边界。更精确地说，若P到AB的垂直距离为a，则存在锐角A，使与垂线PD成小于A的角的所有直线，都与AB相交；而成大于或等于A的角的直线，都不与AB相交。与PD成角A的两条直线p与q是平行线，A称为平行角。过P不与AB相交的其他直线（平行线除外）称为不相交线，尽管按欧几里得意义，它们也是平行线。在这个意义上，罗巴切夫斯基几何容许过P有无穷多条平行线。

The technical content of what these men created is rather simple. It is just as well to note Lobatchevsky’s work since all three did about the same thing. Lobatchevsky boldly rejects Euclid’s parallel axiom and makes the assumption which, in effect, Saccheri had made. Given a line AB and a point P (Fig. 4.4) then all lines through P fall into two classes with respect to AB, namely, the class of lines which meet AB and the class of lines which do not. To the latter belong two lines p and q which form the boundary between the two classes. More precisely, if P is a point at a perpendicular distance a from the line AB, then there exists an acute angle A such that all lines which make with the perpendicular PD an angle less than A will intersect AB, while lines which make an angle greater than or equal to A do not intersect AB. The two lines p and q which make the angle A with PD are the parallels and A is called the angle of parallelism. Lines through P (other than the parallels) which do not meet AB are called non-intersecting lines, though in Euclid’s sense they would be parallel lines. In this sense Lobatchevsky’s geometry admits an infinite number of parallels through P.

随后，他证明几个关键定理。若角A等于π2，就得到欧几里得平行公理。若A为锐角，则随着垂直距离a减小到0，A增大并趋于π2；随着a趋于无穷，A减小并趋于0。三角形内角和总小于180°，且面积减小时趋于180°。此外，两个相似三角形必然全等。

He then proved several key theorems. If angle A equals π2 then the Euclidean parallel axiom results. If angle A is acute, then it follows that it increases and approaches π2 as the perpendicular a decreases to 0; further, angle A decreases and approaches 0 as a becomes infinite. The sum of the angles of a triangle is always less than 180° and approaches 180° as the area of the triangle decreases. Moreover, two similar triangles are necessarily congruent.

数学的任何主要分支，甚至任何重要具体结果，都不是一人的工作。至多，某个决定性步骤或断言可归于个人。数学的这种累积发展，无疑也适用于非欧几里得几何。如果非欧几里得几何意味着，发展一个包含欧几里得平行公理替代品的公理体系之结果，那么主要荣誉应归于萨凯里，而他也得益于许多人寻找可接受替代公理的工作。如果创立非欧几里得几何意味着，认识到可能有欧几里得几何之外的其他几何，那么克吕格尔与兰伯特创造了它。然而，非欧几里得几何最重要的事实，是它能像欧几里得几何一样精确地描述物理空间性质。欧几里得几何并非物理空间的必然几何；其物理真理性不能由任何先验依据保证。这一认识无需技术数学发展，因为技术工作已完成；最先获得它的是高斯。

No major branch of mathematics or even a major specific result is the work of one man. At best some decisive step or assertion may be credited to an individual. This cumulative development of mathematics certainly applies to non-Euclidean geometry. If non-Euclidean geometry means the development of the consequences of a system of axioms containing an alternative to Euclid’s parallel axiom, then most credit must be accorded to Saccheri and even he benefited by the work of many men who tried to find an acceptable substitute axiom for Euclid’s. If the creation of non-Euclidean geometry means the recognition that there can be geometries alternative to Euclid’s, then Kliigel and Lambert created it. However, the most significant fact about non-Euclidean geometry is that it can be used to describe the properties of physical space as accurately as Euclidean geometry does. Euclidean geometry is not the necessary geometry of physical space; its physical truth cannot be guaranteed on any a priori grounds. This realization, which did not call for any technical mathematical development, because this had already been done, was first attained by Gauss.

据一位传记作者，高斯试图检验这一确信。他注意到，三角形内角和在欧几里得几何中为180°，在非欧几里得几何中较小。他曾多年测量汉诺威王国，并记录数据，可能用这些测量三角形内角和。在1827年著名论文中，他指出，布罗肯、霍赫哈根与因瑟尔贝格三座山峰构成的三角形，内角和超过180°约15″。这没有证明什么，因为实验误差远大于超出量，所以正确的和可能为180°或更小。他必定认识到，这个三角形太小，不能作出决定，因为在其非欧几里得几何中，偏离180°的程度与面积成正比。只有天文学研究中的大三角形，才可能显示内角和显著偏离180°。尽管如此，他确信新几何与欧几里得几何同样适用。

According to one of his biographers Gauss attempted to test this conviction. He noted that the sum of the angles of a triangle is 180° in Euclidean geometry and less in non-Euclidean geometry. He had spent some years making a survey of the kingdom of Hannover and he had recorded the data. It is possible that he used these to measure the sum of the angles of a triangle. In a famous paper he wrote in 1827 Gauss noted that the angle sum of the triangle formed by three mountain peaks, Brocken, Hohehagen, and Inselberg, exceeded 180° by about 15". This proved nothing because the experimental error was much larger than the excess, so that the correct sum could have been 180° or less. Gauss must have realized that this triangle was too small to be decisive because in his non-Euclidean geometry the departure from 180° is proportional to the area. Only a large triangle, such as one involved in astronomical investigations, could possibly reveal any significant departure from an angle sum of 180°. Nevertheless Gauss was convinced that this new geometry was as applicable as Euclidean geometry.

罗巴切夫斯基也考虑自己的几何对物理空间的适用性，并论证它可能适用于非常大的几何图形。因此，到1830年代，不仅少数人接受非欧几里得几何，还认为它对物理空间的适用至少是可能的。

Lobatchevsky also considered the applicability of his geometry to physical space and did give an argument to show that it could be applicable to very large geometrical figures. Thus by the 1830s not only was a non-Euclidean geometry accepted by a few men but its applicability to physical space was considered at least possible.

主要由高斯工作提出的、哪种几何符合物理空间的问题，激发了另一项创造：一种新几何，进一步促使数学界相信物理空间的几何可能是非欧几里得的。创造者是高斯的学生、后来任哥廷根数学教授的格奥尔格·伯恩哈德·黎曼（1826—1866）。黎曼虽不知道罗巴切夫斯基与鲍耶工作的细节，高斯却知道；黎曼也必定了解高斯对欧几里得几何必然适用的怀疑。

The problem of which geometry fits physical space, raised primarily by the work of Gauss, stimulated another creation, a new geometry that gave the mathematical world further inducement to believe that the geometry of physical space could be non-Euclidean. The creator was Georg Bernhard Riemann (1826-1866), a student of Gauss and later professor of mathematics at Gottingen. Though the details of Lobatchevsky’s and Bolyai’s work were unknown to Riemann, they were known to Gauss, and Riemann certainly knew Gauss’s doubts as to the necessary applicability of Euclidean geometry.

黎曼要获得编外讲师（Privatdozent）资格，必须作报告；高斯指定几何基础为主题。1854年，黎曼向哥廷根哲学部作报告，高斯在场。报告1868年以《论作为几何基础的假设》为题发表。他重新考虑空间结构的整个问题，首先问物理空间究竟有哪些确定之处。在通过经验确定物理空间可能具有的性质之前，空间概念本身预设了什么条件或事实？他计划把这些条件或事实作为公理，推导进一步性质。公理及其逻辑结果将是先验、必然为真的。其他任何空间性质，都必须通过经验认识。他的目标之一，是说明欧几里得公理确是经验性而非自明真理。他采用分析方法（微积分及其扩展），因为几何证明中，我们可能被知觉误导，假定未明确认识的事实。

Gauss assigned to Riemann the subject of the foundations of geometry for the lecture he was required to deliver to qualify for the title of Privatdozent. Riemann gave this lecture in 1854 to the philosophical faculty at Gottingen with Gauss present. It was published in 1868 under the title “On the Hypotheses which Lie at the Foundation of Geometry.” In it Riemann reconsidered the entire problem of the structure of space. He took up first the question of just what is certain about physical space. What conditions or facts are presupposed in the very concept of space before we determine by experience whatever properties may hold in physical space? From these conditions or facts, treated as axioms, he planned to deduce further properties. The axioms and their logical consequences would be a priori and necessarily true. Any other properties of space would then have to be learned empirically. One of Riemann’s objectives was to show that Euclid’s axioms were indeed empirical rather than self-evident truths. He adopted the analytical approach (calculus and its extensions) because in geometrical proofs we may be misled by our perceptions to assume facts not explicitly recognized.

黎曼研究空间结构的方法非常一般，这里无需详察。在研究可以先验断言什么时，他区分了后来更重要的两点：空间的无界性与无限性。（例如球面无界，却非无限。）他指出，无界性比无限延展具有更大的经验可信度。

Riemann s approach to the structure of space is very general and for present purposes we need not examine it in detail. While studying what can be asserted a priori, he made a distinction which later became more important, the distinction between boundlessness and infiniteness of space. (Thus the surface of a sphere is boundless but not infinite.) Unboundedness, he pointed out, has a greater empirical credibility than infinite extent.

黎曼关于空间可能无界而非无限的想法，提示另一种初等非欧几里得几何，如今称为双椭圆几何。最初，他与欧金尼奥·贝尔特拉米（1835—1900）认为，这种新几何适用于某些曲面，如以大圆为“直线”的球面。但凯莱及其他人后来的工作，迫使数学家接受：双椭圆几何，如同高斯、罗巴切夫斯基与鲍耶的几何，可以描述直线是直尺边缘的三维物理空间。

Riemann’s idea about the possibility of a space being unbounded rather than infinite suggested another elementary non-Euclidean geometry now called double elliptic geometry. At first Riemann himself and Eugenio Beltrami (1835-1900) thought of this new geometry as one which applies to certain surfaces, such as the surface of a sphere where great circles are the “straight lines.” But later work by Cayley and others obliged mathematicians to accept the fact that double elliptic geometry, like the geometry of Gauss, Lobatchevsky, and Bolyai, can describe our three-dimensional physical space in which the straight line is the ruler’s edge.

双椭圆几何中，直线确实无界，但长度有限，而且没有平行线。新几何保留欧几里得几何的某些公理，因此部分定理相同。例如，两三角形的两边及夹角分别相等则全等，是新几何的定理，其他熟悉的全等定理也是。然而，其主要定理不同于欧几里得几何，也不同于高斯、罗巴切夫斯基与鲍耶的几何。一条定理说，所有直线具有相同的有限长度，并相交于两点。另一条说，某直线的所有垂线相交于一点。三角形内角和总大于180°，但面积趋于零时，内角和减小至180°。两个相似三角形必然全等。关于双椭圆几何的适用性，先前创立、如今称为双曲几何的非欧几里得几何的一切适用性论证，都同样有力*。

In double elliptic geometry the straight line is in fact unbounded but not infinite in length. Moreover, there are no parallel lines. Since this new geometry does retain some of the axioms of Euclidean geometry, some of the theorems are the same. Thus the theorem that two triangles are congruent when two sides and the included angle of one equal the corresponding parts of the other is a theorem of the new geometry as are other familiar congruence theorems. However, the major theorems of this geometry differ from those of Euclidean geometry and the geometry of Gauss, Lobatchevsky, and Bolyai. One theorem asserts that all straight lines have the same finite length and meet in two points. Another asserts that all perpendiculars to a line meet in one point. The sum of the angles of a triangle is always greater than 180° but decreases to 180° as the area of the triangle approaches zero. Two similar triangles are necessarily congruent. As to the applicability of this double elliptic geometry, all of the arguments for the applicability of the previously created non-Euclidean geometry, now called hyperbolic geometry, apply with equal force.*

乍看起来，这些奇特几何竟可能与欧几里得几何竞争，甚至取代它，似乎荒谬。但高斯面对了这一可能。无论他是否使用1827年论文的测量数据检验非欧几里得几何，他都最先不仅断言其适用，而且认识到我们不再能确信欧几里得几何的真理性。无法确定他是否直接受休谟著作影响。他蔑视康德对休谟的反驳。尽管如此，高斯生活的时代，数学规律的真理性正在受到挑战；他必定吸收了思想氛围，如同我们都呼吸周围的空气。新的思想视野，即使不易察觉，也会扎根。如果萨凯里晚生一百年，或许他也会得出高斯的结论。

At first thought the idea that any of these strange geometries could possibly compete with or even supersede Euclidean geometry seems absurd. But Gauss faced this possibility. Whether or not he used the measurements recorded in his paper of 1827 to test the applicability of non-Euclidean geometry, he was the first man to assert not only its applicability but to recognize that we could no longer be sure of the truth of Euclidean geometry. That Gauss was influenced directly by the writings of Hume cannot be ascertained. Kant’s rebuttal of Hume he disdained. Nevertheless he lived at a time when the truth of mathematical laws was being challenged, and he must have absorbed the intellectual atmosphere as surely as all of us breathe the air about us. New intellectual outlooks take hold even if imperceptibly. Had Saccheri been born one hundred years later, perhaps he too would have arrived at Gauss’s conclusions.

*后来，费利克斯·克莱因指出，还有另一种初等非欧几里得几何，其中任意两直线相交于一点。他称之为单椭圆几何。

" Later Felix Klein pointed out that there is another elementary non-Euclidean geometry in which any two lines meet in one point. This he called single elliptic.

起初，高斯似乎断定，整个数学都没有真理。1811年11月21日，他致贝塞尔信中说：“永远不应忘记，［复变］函数如同一切数学构造，只是我们自己的创造；当最初采用的定义不再有意义时，不应问它是什么，而应问，为使它仍有意义，假定什么更方便。”但没有人轻易放弃珍宝。他显然重新考虑数学真理问题，找到可用来锚定数学的磐石。1817年致海因里希·W.M.奥尔伯斯（1758—1840）信中，他说：“我越来越确信，我们的［欧几里得］几何的［物理］必然性不能证明，至少不能由人类理性证明，也不能为人类理性证明。或许来世，我们能获得如今无法达到的空间本性洞见。在此之前，不应把几何与纯粹先验的算术归于一类，而应与力学归于一类。”高斯不同于康德，不接受力学规律为真理。他和大多数人追随伽利略，相信这些规律以经验为基础。1830年4月9日，他致信贝塞尔：

At first Gauss seems to have concluded that there is no truth in all of mathematics. In a letter to Bessel of November 21,1811, he said, “One should never forget that the functions [of a complex variable], like all mathematical constructions, are only our own creations, and that when the definition with which one begins ceases to make sense, one should not ask, What is, but what is it convenient to assume in order that it remain significant.” But no one yields up treasures readily. Gauss apparently reconsidered the matter of the truth of mathematics and saw the rock to which he could anchor it. In a letter to Heinrich W. M. Olbers (1758- 1840) written in 1817 he said, “I am becoming more and more convinced that the [physical] necessity of our [Euclidean] geometry cannot be proved, at least not by human reason nor for human reason. Perhaps in another life we will be able to obtain insight into the nature of space which is now unattainable. Until then we must not place geometry in the same class with arithmetic, which is purely a priori, but with mechanics.” Gauss, unlike Kant, did not accept the laws of mechanics as truths. Rather he and most men followed Galileo in believing that these laws are founded on experience. On April 9, 1830, Gauss wrote to Bessel:

依我最真诚的确信，空间理论在知识中的地位，与纯数学［以数为基础的数学］完全不同。我们关于空间的全部知识，都缺少后者具有的、对必然性（以及绝对真理性）的完全确信。我们必须谦逊地补充：如果数纯粹是心智的产物，空间却在心智之外具有实在性，我们不能完全规定其规律。

According to my most sincere conviction the theory of space has an entirely different place in knowledge from that occupied by pure mathematics [the mathematics built on number]. There is lacking throughout our knowledge of it the complete persuasion of necessity (also of absolute truth) which is common to the latter: we must add in humility, that if number is exclusively the product of our mind, space has a reality outside our mind and we cannot completely prescribe its laws.

高斯断言，真理存在于算术，因而也存在于以算术为基础的代数与分析（微积分及其扩展）中，因为算术真理对心智是清楚的。

Gauss was asserting that truth lies in arithmetic and consequently in algebra and analysis (calculus and its extensions), which are built on arithmetic, because the truths of arithmetic are clear to our minds.

欧几里得几何是物理空间的几何、是关于空间的真理，这一观念如此根深蒂固，以至于多年间，高斯等人的任何相反思想都被拒绝。数学家格奥尔格·康托尔谈到无知守恒定律。错误结论一旦得出并广泛接受，便不易动摇；人们越不理解，就越顽固坚持。罗巴切夫斯基与鲍耶的著作发表后三十年左右，除少数数学家外，所有人都忽视非欧几里得几何，把它视为奇异之物。有些不否认其逻辑连贯性，另一些却相信其中必有矛盾，因而毫无价值。几乎所有数学家都坚持，物理空间的几何，那唯一的几何，必定是欧几里得的。

That Euclidean geometry is the geometry of physical space, that it is the truth about space, was so ingrained in people’s minds that for many years any contrary thoughts such as Gauss’s were rejected. The mathematician Georg Cantor spoke of a law of conservation of ignorance. A false conclusion once arrived at and widely accepted is not easily dislodged and the less it is understood the more tenaciously it is held. For thirty or so years after the publication of Lobatchevsky’s and Bolyai’s works all but a few mathematicians ignored the non-Euclidean geometries. They were regarded as a curiosity. Some mathematicians did not deny their logical coherence. Others believed that they must contain contradictions and so were worthless. Almost all mathematicians maintained that the geometry of physical space, the geometry, must be Euclidean.

不幸的是，数学家已抛弃上帝，因此神圣几何学家拒绝揭示，他究竟用哪种竞争几何设计宇宙。数学家只能自谋出路。但高斯1855年去世后，笔记内容得以公布，当时他的声誉无可匹敌；1868年黎曼1854年的论文出版，又使许多数学家确信，非欧几里得几何可能是物理空间的几何，我们不再能确定哪一种为真。可能存在替代几何这一事实，本身就是震动；更大的震动，是不能再确定哪种几何为真，或是否其中任何一种为真。显然，数学家采用的几何公理，只基于有限经验而看来正确，他们却受误导，以为它们是自明真理。数学家处于马克·吐温描述的境地：“人是宗教动物。他是唯一拥有真正宗教的动物——而且有好几种。”

Unfortunately, mathematicians had abandoned God and so the Divine Geometer refused to reveal which of the several competing geometries He had used to design the universe. Mathematicians were thrown upon their own resources. However, the material in Gauss’s notes became available after his death in 1855 when his reputation was unexcelled and the publication in 1868 of Riemann’s 1854 paper convinced many mathematicians that a non-Euclidean geometry could be the geometry of physical space and that we could no longer be sure which geometry was true. The mere fact that there can be alternative geometries was in itself a shock. But the greater shock was that one could no longer be sure which geometry was true or whether any one of them was true. It became clear that mathematicians had adopted axioms for geometry that seemed correct on the basis of limited experience and had been deluded into thinking that these were self-evident truths. Mathematicians were in the position described by Mark Twain: “Man is the religious animal. He’s the only one who’s got the true religion—several of them.”

数学家逐渐接受非欧几里得几何及其对几何真理性的含义，但不是因为其适用性论证得到任何加强。真正原因，量子力学创始人马克斯·普朗克于二十世纪初说明了：“新的科学真理不是通过说服反对者、使他们看见光明而胜利，而是因为反对者最终死去，熟悉它的新一代成长起来。”

Non-Euclidean geometry and its implication about the truth of geometry were accepted gradually by mathematicians, but not because the arguments for its applicability were strengthened in any way. Rather the reason was given in the early 1900s by Max Planck, the founder of quantum mechanics: “A new scientific truth does not triumph by convincing its opponents and making them see light, but rather because its opponents eventually die, and a new generation grows up that is familiar with it.”

至于整个数学的真理性，某些数学家采取高斯的立场。真理存在于数中，数是算术、代数、微积分与高等分析的基础。卡尔·古斯塔夫·雅各布·雅可比（1804—1850）说：“上帝永远在进行算术活动。”并非柏拉图所说的永远进行几何活动。

As to the truth of mathematics as a whole, some mathematicians took the position of Gauss. Truth resides in number, which is the basis of arithmetic, algebra, calculus, and higher branches of analysis. As Karl Gustav Jacob Jacobi (1804-1850) put it, “God ever arithmetizes.” He does not, as Plato had maintained, eternally geometrize.

看来，数学家成功挽救了以算术为基础的部分数学，保持其真理地位；到1850年，这部分远比几种几何庞大，对科学也更关键。不幸，随后还有其他震撼事件。为理解它们，须稍作回溯。自十六世纪起，数学家使用向量概念。向量通常画成有向线段，既有方向，也有大小（图4.5），用于表示力、速度，或其他方向与大小都重要的量。平面中的向量，可以在几何上按照通常的加、减、乘除运算组合，得到合向量。同一世纪引入复数，即a + bi形式的数，其中i = −1，a和b为实数。甚至对数学家，它们也颇为神秘。因此，约1800年，卡斯帕尔·韦塞尔（1745—1818）、让—罗贝尔·阿尔冈（1786—1822）与高斯等几位数学家认识到，可用平面中的有向线段表示复数（图4.6），实在是一大福音。这些人立即看出，复数不仅可以用来表示平面中的向量，还可以用于进行向量的加、减、乘、除。也就是说，复数充当向量的代数，如同整数与分数可以表示商业交易等。因此，无需在几何上进行向量运算，可以用代数处理。例如，两个向量OA与OB相加（图4.7），按照向量加法平行四边形法则，必得和或合向量OC；可以把OA表示为复数3 + 2i，把OB表示为2 + 4i，以代数完成运算。其和5 + 6i就代表合向量OC。

It would seem then that mathematicians had managed to rescue and maintain as truths the portion of mathematics built on arithmetic, which by 1850 was far more extensive and more vital for science then the several geometries. Unfortunately, other shattering events were to follow. To understand these we must backtrack a bit. Since the sixteenth century, mathematicians had been using the concept of vectors. A vector, usually pictured as a directed line segment, has both direction and magnitude (Fig. 4.5). It is used to represent a force, a velocity, or any other quantity for which both direction and magnitude are important. Vectors in one plane can be combined geometrically under the usual operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division to yield a resultant vector. The same century saw the introduction of complex numbers, that is, numbers of the form a + bi, where i = −1 and a and b are real numbers. These were, even to mathematicians, rather mysterious quantities. It was therefore a boon when, about 1800, several mathematicians, Caspar Wessel (1745-1818), Jean-Robert Argand (1786- 1822), and Gauss, realized that one can represent complex numbers as directed line segments in a plane (Fig. 4.6). These same men saw at once that complex numbers could be used not only to represent vectors in a plane but that the operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of vectors could be performed by using the complex numbers. That is, complex numbers serve as the algebra of vectors, just as the whole numbers and fractions serve to represent, for example, commercial transactions. Hence one need not carry out operations with vectors geometrically but can work with them algebraically. Thus the addition of the two vectors OA and OB (Fig. 4.7), which according to the parallelogram law for the addition of vectors must yield the sum or resultant vector OC, can be carried out algebraically by representing OA as the complex number 3 + 2i, and OB as the complex number 2 + 4i. The sum, 5 + 6i, then represents the resultant vector OC.

图4.6

Figure 4.6

这种用复数表示平面向量及其运算的方法，到1830年已相当为人所知。然而，若几个力作用于物体，这些力及其向量表示不必、而且通常不会位于同一平面。如果为方便，把普通实数称为一维数，复数称为二维数，那么要表示并用代数处理空间向量，就需要某种三维数。如同复数，这些三维数应能进行加、减、乘、除，并遵循实数与复数的通常性质，使代数运算可以自由、有效地应用。因此，数学家开始寻找所谓三维复数及其代数。

This use of complex numbers to represent vectors and operations with vectors that lie in a plane had become somewhat well known by 1830. However, if several forces act on a body, these forces and their vector representations need not and generally will not lie in one plane. If for the sake of convenience we call ordinary real numbers one-dimensional numbers and complex numbers two-dimensional, then what would be needed to represent and work algebraically with vectors in space is some sort of three-dimensional number. The desired operations with these three-dimensional numbers, as in the case of complex numbers, would have to include addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division and moreover obey the usual properties of real and complex numbers so that algebraic operations could be applied freely and effectively. Hence mathematicians began a search for what was called a three-dimensional complex number and its algebra.

许多数学家研究这个问题。1843年，威廉·R.哈密顿创造了复数的一种有用空间类似物。他曾困惑十五年。当时所有已知的数都具有乘法交换性，即ab = ba，他自然相信，所求三维或三分量的数，除实数和复数的其他性质外，也应具有这一性质。他成功了，却只能作两项妥协：第一，新数包含四个分量；第二，必须牺牲乘法交换律。这两点对代数都是革命性的。他称新数为四元数。

Many mathematicians took up this problem. The creation in 1843 of a useful spatial analogue of complex numbers is due to William R. Hamilton. For fifteen years Hamilton was baffled. All of the numbers known to mathematicians at this time possessed the commutative property of multiplication, that is ab = ba, and it was natural for Hamilton to believe that the three-dimensional or three-component numbers he sought should possess this same property as well as the other properties that real and complex numbers possess. Hamilton succeeded but only by making two compromises. First, his new numbers contained four components and, second, he had to sacrifice the commutative law of multiplication. Both features were revolutionary for algebra. He called the new numbers quaternions.

复数形式是a + bi，其中i = −1；四元数则是如下形式的数：

Whereas a complex number is of the form a + bi wherein i = −1, a quaternion is a number of the form

a+bi+cj+dk

a+bi+cj+dk

其中i、j、k具有与−1相同的性质，即

wherein the i, j, and k possess the same property as −1, namely,

i2=j2=k2=−1.

i2=j2=k2=−1.

两个四元数相等的标准，是对应系数a、b、c、d分别相等。

The criterion for equality of two quaternions is that the coefficients a, b, c, and d be equal.

两个四元数相加，就是分别相加对应系数，形成新系数。因此，两四元数之和仍为四元数。为定义乘法，哈密顿必须规定i与j、i与k、j与k的乘积。为保证乘积仍为四元数，并使四元数尽可能具有实数与复数的性质，他得到：

Two quaternions are added by the addition of the respective coefficients to form new coefficients. Thus the sum of two quaternions is itself a quaternion. To define multiplication Hamilton had to specify what the products of i and j, i and k, and j and k should be. To ensure that the product be a quaternion and to secure for his quaternions as many of the properties of real and complex numbers as possible, he arrived at

jk=i,kj=−i,ki=j,ik=−j,ij=k,ji=−k.

jk=i,kj=−i,ki=j,ik=−j,ij=k,ji=−k.

这些约定意味着乘法不交换。因此，若p与q为四元数，pq不等于qp。四元数之间也能进行除法。但乘法不交换意味着，以四元数q除p，可能要找满足p = qr的r，也可能要找满足p = rq的r。两种情况下的商r不必相同。四元数虽未像哈密顿期待的那样广泛有用，他仍将其应用于大量物理与几何问题。

These agreements mean that multiplication is not commutative. Thus if p and q are quaternions, pq does not equal qp. Division of one quaternion by another can also be effected. However, the fact that multiplication is not commutative means that to divide the quaternion p by the quaternion q one can intend to find r such that p = qr or such that p = rq. The quotient r need not be the same in the two cases. Though quaternions did not prove to be as broadly useful as Hamilton expected, he was able to apply them to a large number of physical and geometrical problems.

四元数的引入，给数学家又一次震动。这是一种物理上有用的代数，却不具有所有实数与复数的基本性质，即

The introduction of quaternions was another shock to mathematicians. Here was a physically useful algebra which failed to possess a fundamental property of all real and complex numbers, namely, that

ab=ba.

ab=ba.

哈密顿创立四元数不久，其他领域的数学家引入更奇异的代数。著名代数几何学家阿瑟·凯莱（1821—1895）引入矩阵，即数的正方形或长方形排列。它们也能进行通常代数运算，却如四元数一样缺少乘法交换性。而且，两矩阵均不为零，乘积却可能为零。四元数与矩阵，只是一批性质越来越奇异的新代数的先驱。赫尔曼·京特尔·格拉斯曼（1809—1877）创立了多种这类代数，甚至比哈密顿四元数更一般。不幸，他是中学教师，因此多年后，工作才获得应有关注。无论如何，他的工作增添了如今所谓超数的新类型。

Not long after Hamilton created quaternions, mathematicians working in other domains introduced even stranger algebras. The famous algebraic geometer Arthur Cayley (1821-1895) introduced matrices, which are square or rectangular arrays of numbers. These too are subject to the usual operations of algebra but, as in the case of quaternions, lack the commutative property of multiplication. Moreover, the product of two matrices can be zero even though neither factor is zero. Quaternions and matrices were but the forerunners of a host of new algebras with stranger and stranger properties. Hermann Gunther Grassmann (1809-1877), created a variety of such algebras. These were even more general than Hamilton’s quaternions. Unfortunately, Grassmann was a high school teacher and so it took many years before his work received the attention it deserved. In any case, Grassmann s work added to the variety of new types of what are now called hypernumbers.

为特殊目的创立新代数，本身并未挑战普通算术及其代数、分析扩展的真理性。毕竟，普通实数与复数用于完全不同的目的，其适用性似乎无可怀疑。然而，新代数的出现本身，使人怀疑熟悉的算术与代数的真理性，正如了解陌生文明习俗的人，开始质疑自己的习俗。

The creation of new algebras for special purposes did not in itself challenge the truth of ordinary arithmetic and its extensions in algebra and analysis. After all, the ordinary real and complex numbers were used for totally different purposes where their applicability seemed unquestionable. Nevertheless, the very fact that new algebras appeared on the scene made men doubt the truth of the familiar arithmetic and algebra, just as people who learn about the customs of a strange civilization begin to question their own.

对算术真理性最尖锐的攻击，来自杰出医生、物理学家兼数学家赫尔曼·冯·亥姆霍兹（1821—1894）。在《计数与测量》（1887）中，他认为算术的主要问题，是为算术自动应用于物理现象提供依据。他的结论是，只有经验能告诉我们算术规律适用于何处。我们不能先验地确信，它们适用于任何给定情境。

The sharpest attack on the truth of arithmetic came from Hermann von Helmholtz (1821-1894), a superb physician, physicist, and mathematician. In his Counting and Measuring (1887) he considered the main problem in arithmetic to be the justification of the automatic application of arithmetic to physical phenomena. His conclusion was that only experience can tell us where the laws of arithmetic do apply. We cannot be sure a priori that they do apply in any given situation.

亥姆霍兹作了许多切题观察。数概念本身来自经验。某些经验提示整数、分数与无理数等通常数类及其性质；熟悉的数适用于这些经验。我们认识到实际上等价的对象存在，因此可以谈论，例如两头牛。但这些对象不能消失、合并或分裂。一滴雨加另一滴，并不成为两滴。甚至相等概念也不能自动用于经验。若对象a等于c，b等于c，a必等于b，似乎确定无疑。但两个音高可能都听起来等于第三个，耳朵却能区分前两个。在这里，同等于一个东西的两个东西，不必彼此相等。同样，颜色a与b看来相同，b与c也相同，但a与c却能区分。

Helmholtz made many pertinent observations. The very concept of number is derived from experiences. Some kinds of experience suggest the usual types of number, whole numbers, fractions, and irrational numbers, and their properties. To these experiences the familiar numbers are applicable. We recognize that virtually equivalent objects exist and so we recognize that we may speak, for example, of two cows. However, these objects must not disappear or merge or divide. One raindrop added to another does not make two raindrops. Even the notion of equality cannot be applied automatically to experience. It would seem certain that if object a equals c and b equals c that a must equal b. But two pitches of sound may seem to equal a third and yet the ear might distinguish the first two. Here things equal to the same thing need not equal each other. Likewise colors a and b may seem the same as do colors b and c but a and c can be distinguished.

许多例子说明，天真地应用算术会导致荒谬。两份等体积水，一份华氏40°，另一份50°，混合后并不成为两份90°的水。把每秒100周与每秒200周的两个纯音叠加，不会得到频率每秒300周的声音；实际上，合成声音的频率是每秒100周。电路中，阻值R1与R2的两电阻并联，合成有效电阻为R1R2/(R1 + R2)。此外，亨利·勒贝格诙谐地指出，把狮子与兔子放进笼子，过后不会在笼中找到两只动物。

Many examples may be adduced to show that the naive application of arithmetic would lead to nonsense. Thus if one mixes two equal volumes of water, one at 40° Fahrenheit and the other at 50°, one does not get two volumes at 90°. If two simple sounds, one of 100 cycles per second and another of 200 cycles per second, are superposed one does not get a sound whose frequency is 300 cycles per second. In fact the composite sound has a frequency of 100 cycles per second. If two resistances of magnitudes R1 and R2 are connected in parallel in an electrical circuit, their combined effective resistance is R1R2/(R1 + R2). Further, as Henri Lebesgue facetiously pointed out, if one puts a lion and a rabbit in a cage, one will not find two animals in the cage later on.

化学告诉我们，氢与氧混合会得到水。但两体积氢与一体积氧，得到的不是三体积，而是两体积水蒸气。同样，一体积氮与三体积氢，产生两体积氨。我们恰好知道这些惊人算术事实的物理解释。按阿伏伽德罗假说，在相同温度与压力下，任何气体的相等体积，含相同数量的粒子。因此，若一定体积氧含10个分子，同体积氢也含10个分子。两体积氢便有20个分子。氧和氢恰好是双原子分子，即每个分子含两个原子。这20个氢分子各与10个氧分子中的一个氧原子结合，形成20个水分子，即两体积水，而非三体积。因此，算术不能正确描述按体积混合气体的结果。

We learn in chemistry that when one mixes hydrogen and oxygen he obtains water. But if someone takes two volumes of hydrogen and one volume of oxygen, he obtains, not three, but two volumes of water vapor. Likewise, one volume of nitrogen and three volumes of hydrogen yield two volumes of ammonia. We happen to know the physical explanation of these surprising arithmetic facts. By Avogadro’s hypothesis, equal volumes of any gas, under the same conditions of temperature and pressure, contain the same number of particles. If, then, a given volume of oxygen contains 10 molecules, the same volume of hydrogen will also contain 10 molecules. Then there are 20 molecules in two volumes of hydrogen. Now it happens that the molecules of oxygen and hydrogen are diatomic; that is, each contains two atoms. Each of these 20 diatomic hydrogen molecules combines with one atom of the 10 molecules of oxygen to form 20 molecules of water or two volumes of water, but not three. Thus arithmetic fails to describe correctly the result of combining gases by volumes.

普通算术也不能描述某些液体按体积混合。把一夸脱杜松子酒与一夸脱味美思混合，不会得到两夸脱，而是略少。一夸脱酒精与一夸脱水，约产生1.8夸脱伏特加。大多数含酒精液体的混合都如此。三汤匙水与一汤匙盐，不构成四汤匙。某些化学混合物不仅体积不相加，还会爆炸。

Ordinary arithmetic also fails to describe the combination of some liquids by volume. If a quart of gin is mixed with a quart of vermouth one does not get two quarts of the mixture but a quantity slightly less. One quart of alcohol and one quart of water yield about 1.8 quarts of vodka. This is true of most mixtures of alcoholic liquids. Three tablespoons of water and one tablespoon of salt do not make four tablespoons. Some chemical mixtures not only do not add up by volume but explode.

整数性质不仅不适用于许多物理情境，还有实际情境必须采用另一种分数算术。让我们考虑棒球，这无疑是数百万美国人关心的主题。

Not only do the properties of the whole numbers fail to apply to many physical situations, but there are practical situations in which a different arithmetic of fractions must be applied. Let us consider baseball, certainly a subject of interest to millions of Americans.

假设球员一场比赛打击3次，另一场4次，总共多少次？毫无困难，共7次。假设第一场成功击球，即到达一垒或更远，2次，第二场3次，两场有多少安打？也没有困难，共2 + 3，即5次。然而，观众与球员通常最关心的是打击率，即安打数与打击次数之比。第一场为2/3，第二场为3/4。现在，若球员或球迷想用这两个比率计算两场总打击率，人们可能认为只需按通常方法把分数相加，即

Suppose a player goes to bat 3 times in one game and 4 times in another. How many times in all did he go to bat? There is no difficulty here. He went to bat a total of 7 times. Suppose he hit the ball successfully, that is, got to first base or farther, twice in the first game and 3 times in the second. How many hits did he make in both games? Again there is no difficulty. The total number of hits is 2 + 3, or 5. However, what the audience, and the player himself, is usually most interested in is the batting average, that is, the ratio of the number of hits to the number of times at bat. In the first game this ratio was 23; in the second game the ratio was 34. And now suppose the player or a baseball fan wishes to use these two ratios to compute the batting average for both games. One would think that all he would have to do was to add the two fractions by the usual method of adding fractions. That is,

23+34=1712.

23+34=1712.

这结果当然荒谬。球员不可能在12次打击中获得17次安打。显然，通常分数加法，不能通过相加各场打击率，得出两场总打击率。

Of course this result is absurd. The player could not get 17 hits in 12 times at bat. Evidently, the ordinary method of adding fractions does not serve to give the batting average for both games by addition of the batting averages for the separate games.

如何从各场打击率获得两场正确的总打击率？答案是采用一种新分数加法。我们知道，总打击率为5/7，各场分别是2/3与3/4。若把各分数的分子相加、分母相加，再组成新分数，就得到正确答案。即

How can we obtain the correct batting average for the two games from those of the separate games? The answer is to use a new method \of adding fractions. We know that the combined average is 57 and the separate batting averages are 23 and 34. We see that, if we add the numerators and add the denominators of the separate fractions and then form the new fraction, we get the correct answer. That is,

前提是，这个加号表示分子相加、分母相加。

provided this plus sign means adding the numerators and adding the denominators.

这种分数加法在其他情境也有用。推销员若想记录成效，可能发现一天5次拜访中成交3次，次日7次中成交4次。为获得成功次数与总拜访数之比，就必须像相加打击率一样，把3/5与4/7相加。两天共12次拜访、7次成功，这个7/12就是3/5 + 47，前提是加号表示分子相加、分母相加。

This method of adding fractions is useful in other situations. A salesman who wishes to keep a record of his effectiveness may note that he made a sale in 3 out of 5 calls one day and 4 out of 7 calls the next day. To obtain the ratio of his successful calls to his total number of calls he would have to add the 35 and 47 in precisely the manner in which the batting averages are added. His record for the two days of work is 7 successes in a total of 12 calls and this 712 is 35 + 47, provided plus means adding the numerators and adding the denominators.

另一项应用更常见。假设汽车2小时行驶50英里，3小时行驶100英里，两段路程的平均速率是多少？可以说，汽车5小时行驶150英里，所以平均每小时30英里。但常常需要从各段平均速率计算全程平均速率。第一段为50/2，第二段为100/3。把两个分数的分子相加、分母相加，就得到全程正确平均速率。

Still another application is even more common. Suppose an automobile covers 50 miles in 2 hours and 100 miles in 3 hours. What is its average speed for both trips? One could say that the automobile covered 150 miles in 5 hours so that its average speed is 30 miles per hour. However, it is often useful to be able to compute the average speed for the total amount of travel from the average speeds for the individual trips. The average speed for the first trip is 502 and the average for the second trip is 1003. If one adds the numerators and adds the denominators of these two fractions, he obtains the correct average for the total trip.

通常4/6 = 23。但在这里讨论的算术中，相加例如2/3 + 3/5时，不能用4/6替代2/3，因为前者答案是5/8，后者是7/11，二者不相等。此外，普通算术中，5/1与7/1等分数的行为，与整数5和7完全相同。但在新算术中把它们作为分数相加，得到的不是12/1，而是12/2。

Ordinarily 46 = 23. However, in adding two fractions in the arithmetic under discussion, say, 23 + 35, it would not do to replace 23 by 46, for the answer in one case is 58 and in the other is 711, and these two answers are not equal. Further, in normal arithmetic, fractions such as 51 and 71 behave exactly as do the integers 5 and 7. However, if we add 51 and 71 as fractions in the new arithmetic we do not obtain 121 but 122.

这些或可称为棒球算术的例子，表明我们可以引入不同于熟悉运算的运算，从而创造适用的算术。实际上，数学中还有许多其他算术。但健全的数学家不会仅为满足异想天开而创立算术。每种算术都设计为表示物理世界的某类现象。把运算定义得符合该类现象中发生的事情，正如上述分数加法符合两场打击率的合并，就能方便地用算术研究物理过程。只有经验能告诉我们，普通算术适用于给定物理现象的何处。因此，不能把算术称为一套必然适用于物理现象的真理。当然，代数与分析既是算术扩展，也不是真理体系。

These examples of what one might call baseball arithmetic do show that we can introduce operations different from the familiar ones and so create an applicable arithmetic. There are in fact many other arithmetics in mathematics. However, the sound mathematician does not create an arithmetic just to indulge whims. Each arithmetic is designed to represent some class of phenomena of the physical world. By defining the operations to fit what takes place in that class of phenomena, just as the above addition of fractions fits the combination of two batting averages, one can use the arithmetic to study conveniently what happens physically. Only experience can tell us where ordinary arithmetic applies to any given physical phenomena. Thus one cannot speak of arithmetic as a body of truths that necessarily apply to physical phenomena. Of course, since algebra and analysis are extensions of arithmetic, these branches, too, are not bodies of truth.

因此，数学家不得不得出的悲哀结论是，数学中没有真理，即没有作为关于真实世界规律的那种真理。算术与几何基本结构的公理，由经验提示，因此结构的适用性有限。究竟适用于何处，只能由经验确定。希腊人试图从自明真理出发、只用演绎证明来保证数学真理性，终于证明徒劳。

Thus the sad conclusion which mathematicians were obliged to draw is that there is no truth in mathematics, that is, truth in the sense of laws about the real world. The axioms of the basic structures of arithmetic and geometry are suggested by experience, and the structures as a consequence have a limited applicability. Just where they are applicable can be determined only by experience. The Greeks’ attempt to guarantee the truth of mathematics by starting with self-evident truths and by using only deductive proof proved futile.

对许多深思的数学家来说，数学并非真理体系这一事实，令人反感得无法接受。上帝似乎用几种几何和代数使他们困惑，正如用不同语言使巴别塔的人困惑。因此，他们拒绝接受新创造。

To many thoughtful mathematicians the fact that mathematics is not a body of truths was too repugnant to swallow. It seemed as though God had sought to confound them with several geometries and several algebras just as He had confounded the people of Babel with different languages. Hence they refused to accept the new creations.

威廉·R.哈密顿无疑是杰出数学家之一，他于1837年表达对非欧几里得几何的反对：

William R. Hamilton, certainly one of the outstanding mathematicians, expressed his objection to non-Euclidean geometry in 1837:

任何坦诚而聪明的人，都不能怀疑两千年前欧几里得在《几何原本》中陈述的平行线主要性质的真理性，虽然完全可以希望用更清楚、更好的方法处理它们。这一学说不包含晦暗或思想混乱，不给心智留下任何合理怀疑依据，尽管可以有益地运用巧思，改进论证方案。

No candid and intelligent person can doubt the truth of the chief properties of Parallel Lines, as set forth by Euclid in his Elements, two thousand years ago; though he may well desire to see them treated in a clearer and better method. The doctrine involves no obscurity nor confusion of thought, and leaves in the mind no reasonable ground for doubt, although ingenuity may usefully be exercised in improving the plan of the argument.

阿瑟·凯莱于1883年向英国科学促进会作会长演说时肯定：

In his presidential address of 1883 to the British Association for the Advancement of Science, Arthur Cayley affirmed:

我的看法是，普莱费尔形式的欧几里得第十二公理［通常称第五公理或平行公理］无需证明，而是我们空间观念的一部分，是我们经验中的物理空间的一部分。我们通过经验熟悉它，但它又是构成一切外部经验基础的表象。……并非几何命题仅近似为真，而是就长期被视为经验的物理空间的欧几里得空间而言，它们仍绝对为真。

My own view is that Euclid’s twelfth axiom [usually called the fifth or parallel axiom] in Playfair’s form of it does not need demonstration, but is part of our notion of space, of the physical space of our experience—which one becomes acquainted with by experience, but which is the representation lying at the foundation of all external experience. . . . Mot that the propositions of geometry are only approximately true, but that they remain absolutely true in regard to that Euclidean space which has been so long regarded as being the physical space of our experience.

近代真正伟大的数学家之一费利克斯·克莱因（1849—1925），表达了大致相同看法。凯莱和克莱因虽亲自研究非欧几里得几何，却把它们视为在欧几里得几何中引入人为的新距离函数后得到的新奇事物。他们拒绝承认非欧几里得几何与欧几里得几何同样基本、同样适用。当然，在相对论之前，他们的立场尚可成立。

Felix Klein (1849-1925), one of the truly great mathematicians of recent times, expressed about the same view. Though Cayley and Klein had themselves worked in non-Euclidean geometries, they regarded them as novelties that result when artificial new distance functions are introduced in Euclidean geometry. They refused to grant that non-Euclidean geometry is as basic and as applicable as Euclidean. Of course their position, in pre-relativity days, was tenable.

伯特兰·罗素也仍相信数学真理性，虽略加限制。1890年代，他研究空间哪些性质必然、可以在经验之前预设；即否定这些先验性质中的任何一项，经验便无意义。在《几何基础论》（1897）中，他同意欧几里得几何不是先验知识。他反而断定，作为基本定性几何的射影几何*，对所有几何都是先验的；鉴于约1900年这一学科的重要性，这一结论可以理解。随后，他把欧几里得及所有非欧几里得几何共有的公理，也作为先验公理加入射影几何。这些公理涉及空间齐性、有限维性与距离概念，使测量成为可能。他还指出，定性考察必须先于定量考察，这加强了射影几何优先性的论据。

Bertrand Russell too still believed in the truth of mathematics, though he limited the truths somewhat. In the 1890s he took up the question of what properties of space are necessary and can be presupposed before experience. That is, experience would be meaningless if any of these a priori properties were denied. In his Essay on the Foundations of Geometry (1897), he agreed that Euclidean geometry is not a priori knowledge. He concluded, rather, that projective geometry,* a basic qualitative geometry, is a priori for all geometry, an understandable conclusion in view of the importance of that subject around 1900. He then added to projective geometry, as a priori, axioms common to Euclidean and all the non-Euclidean geometries. These axioms, which concern the homogeneity of space, finite dimensionality, and a concept of distance, make measurement possible. Russell also pointed out that qualitative considerations must precede quantitative ones, and this contention reinforces the case for the priority of projective geometry.

至于度量几何，即欧几里得与几种非欧几里得几何，通过引入特定距离概念可以从射影几何推出它们；罗素认为，这是没有哲学意义的技术成就。无论如何，它们的具体定理不是先验真理。对于几种基本度量几何，他不同于凯莱、克莱因，把它们视为具有同等逻辑地位。由于只有欧几里得、双曲、单椭圆与双椭圆空间具有上述先验性质，他断定，它们是仅有的可能度量几何，当然欧几里得几何是唯一物理上适用者。其他几何的哲学重要性，在于表明可能有其他几何。事后看来，他以射影偏见取代了欧几里得偏见。多年后，他承认《几何基础论》是年轻时的作品，不再能够辩护。但后面将看到，他与其他人提出了确立数学真理的新基础（第X章）。

As for the metrical geometries, that is, the Euclidean and the several non-Euclidean, the fact that they can be derived from projective geometry by the introduction of a specific concept of distance Russell regarded as a technical achievement having no philosophical significance. In any case their specific theorems are not a priori truths. With respect to the several basic metric geometries, he departed from Cayley and Klein and regarded all these geometries as being on an equal logical footing. Since the only metric spaces that possess the above a priori properties are the Euclidean, hyperbolic, and single and double elliptic, Russell concluded that these are the only possible metrical geometries and of course Euclidean is the only physically applicable one. The others are of philosophical importance in showing that there can be other geometries. With hindsight it is now possible to see that Russell replaced the Euclidean bias by a projective bias. Russell admitted many years later that his Essay was a work of his youth and could no longer be defended. As we shall see later, however, he and others formulated a new basis for establishing truth in mathematics (Chapter X).

数学家坚持寻找某些基本真理，可以理解。历经数百年在描述与预测物理现象方面的辉煌成功之后，接受数学不是钻石收藏而是人造宝石收藏的事实，对任何人都困难，尤其对那些可能因自豪于自己创造而目盲者。然而，数学家逐渐承认，数学公理与定理不是关于物理世界的必然真理。某些经验领域提示特定公理集合；公理及其逻辑结果对这些领域的适用，足够精确，可以作为有用描述。但扩大领域后，适用性可能失去。就物理世界研究而言，数学只提供理论或模型。当经验或实验显示新理论比旧理论吻合更紧密时，新数学理论可以取代旧理论。爱因斯坦1921年很好地表达了数学与物理世界的关系：

The persistence of mathematicians in searching for some basic truths is understandable. To accept the fact that mathematics is not a collection of diamonds but of synthetic stones, after the centuries of brilliant successes in describing and predicting physical phenomena, would be hard for anyone and especially for those who might be blinded by pride in their own creations. Gradually, however, mathematicians granted that the axioms and theorems of mathematics were not necessary truths about the physical world. Some areas of experience suggest particular sets of axioms and to these areas the axioms and their logical consequences apply accurately enough to be taken as a useful description. But if any area is enlarged the applicability may be lost. As far as the study of the physical world is concerned, mathematics offers nothing but theories or models. And new mathematical theories may replace older ones when experience or experiment shows that a new theory provides closer correspondence than an older one. The relationship of mathematics to the physical world was well expressed by Einstein in 1921:

*射影几何研究把一个图形从一个平面投影到另一平面后，所得图形的共同性质。例如，把圆放在手电筒前，就能在屏幕或墙上看到影子。影子的形状随圆偏离竖直方向的倾斜程度而变化。然而，圆与这些不同形状，具有共同几何性质。

*Projective geometry studies the properties common to figures that result from projecting a figure from one plane to another. Thus if a circle is held in front of a flashlight, its shadow can be seen on a screen or a wall. The shape of the shadow changes as the circle is more or less inclined to the vertical. Yet the circle and the various shapes have common geometrical properties.

数学命题只要描述实在，就不确定；只要确定，就不描述实在。……但另一方面，确定的是，一般数学，尤其几何，其存在源于我们需要了解真实对象的性质。

Insofar as the propositions of mathematics give an account of reality they are not certain; and insofar as they are certain they do not describe reality. . . . But it is, on the other hand, certain that mathematics in general and geometry in particular owe their existence to our need to learn something about the properties of real objects.

数学家已放弃上帝，因此理应接受人。他们确实如此做了。他们继续发展数学、寻找自然规律，知道所产生的不是上帝的设计，而是人的工作。过去的成功帮助他们保持信心，幸运的是，许多新成功迎接其努力。保全数学生命的，是它自己调制的强效药物：天体力学、声学、流体动力学、光学、电磁理论与工程中的巨大成就，以及预测不可思议的精确性。这样一门学科，虽在不可战胜的真理旗帜下作战，实际却靠某种内在神秘力量获胜，必有某种根本、或许神奇的力量（第XV章）。于是，数学创造及其科学应用，以更快步伐继续。

Mathematicians had given up God and so it behooved them to accept man. And this is what they did. They continued to develop mathematics and to search for laws of nature, knowing that what they produced was not the design of God but the work of man. Their past successes helped them to retain confidence in what they were doing, and, fortunately, hosts of new successes greeted their efforts. What preserved the life of mathematics was the powerful medicine it had itself concocted—the enormous achievements in celestial mechanics, acoustics, hydrodynamics, optics, electromagnetic theory, and engineering—and the incredible accuracy of its predictions. There had to be some essential—perhaps magical—power in a subject which, though it had fought under the invincible banner of truth, has actually achieved its victories through some inner mysterious strength (Chapter XV). And so mathematical creation and application to science continued at an even faster pace.

认识到数学不是真理体系，产生了震撼性的影响。先看对科学的影响。自伽利略起，科学家认识到，不同于数学，科学基本原理必须来自经验，虽然至少两个世纪间，他们相信所找到的原理嵌入自然设计中。但十九世纪初，他们认识到科学理论不是真理。认识到甚至数学也从经验获得原理、不能再断言其真理性，使科学家明白，只要理论使用数学公理与定理，就更加脆弱。自然规律是人的创造。宇宙立法者是我们，不是上帝。自然规律是人的描述，不是上帝的规定。

The recognition that mathematics is not a body of truths has had shattering repercussions. Let us note first the effect on science. From Galileo’s time onward scientists recognized that the fundamental principles of science, as opposed to mathematics, must come from experience, although for at least two centuries they believed that the principles they did find were imbedded in the design of nature. But by the early nineteenth century they realized that scientific theories are not truths. The realization that even mathematics derives its principles from experience and that they could no longer assert their truth made scientists recognize that insofar as they use axioms and theorems of mathematics their theories are all the more vulnerable. Nature’s laws are man’s creation. We, not God, are the lawgivers of the universe. A law of nature is man’s description and not God’s prescription.

这场灾难的回响，波及几乎所有文化领域。数学与数学物理取得表面真理，曾鼓励人们期待在其他一切知识领域也能获得真理。笛卡尔1637年的《方法论》表达了这一期待：

The reverberations of this disaster have reached almost all areas of our culture. The attainment of apparent truths in mathematics and mathematical physics had encouraged the expectation that truths could be acquired in all other fields of knowledge. In his Discourse on Method of 1637 Descartes had voiced this expectation:

几何学家习惯借以完成最困难证明的简单、容易的长推理链，使我想到：凡人能够认识的事物，都以同样方式相互联系；没有什么离我们太远、无法达到，也没有什么隐藏得太深、无法发现，只要我们不把假当真，并在思考中始终保持从一个真理推出另一个真理所需的次序。

The long chains of simple and easy reasoning by means of which geometers are accustomed to reach the conclusions of their most difficult demonstrations, led me to imagine that all things, to the knowledge of which man is competent, are mutually connected in the same way, and there is nothing so far removed from us as to be beyond our reach or so hidden that we cannot discover it, provided only we abstain from accepting the false for the true, and always preserve in our thoughts the order necessary for the deduction of one truth from another.

笛卡尔写这些话时，数学研究的成功仍很少。十八世纪中叶，成功如此众多、如此深刻，思想领袖确信，通过理性与数学，可以在所有领域获得真理。达朗贝尔代表其时代说：

Descartes wrote these words when the successes of mathematical inquiry were still few. By the middle of the 18th century the successes were so numerous and so deep that intellectual leaders were confident they could secure truths in all fields by application of reason and mathematics. D’Alembert spoke for his age:

……宇宙景象在我们心中引起的某种思想升华……［已经］带来了活跃的心智激荡。这种激荡向自然的一切方向扩展，如一条冲破堤坝的河流，以某种猛烈力量席卷挡路的一切。……因此，从世俗科学的原理到宗教启示的基础，从形而上学到鉴赏，从音乐到道德，从神学家的经院争论到商业，从君主的法律到人民的法律，从自然法到各国任意制定的法律……一切都得到讨论与分析，或者至少被提及。

... a certain exaltation of ideas which the spectacle of the universe produces in us . . . [has] brought about a lively fermentation of minds. Spreading through nature in all directions like a river which has burst its dams, this fermentation has swept with a sort of violence everything along with it which has stood in its way. . . .
