Do we always, he asked pointedly, have such interpretations and do we not rely upon an intuitive basis for accepting their consistency?

外尔也挑战传统创造和证明方法更强的断言。在《心灵与自然》（1934）中说：“期待认识揭示比向直觉敞开的更深本性，是痴梦。”

Weyl, too, challenged the assertion that the traditional modes of creation and proof are more powerful. In his Mind and Nature (1934), he said, “It is fond dreaming to expect that a deeper nature than that which lies open to intuition should be revealed to cognition.”

某些反对者同意数学是人类创造，却认为可客观决定正确与否；直觉主义者则依赖会出错的人类心灵的自明性。希尔伯特和保罗·伯奈斯（1888—1978）在数学基础著作第一版中论证，这正是哲学的大弱点。若正确指对心灵自明，能依赖什么概念和推理？对全人类客观有效的真理在哪？

Some of intuitionism’s opponents agree that mathematics is a human creation, but believe that correctness or incorrectness can be objectively determined, whereas the intuitionists depend on self-evidency to fallible human minds. As Hilbert and Paul Bernays (1888-1978) argued in the first edition of their work on the foundations of mathematics, here we find the great weakness of the intuitionist philosophy. What concepts and reasoning may we rely upon if correctness were to mean self-evidency to the human mind? Where is truth, objectively valid for all human beings?

另一批评是，直觉主义不关心数学应用于自然，不使数学与知觉联系。布劳威尔承认直觉主义数学对实际应用无用；实际上，他拒绝人类支配自然。不论批评如何，外尔1951年说：“我认为，凡要坚持数学命题述说纯粹真理、以证据为基础的真理的人，都必须接受布劳威尔的批判。”

Another criticism of intuitionism is that it is not concerned with the application of mathematics to nature. Intuitionism does not relate mathematics to perception. Brouwer admitted that intuitionistic mathematics is useless for practical applications. In fact, Brouwer rejected human domination over nature. Whatever the criticisms, Weyl said in 1951, “I think everybody has to accept Brouwer’s critique who wants to hold on to the belief that mathematical propositions tell the sheer truth, truth based on evidence.”

直觉主义学说提出相关问题。如我们知道，他们认为人类心灵能构想且确实构想可靠、可接受的思想。思想不以文字形式产生；语言仅是不完美的传达手段。长期讨论的问题是：思想能否无词语而存在？一方可用《约翰福音》表达：“太初有道。”圣约翰虽非谈数学，却符合希腊哲学及某些现代心理学家。另一方，贝克莱主教认为词语妨碍思想。

The doctrines of the intuitionists have raised a related issue. They maintain, as we know, that sound and acceptable ideas can be and are conceived by the human mind. These ideas do not originate in verbal form. In fact, language is merely an imperfect device for communicating these ideas. The issue, which has been discussed at length, is whether thoughts can exist without words. On one side, there is the position which can be expressed as in the Gospel of St. John: “In the beginning there was the word.” Though St. John did not have mathematics in mind, his statement is in accord with the Greek philosophical position and the views of some modern psychologists. On the other hand, Bishop Berkeley contended that words are an impediment to thought.

欧拉致普鲁士腓特烈大帝侄女、安哈尔特—德绍公主的书信（1768—72出版），讨论此问题：

Euler in his letters to the Princess of Anhalt-Dessau, niece of Frederick the Great of Prussia (published 1768-72), discussed this question:

不论人多善于抽象、形成一般观念，没有口头或书面语言帮助，就不能大进步。两者含各种词语，只是对应观念的符号，意义由习惯或共同生活者的默契确定。

Whatever aptitude a man may have to exercise the power of abstraction, and to furnish himself with general ideas, he can make no considerable progress without the aid of language, spoken or written. Both the one and the other contain a variety of words, which are only certain signs corresponding to our ideas, and whose signification is settled by custom, or the tacit consent of several men who live together.

由此似乎语言唯一目的是互相传达情感，独居者可不用。但稍反思就信服：追寻和培养自己的思想，同与他人交流一样，需要语言。

It would appear from this, that the only purpose of language to mankind is mutually to communicate their sentiments, and that a solitary man might do well without it; but a little reflection only is necessary to be convinced that men stand in need of language, as much to pursue and cultivate their own thoughts as to keep up a communication with others.

雅克·阿达马在《数学领域的发明心理学》（1945）研究数学家如何思考，发现创造时几乎全都避免精确语言，使用视觉或触觉的模糊形象。爱因斯坦的信（转载于该书）表达这种方式：

Jacques Hadamard in The Psychology of Invention in the Mathematical Field (1945) investigated the question of how mathematicians think, and his findings were that in the creative process practically all mathematicians avoid the use of precise language; they use vague images, visual or tactile. This mode of thinking was expressed by Einstein in a letter reproduced in Hadamard’s book:

书写或口说的词语、语言，似乎在我的思维机制无作用……。似乎充当思维元素的物理实体，是某些符号和较清楚或较模糊、能有意重现组合的形象……。对我，上述元素是视觉的，有些是肌肉类型。仅在第二阶段，才须辛苦寻找惯常词语或其他符号……。

The words or the language, as they are written or spoken, do not seem to play any role in my mechanism of thought. . . . The physical entities which seem to serve as elements in thought are certain signs and more or less clear images which can be voluntarily reproduced and combined. . . . The above-mentioned elements are, in my case, visual and some of muscular type. Conventional words or other signs have to be sought for laboriously only in a secondary state. . . .

当然，视觉想象在创造中作用重大。无限直线把欧几里得平面分两部分，来自视觉想象。问题因此归结为：不论事实如何获得，心灵的信任是否能像直觉主义者坚持的那么确定，以致无需精确语言表达和逻辑证明？

Of course, visualization plays a major role in the creative act. That an infinite straight line divides the Euclidean plane into two parts derives from visualization. The issue then boils down to whether, as the intuitionists maintain, the mind’s confidence in a fact, however obtained, can be so certain as to render unnecessary the need for expression in precise language and logical proof.

为改善与形式逻辑学家交流，布劳威尔之后直觉主义主要阐释者阿伦德·海廷（1898—1980）1930年论文提出直觉主义命题逻辑形式规则，仅含古典形式逻辑一部分。例如，允许 p 真蕴涵“p 假”为假，但“p 假”为假，不推出 p 真，因为 p 断言的东西可能不可构造。不使用“p 或非 p 必真”的排中律。但若 p 蕴涵 q，则否定 q 蕴涵 p 假。直觉主义者不视形式化为根本，只是不完整地表示思想。此外，海廷不是唯一的形式化方案；他们对可接受逻辑原则意见不一。

As a gesture toward improving communication with formal logicians, Arend Heyting (1898-1980), the leading exponent of intuitionism after Brouwer, published a paper in 1930 setting forth formal rules of intuitionist propositional logic. These include only a part of classical formal logic. For instance, Heyting allowed that the truth of p implies that it is false that p is false. However, if it is false that p is false, it does not follow that p is true because what p asserts may not be constructible. The law of excluded middle—p or not p must be true—is not used. But if proposition p implies proposition q, then the denial of q implies that p is false. This formalization is not considered to be fundamental by the intuitionists. It is an incomplete representation of the ideas. Heyting’s formalization is, moreover, not the only one. The intuitionists differ among themselves about acceptable logical principles.

尽管直觉主义限制数学，也受批评，它有健康影响，使选择公理引发首次认真讨论的问题突出：数学存在何意？换用外尔的话，知道特殊性质的数存在，却无方法实现或计算，有用吗？天真地无限扩展排中律使用，确须重新考虑。最有价值的贡献或许是坚持计算那些仅靠不存在导致矛盾而确立存在的数或函数。亲密了解这些数，就像与朋友同住，区别于仅知道世界某处有朋友。

Despite the restrictions on mathematics intuitionists have imposed and the criticisms by others of the intuitionist philosophy, intuitionism has had a healthy influence. It has brought to the fore the question first seriously debated in connection with the axiom of choice. What does mathematical existence mean? Does it do any good, to paraphrase Weyl, to know that a number with special properties exists without any way of realizing or computing that number? The unrestricted, naive extension of the use of the law of excluded middle certainly calls for reconsideration. Of the contributions of intuitionism perhaps the most valuable is its insistence on calculating numbers or functions whose existence was established merely by showing that non-existence leads to a contradiction. To know these numbers intimately is like living with a friend as opposed to knowing that one has a friend somewhere in the world.

逻辑主义和直觉主义的对抗，只是确立恰当数学基础战争的开场。其他参战者加入，我们还须听他们的声音。

The confrontation of logicists and intuitionists was merely the opening battle in the war to establish the proper foundations of mathematics. Other contestants entered the fray and we have yet to hear from them.

第十一章　形式主义与集合论基础

XI. The Formalist and Set-Theoretic Foundations

因为与现代数学辽阔领域相比，直觉主义者所得可怜残余——几个孤立、不完备、不相联系的结果——算什么？

For, compared with the immense expanse of modern mathematics, what would the wretched remnants mean, the few isolated results incomplete and unrelated, that the intuitionists have obtained.

大卫·希尔伯特

David Hilbert

本世纪第一个十年发起、对恰当数学基础观点截然相反的逻辑主义与直觉主义哲学，仅是最初炮声。大卫·希尔伯特创立并领导第三个学派，称为形式主义；恩斯特·策梅洛发起第四个，即集合论学派。

The logicist and intuitionist philosophies, launched during the first decade of this century and diametrically opposed in their views on the proper foundations of mathematics, were just the first guns to be fired. A third school of thought, called formalist, was fashioned and led by David Hilbert, and a fourth, the set-theoretic school, was initiated by Ernst Zermelo.

希尔伯特在1900年国际大会上的演讲中（第八章），强调了证明数学一致性的重要性。他还要求找出实数的良序化方法；根据策梅洛的工作，我们知道良序化与选择公理等价。最后，希尔伯特还提议数学家着手证明连续统假设，即在ℵ0与c之间不存在超限数。甚至在这些棘手的悖论尚未为人所知、选择公理尚未引起争论之前，希尔伯特就已预见到，解决所有这些问题至关重要。

In his speech at the International Congress of 1900 (Chapter VIII), Hilbert stressed the importance of proving the consistency of mathematics. He had also called for a method of well-ordering the real numbers and we know, as a consequence of the work of Zermelo, that well-ordering is equivalent to the axiom of choice. Finally, Hilbert had also proposed that mathematicians undertake to prove the continuum hypothesis, which states that there is no transfinite number between ℵ0 and c. Even before the troublesome paradoxes became known and the controversy about the axiom of choice arose, Hilbert foresaw that solving all these problems was vital.

希尔伯特本人在1904年第三届国际大会上，提出了他研究数学基础的方案梗概，其中包括证明一致性的方法。不过，此后一段时期他并没有开展更深入的工作。在接下来的十五年中，逻辑主义者和直觉主义者广泛传播自己的学说，而希尔伯特对他们解决困扰数学基础的问题的办法，客气地说，是不满意的。

Hilbert himself presented a sketch of his approach to the foundations, including a method of proving consistency, at the Third International Congress of 1904. However, he did not undertake more serious work for some time. During the next fifteen years, the logicists and intuitionists spread their doctrines widely, and Hilbert was, to put it mildly, dissatisfied with their solutions to the problems besetting the foundations.

他相当平静地否定了逻辑主义纲领。正如他在1904年的演讲和论文中所说，他的根本异议在于：逻辑漫长而复杂的发展其实已经涉及整数，尽管没有这样称呼它们。因此，把数建立在逻辑之上就是循环论证。他还批评用性质来定义集合：这就必须按类型来区分命题和命题函数，而类型论又需要可疑的可归约性公理。他确实赞同罗素和怀特海，认为应当纳入无限集合。但这需要无穷公理；希尔伯特和其他人一样，认为它不是逻辑公理。

The logistic program he dismissed rather calmly. His fundamental objection, as he put it in his 1904 talk and paper, was that in the long and complicated development of logic, the whole numbers were already involved even though not named as such. Hence to build number on logic was circular reasoning. He also criticized defining sets by their properties: this necessitated distinguishing propositions and propositional functions by types and type theory required the questionable axiom of reducibility. He did agree with Russell and Whitehead that infinite sets should be included. But this required the axiom of infinity and Hilbert like others argued that this is not an axiom of logic.

另一方面，直觉主义者的哲学使希尔伯特感到震惊，因为他们不仅拒绝无限集合，而且拒绝分析的广大部分，例如那些依赖纯粹存在性证明的内容。他猛烈抨击他们的哲学。1922年，他说直觉主义“企图拆散并毁坏数学”。在1927年的一篇论文中，他抗议道：“夺走数学家的排中律，就如同禁止天文学家使用望远镜，或禁止拳击手使用拳头。否认用排中律推导出的存在性定理，无异于彻底放弃数学这门科学。”

The philosophy of the intuitionists, on the other hand, alarmed Hilbert because they rejected not only infinite sets but also vast portions of analysis such as those that depended on pure existence proofs, and he attacked their philosophy vehemently. In 1922, he said that intuitionism “seeks to break up and disfigure mathematics.” In a paper of 1927, he protested that “Taking the principle of excluded middle from the mathematician would be the same, say, as proscribing the telescope to the astronomer or to the boxer the use of his fists. To deny existence theorems derived by using the principle of excluded middle is tantamount to relinquishing the science of mathematics altogether.

外尔在1927年谈到希尔伯特对直觉主义的立场时说：“从这种［直觉主义］观点来看，古典数学中只有一部分，也许只是可怜的一小部分，能够成立，这是一个痛苦却不可避免的事实。希尔伯特无法忍受这种肢解。”

Weyl said in 1927, apropos of Hilbert’s position on intuitionism, “that from this [intuitionist] point of view only a part, perhaps only a wretched part, of classical mathematics is tenable is a bitter but inevitable fact. Hilbert could not bear this mutilation.”

希尔伯特反对逻辑主义和直觉主义，认为二者都没有证明一致性。在1927年的论文中，希尔伯特大声说道：

Against both logicism and intuitionism, Hilbert held that neither proved consistency. In the 1927 paper, Hilbert exclaimed:

为了给它［数学］奠定基础，我不需要像克罗内克那样求助于上帝，也不需要像庞加莱那样假定一种适应数学归纳法原理的特殊理解能力［庞加莱曾说，使用数学归纳法的体系的一致性无法证明］，不需要布劳威尔的原始直觉，最后也不需要像罗素和怀特海那样诉诸无穷公理、可归约性公理或完备性公理；这些的确是具有实际内容的重要命题，却无法通过一致性证明来确立。

To found it [mathematics] I do not need God, as does Kronecker, or the assumption of a special faculty of understanding attuned to the principle of mathematical induction, as does Poincare [who had said that the consistency of a system using mathematical induction could not be proved], or the primal intuition of Brouwer, or finally, as do Russell and Whitehead, axioms of infinity, reducibility, or completeness which are indeed real and substantial propositions, but not capable of being established through a proof of consistency.

在20世纪20年代，希尔伯特形成了自己研究数学基础的方案，并为此工作终身。在他于20年代和30年代初发表的论文中，1925年的论文最能代表他的思想。*他在这篇《论无穷》中说：“我的理论的目标，是一劳永逸地确立数学方法的确定性。”

During the 1920s Hilbert formulated his own approach to the foundations and he worked on it for the rest of his life. Of the papers Hilbert published during the 1920s and early 1930s, the paper of 1925 is the major one for his ideas.* He said in this paper, “On the Infinite,” “the goal of my theory is to establish once and for all the certitude of mathematical methods.”

他的第一个论点是：既然逻辑的发展实际上涉及数学观念，而且要保留古典数学，无论如何都必须引进无穷公理这类逻辑之外的公理，那么研究数学的正确方法就必须同时包含逻辑和数学的概念与公理。此外，逻辑必须作用于某些东西，而这些东西就是数之类的逻辑之外的具体概念，它们在任何逻辑发展开始之前，就已经存在于直觉中。

The first of his theses is that, since the development of logic really involves mathematical ideas and since extra-logical axioms such as the axiom of infinity must be introduced anyway if classical mathematics is to be preserved, the correct approach to mathematics must include concepts and axioms of both logic and mathematics. Moreover, logic must operate on something and that something consists of certain extra-logical concrete concepts, such as number, which are present in intuition before any logical development can be undertaken.

希尔伯特所采用的逻辑公理与罗素的并无本质差异，不过，他采用的公理较多，因为他并不那么关注为逻辑建立公理基础。然而，按照希尔伯特的看法，既然不能仅由逻辑推出数学——数学不是逻辑的结果，而是一门独立的学科——每个分支就都必须具有适当的逻辑公理和数学公理。此外，处理数学最可靠的办法，是不把它看作事实知识，而看作一门形式学科，即抽象的、符号化的、不涉及意义的学科（尽管在非形式的层面，意义以及与现实的关系确实会进入）。推演应当是按照逻辑原则进行的符号操作。

The logical axioms that Hilbert assumed are not essentially different from Russell’s, though Hilbert assumed more because he was not as concerned with establishing an axiomatic basis for logic. However, because, according to Hilbert, one cannot deduce mathematics from logic alone—mathematics is not a consequence of logic but an autonomous discipline—each branch must have the appropriate axioms of both logic and mathematics. Moreover, the most reliable way to treat mathematics is to regard it not as factual knowledge but as a formal discipline, that is, abstract, symbolic, and without reference to meaning (though, informally, meaning and relation to reality do enter). Deductions are to be manipulations of symbols according to logical principles.

*译文可见保罗·贝纳塞拉夫与希拉里·普特南编：《数学哲学》，普伦蒂斯－霍尔出版社，1964年，第134—181页。

*A translation can be found in Paul Benacerraf and Hilary Putnam: Philosophy of Mathematics, Prentice Hall, 1964, 134-81.

因此，为了避免语言的歧义以及无意识地使用直觉知识——这是某些悖论的根源——为了消除其他悖论，并实现证明的精确性和客观性，希尔伯特决定，逻辑和数学的一切陈述都必须用符号形式表达。这些符号虽可能代表在直觉上具有意义的感知，但在他提出的形式数学中，不应赋予它们解释。有些符号甚至代表无限集合，因为希尔伯特希望把无限集合包括进来，但这些符号没有直觉意义。他称之为理想元素，构建全部数学都需要它们，因此引入它们是合理的，尽管他相信现实世界中只存在有限多个对象。物质由有限多个元素组成。

Hence to avoid ambiguities of language and unconscious use of intuitive knowledge, which are the cause of some of the paradoxes, to eliminate other paradoxes, and to achieve precision of proof and objectivity, Hilbert decided that all statements of logic and mathematics must be expressed in symbolic form. These symbols, though they may represent intuitively meaningful perceptions, are not to be interpreted in the formal mathematics that he proposed. Some symbols would even represent infinite sets since Hilbert wished to include them, but these have no intuitive meaning. These ideal elements, as he called them, are needed to build all of mathematics and so their introduction is justified, though Hilbert believed that in the real world only a finite number of objects exist. Matter is composed of a finite number of elements.

可以通过一个类比理解希尔伯特这里的论证。无理数作为数，并没有直觉意义。尽管我们可以引入度量为无理数的长度，但长度本身并未给无理数提供任何直觉意义。然而，无理数作为理想元素，甚至对初等数学也是必需的；这就是数学家直到19世纪70年代之前，在没有任何逻辑基础的情况下仍然使用它们的原因。希尔伯特对复数，即涉及−1的数，也提出了同样的看法。复数在现实中没有直接的对应物。然而，它们使一般性定理成为可能，例如每个n次多项式方程恰有n个根；它们还使整个复变函数理论成为可能，而这一理论甚至在物理研究中也已证明极其有用。无论符号是否代表直觉上有意义的对象，表示概念和运算的一切记号与符号都被剥离了意义。从奠基的角度看，数学思维的元素就是符号，以及作为符号组合或符号串的命题。因此，形式主义者试图付出代价来换取确定性，代价就是与无意义的符号打交道。

Hilbert’s argument here can be understood by considering an analogy. The irrational number has no intuitive meaning as a number. Even though we can introduce lengths whose measures are irrational, the lengths themselves do not furnish any intuitive meaning for irrational numbers. Yet irrationals, as ideal elements, are necessary even for elementary mathematics and this is why mathematicians used them even without any logical basis until the 1870s. Hilbert made the same point with respect to complex numbers, that is, numbers involving −1. These have no real immediate counterparts. Yet they make possible general theorems, such as that every polynomial equation of the nth degree has exactly n roots, as well as an entire theory of functions of a complex variable, which has proved immensely useful even in physical investigations. Whether or not the symbols represent intuitively meaningful objects, all signs and symbols of concepts and operations are freed of meaning. For the purpose of foundations the elements of mathematical thought are the symbols and the propositions, which are combinations or strings of symbols. Thus the formalists sought to buy certainty at a price, the price of dealing with meaningless symbols.

幸运的是，逻辑符号体系在19世纪末和20世纪初已经发展起来（第八章），所以希尔伯特手头已有所需的工具。例如，表示“非”的~，表示“且”的•，表示“或”的∨，表示“蕴涵”的→，表示“存在”的∃，都是现成的。它们是未定义的、原始的概念。至于数学本身，符号体系当然早就具备了。

Luckily, the symbolism for logic had been developed during the late nineteenth and early twentieth centuries (Chapter VIII) and so Hilbert had on hand what he needed. Thus, symbols such as ~ for “not,” • for “and,” ∨ for “or,” -> for “implies,” and ∃ for “there exists” were available. These were undefined or primitive concepts. For mathematics proper the symbolism had, of course, long been available.

希尔伯特选择的逻辑公理，旨在实际推出亚里士多德逻辑的全部原则。这些公理是否可以接受，几乎不容置疑。例如，X、Y、Z为命题时，一条公理说X蕴涵X∨Y，用语言来说就是：如果X为真，那么X或Y为真。另一条公理用语言表达，相当于说：如果X蕴涵Y，那么Z或X蕴涵Z或Y。一条基本公理是蕴涵规则，也叫推理规则。这条公理说：如果公式A为真，而且公式A蕴涵公式B，那么公式B为真。在亚里士多德逻辑中，这条逻辑原则称为肯定前件式。希尔伯特还希望使用排中律，并引入了一种技术手段，以符号形式表达这一定律。同一手段也被用于表达选择公理，后者当然是一条数学公理。这种手段避免了明确使用“所有”一词，希尔伯特由此期望避免任何悖论。

The axioms of logic that Hilbert chose were intended to yield in effect all the principles of Aristotelian logic. One could hardly question the acceptability of these axioms. For example, where X, Y, and Z are propositions, one axiom states that X implies X ∨ Y, which verbally means that, if X is true, then X or Y is true. Another, in verbal form, amounts to the statement that, if X implies Y, then Z or X implies Z or Y. A fundamental axiom is the rule of implication or rule of inference. The axiom states that, if formula A is true and if formula A implies formula B, then formula B is true. This principle of logic is called the modus ponens in Aristotelian logic. Hilbert also wished to use the law of excluded middle, and he introduced a technical device which expresses this law in symbolic form. This same device was used to express the axiom of choice, which is, of course, a mathematical axiom. It avoided the explicit use of the word “all” and thereby Hilbert expected to avoid any paradoxes.

按照希尔伯特的纲领，在处理数的数学分支中，有数的公理。例如，有一条公理是a=b蕴涵a′=b′，它说，如果两个整数a与b相等，那么它们的后继数（直觉上，就是紧接其后的整数）也相等。数学归纳法公理也包括在内。一般来说，公理至少与有关自然现象的经验，或与已有的数学知识领域相关。

In the branch of mathematics dealing with number, there are, in accordance with Hilbert’s program, axioms of number. As an illustration, there is the axiom a = b implies a′ = b′ and this states that, if two integers a and b are equal, then their successors (intuitively, the next integers) are also equal. The axiom of mathematical induction is also included. Generally the axioms are at least relevant to experience with natural phenomena or to the world of mathematical knowledge already in existence.

如果形式体系要表示集合论，就必须包含以符号形式陈述哪些集合可以形成的公理。因此，这些公理允许形成两个集合之和的集合，以及一个给定集合的所有子集构成的集合。

If the formal system is to represent set theory, it must contain axioms (in symbolic form) stating which sets can be formed. Thus the axioms permit forming the set which is the sum of two sets and the set of all subsets of a given set.

所有逻辑公理和数学公理都表示成公式或符号的汇集以后，希尔伯特就可以说明他所谓的客观证明是什么了。它由如下过程构成：断言某个公式；断言这个公式蕴涵另一个公式；断言第二个公式。由这类步骤构成的序列，其中最后被断言的公式是先前公理或结论所蕴涵的，就构成一个定理的证明。此外，用一个符号或一组符号替代另一个符号，也是允许的操作。因此，公式是通过应用逻辑公理，对先前已经确立的公式或公理中的符号进行操作而推导出来的。

With all logical and mathematical axioms expressed as formulas or collections of symbols, Hilbert was prepared to state what he meant by objective proof. It consists of the following process: the assertion of some formula; the assertion that this formula implies another; the assertion of the second formula. A sequence of such steps in which the final asserted formula is the implication of preceding axioms or conclusions constitutes the proof of a theorem. Also, substitution of one symbol or a group of symbols for another is a permissible operation. Thus, formulas are derived by applying the logical axioms to the manipulation of the symbols of previously established formulas or axioms.

一个公式为真，当且仅当它能够成为一个公式序列中的最后一个公式，而序列中的每个公式，要么是形式体系中的公理，要么是按某条推演规则推导出来的。人人都能检查一个给定公式是否通过恰当的推导序列得到，因为证明本质上是对符号的机械操作。因此，在形式主义的观点下，证明和严密性都具有明确的定义，并且是客观的。

A formula is true if and only if it can be obtained as the last of a sequence of formulas such that every formula of the sequence is either an axiom in the formal system or is itself derived by one of the rules of deduction. Everyone can check whether a given formula has been obtained by a proper sequence of derivations because the proof is essentially a mechanical manipulation of symbols. Thus, under the formalist view, proof and rigor are well defined and objective.

因此，在形式主义者看来，数学本身是一批形式体系，每个体系都在构建自身数学的同时构建自身的逻辑，各有自己的概念、自己的公理、自己推导定理的规则以及自己的定理。发展这些演绎体系中的每一个，就是数学的任务。

To the formalist, then, mathematics proper is a collection of formal systems, each building its own logic along with its mathematics, each having its own concepts, its own axioms, its own rules for deducing theorems, and its own theorems. The development of each of these deductive systems is the task of mathematics.

这就是希尔伯特构建数学本身的纲领。然而，从公理推导出的结论是否没有矛盾呢？先前对数学主要分支的一致性证明，都是在假定算术一致的前提下给出的——事实上，希尔伯特本人已经证明，欧几里得几何的一致性可以归结为算术的一致性——因此，算术的一致性成了关键问题。正如希尔伯特所说：“在几何学和物理理论中，一致性证明是通过把它归结为算术的一致性而完成的。这一方法用于算术本身的证明时，显然行不通。”因此，希尔伯特寻求的是绝对一致性的证明，而非相对一致性的证明。这也就是他专注的问题。他对此说，我们不能冒险在未来再次遭遇像20世纪初那样令人不快的意外。

This was Hilbert’s program for the construction of mathematics proper. However, are the conclusions derivable from the axioms free of contradictions? Since prior proofs of consistency of major branches of mathematics had been given on the assumption that arithmetic is consistent—indeed Hilbert himself had shown that the consistency of Euclidean geometry reduces to the consistency of arithmetic—the consistency of the latter became the crucial question. As Hilbert put it, “In geometry and physical theory the proof of consistency is accomplished by reducing it to the consistency of arithmetic. This method obviously fails in the proof for arithmetic itself.” What Hilbert sought then is a proof of absolute as opposed to relative consistency. And this is the issue on which he concentrated. He said in this connection that we cannot risk unpleasant surprises in the future such as occurred in the early 1900s.

一致性是无法观察到的。人不可能预见公理的全部后果。不过，希尔伯特和几乎所有关注数学基础的数学家一样，使用实质蕴涵的概念（第八章）；按这个概念，一个假命题蕴涵任何命题。如果存在矛盾，那么按照矛盾律，两个命题中必有一个为假；而如果有一个假命题，它就蕴涵1=0。因此，要确立一致性，只须证明永远不能得出1=0这个陈述。希尔伯特在1925年的文章中说，这样，“我们已经经历两次的事情，先是无穷小微积分的悖论，后来是集合论的悖论，就不可能发生第三次，而且永远不会再发生。”

Now, consistency cannot be observed. One cannot foresee all the implications of the axioms. However, Hilbert, like almost all mathematicians concerned with foundations, used the concept of material implication (Chapter VIII) in accordance with which a false proposition implies any proposition. If there is a contradiction, then according to the law of contradiction one of the two propositions must be false and if there is a false proposition, it implies that 1 = 0. Therefore, all one needed in order to establish consistency was to show that one could never arrive at the statement 1 = 0. Then, said Hilbert in his article of 1925, “What we have experienced twice, first with the paradoxes of the infinitesimal calculus and then with the paradoxes of set theory, cannot happen a third time and will never happen again.” '

1920至1930年间，希尔伯特及其学生威廉·阿克曼（1896—1962）、保罗·贝尔奈斯（1888—1978）和约翰·冯·诺伊曼（1903—1957），逐步发展出一种确立任何形式体系一致性的方法，称为希尔伯特的Beweistheorie［证明论］，或元数学。元数学的基本观念可以通过一个类比来理解。如果要研究日语的有效性或完备程度，用日语进行研究就会妨碍分析，因为分析可能受制于日语的局限。不过，如果英语是一种有效的语言，就可以用英语来研究日语。

Hilbert and his students Wilhelm Ackermann (1896-1962), Paul Bernays (1888-1978), and John von Neumann (1903-1957) gradually evolved, during the years from 1920 to 1930, what is known as Hilbert’s Beweistbeorie [proof theory] or metamathematics, a method of establishing the consistency of any formal system. The basic idea of metamathematics may be understood through an analogy. If one wished to study the effectiveness or comprehensiveness of the Japanese language, to do so in Japanese would handicap the analysis because it might be subject to the limitations of Japanese. However, if English is an effective language, one might use English to study Japanese.

在元数学中，希尔伯特提出使用一种不应受到任何异议的特殊逻辑。逻辑原则应当显然为真，以至人人都会接受。实际上，这些原则十分接近直觉主义原则。有争议的推理——例如用反证法证明存在性、超限归纳法、实无限集合、非直谓定义以及选择公理——都不应使用。存在性证明必须是构造性的。由于形式体系可以没有终点，元数学必须容纳至少涉及潜无限体系的概念和问题。不过，既不应涉及无限多个公式的结构性质，也不应涉及无限多次公式操作。可以允许考虑那些符号代表实无限集合的公式，但这些仅仅是公式中的符号。对自然数（正整数）进行数学归纳是允许的，因为它证明命题一直成立到任意有限的n，却不必被理解为证明命题对自然数的整个无限集合成立。

In metamathematics, Hilbert proposed to use a special logic that was to be free of all objections. The logical principles would be so obviously true that everyone would accept them. Actually, they were very close to the intuitionist principles. Controversial reasoning—such as proof of existence by contradiction, transfinite induction, actually infinite sets, impredicative definitions, and the axiom of choice—was not to be used. Existence proofs must be constructive. Since a formal system can be unending, metamathematics must entertain concepts and questions involving at least potentially infinite systems. However, there should be no reference either to an infinite number of structural properties of formulas or to an infinite number of manipulations of formulas. One can permit the consideration of formulas in which the symbols stand for actually infinite sets. But these are merely symbols within formulas. Mathematical induction over the natural numbers (positive whole numbers) is allowable because it proves a proposition up to any finite n but need not be understood to prove the proposition for the entire infinite set of natural numbers.

他把元数学证明的概念和方法称为有穷的。对于“有穷”究竟是什么意思，希尔伯特的说明有些含糊。在1925年的论文中，他举了下面的例子。“如果p是素数，就存在比p更大的素数”这个陈述是非有穷的，因为它断言的是所有大于p的整数。然而，“如果p是素数，那么p与p!+1（p的阶乘加一）之间存在一个素数”这个断言是有穷的，因为对任何素数p，我们只需检查p与p!+1之间有限多个数中，是否有素数。

The concepts and methods of metamathematical proof he called finitary. Hilbert was somewhat vague about what finitary means. In his 1925 paper, he gave the following example. The statement “if p is a prime, there exists a prime larger than p” is non-finitary because it is an assertion about all the integers larger than p. However, the assertion “that if p is a prime, there exists a prime between p and p! + 1 (p factorial plus one)” is finitary because, for any prime p, all we have to check is whether there is a prime among the finite number of numbers between p and p! + 1.

在1934年与保罗·贝尔奈斯合著的一本书中，希尔伯特这样描述“有穷”：

In a book he published in 1934 with Paul Bernays, Hilbert described finitary thus:

我们将始终使用“有穷”一词，表示所讨论的论述、断言或定义，被限制在对象完全可以产生、过程完全可以实行的范围之内，因此可以在具体检视的领域内完成。

We shall always use the word “finitary” to indicate that the discussion, assertion, or definition in question is kept within the bounds of thorough-going producibility of objects and thorough-going practicability of processes, and may accordingly be carried out within the domain of concrete inspection.

元数学将使用直觉数学或非形式数学的语言，并在无可争议之处借助一些符号。

Metamathematics would use the language of intuitive or informal mathematics with the help, where unquestionable, of some symbolism.

在1928年的国际数学家大会上谈到自己的元数学纲领时，希尔伯特自信地宣称：“有了这一可以恰当地称为证明论的数学新基础，我相信我能够把所有基础问题从世界上驱逐出去。”他尤其确信自己能够解决一致性问题和完备性问题。也就是说，所有有意义的陈述都将被证明或被否证，不会有不可判定的命题。

Speaking of his metamathematical program at the International Congress of Mathematicians (1928), Hilbert asserted confidently, “With this new foundation of mathematics, which one can properly call a proof theory, I believe I can banish from the world all the foundational problems.” In particular he was sure he could settle consistency and the completeness problem. That is, all meaningful statements would be proven or disproven. There would no undecidable propositions.

可以预料，形式主义纲领会受到竞争者的批评。罗素在《数学原则》第二版（1937年）中提出异议：形式主义者使用的算术公理，并没有确定符号0、1、2、……的意义。完全也可以从我们直觉上所说的100、101、102、……开始。因此，“有十二位使徒”这个陈述，在形式主义中没有意义。“形式主义者就像一位钟表匠，专心致志地把钟表做得漂亮，却忘记了钟表报时的用途，因此根本没有装进机芯。”逻辑主义对数的定义使它与现实世界的联系可以理解；形式主义理论却做不到。

One might anticipate that the formalist program would be criticized by its rivals. In the second edition of The Principles of Mathematics (1937), Russell objected that the axioms of arithmetic used by the formalists do not pin down the meaning of the symbols 0, 1, 2, •••. One could as well start with what we intuitively mean by 100, 101, 102, •••. Hence the statement “There were 12 Apostles” has no meaning in formalism. “The formalists are like a watchmaker who is so absorbed in making his watches look pretty that he has forgotten their purpose of telling the time, and has therefore omitted to insert any works.” The logicist definition of number makes the connection with the actual world intelligible; the formalist theory does not.

罗素还抨击了形式主义的存在概念。希尔伯特接受了无限集合及其他理想元素，并说，如果某个分支的公理——包括排中律和矛盾律——不导致矛盾，那么满足这些公理的实体的存在就得到了保证。罗素把这种存在观称为形而上学的。此外，罗素说，人们可能创造的无矛盾公理体系，种类没有限度。他接着说，我们关心的是那些能够应用于经验材料的体系。

Russell also struck at the formalist concept of existence. Hilbert had accepted infinite sets and other ideal elements, and had said that if the axioms of any one branch, which included the law of excluded middle and the law of contradiction, do not lead to a contradiction, the existence of the entities that satisfy the axioms is assured. Russell called this notion of existence metaphysical. Moreover, Russell said, there is no limit to the variety of non-contradictory systems of axioms that might be invented. We are, he continued, interested in systems that have application to empirical material.

罗素的批评令人想起五十步笑百步。到1937年，他已经忘记了自己最初在1901年写下的话：“数学可以定义为这样一门学科：我们在其中从不知道自己谈论的是什么，也不知道自己所说的是否为真。”

Russell’s criticisms remind one of the pot calling the kettle black. He had forgotten by 1937 what he had first written in 1901: “Mathematics may be defined as the subject in which we never know what we are talking about nor whether what we are saying is true.”

直觉主义者无法接受形式主义纲领。除在无穷和排中律上存在根本分歧之外，直觉主义者仍然强调，他们依靠数学的意义来判断数学是否可靠，而形式主义者（以及逻辑主义者）却在处理没有意义的理想世界或超越世界。布劳威尔早在1908年就已指出，在古典分析的某些基本断言中，逻辑与意义存在明显矛盾，其中就有波尔查诺－魏尔斯特拉斯定理（一个颇为技术性的定理，断言有界无限集合至少有一个聚点）。布劳威尔说，当排中律被用于超出有限可验证范围的论证时，我们必须在正整数的先验概念与自由使用排中律之间作出选择。自由使用亚里士多德逻辑，会导致形式上有效却没有意义的断言。古典数学在许多逻辑构造中放弃意义，也就放弃了现实。

The formalist program was unacceptable to the intuitionists. Beyond basic differences on infinity and the law of excluded middle, the intuitionists continued to stress that they relied on the meaning of the mathematics to determine its soundness, whereas the formalists (and the logicists) dealt with ideal or transcendental worlds which had no meaning. Brouwer in 1908 had already shown that logic and meaning were in blatant contradiction in some of the basic assertions of classical analysis, among them the Bolzano-Weierstrass theorem (a rather technical theorem that a bounded infinite set has at least one limit point). We must choose, Brouwer said, between our a priori concept of the positive integers and the free use of the principle of excluded middle when the latter is applied to any argument beyond what is finitely verifiable. The free use of Aristotelian logic led to formally valid but meaningless assertions. Classical mathematics abandons reality by abandoning meaning in many logical constructs.

布劳威尔的批判使许多人认识到，先前从未受到质疑的一种信念是错误的：数学的伟大理论真实地表达了某种潜在的现实内容。人们原以为这些理论是本质上真实的事物或现象的理想化。然而，尤其在19世纪，古典分析的很大一部分已经远远超出了任何直觉意义；此外，其逻辑在直觉主义者看来也不令人满意。接受布劳威尔的观点，就意味着以缺乏直觉意义为由，拒绝大量古典数学。

Brouwer’s critique caused many people to recognize the falsity of the previously unquestioned belief that the great theories of mathematics are a true expression of some underlying real content. They supposedly were idealizations of essentially real things or phenomena. However, in the nineteenth century especially, much of classical analysis had gone far beyond any intuitive meaning, apart from its logical unsatisfactoriness to the intuitionists. To accept Brouwer is to reject a great deal of classical mathematics on the ground that it lacks intuitive meaning.

今天的直觉主义者说，即使希尔伯特真的完成了形式化数学的一致性证明，这种理论，即形式化数学，仍然没有意义。外尔抱怨，希尔伯特“通过彻底重新解释其意义”“挽救”了古典数学，也就是把它形式化，实际上夺走它的意义，“从而在原则上把它从一个直觉结果的体系变成一种按固定规则进行的公式游戏”。“希尔伯特的数学或许是一种漂亮的公式游戏，甚至比国际象棋更有趣；但它与认识有什么关系呢？既然其公式公认没有实际意义，而只有凭借这种意义，它们才可能表达直觉真理。”为形式主义哲学辩护，必须指出：数学被化为无意义的公式，仅仅是为了证明一致性、完备性以及其他性质。至于整个数学，甚至形式主义者也不接受它只是游戏的观点；他们把数学视为一门客观的科学。

The intuitionists say today that, even if Hilbert’s proof of the consistency of formalized mathematics were to be made, the theory, the formalized mathematics, is pointless. Weyl complained that Hilbert “saved” classical mathematics “by a radical reinterpretation of its meaning,” that is, by formalizing it and really robbing it of meaning, “thus transforming it in principle from a system of intuitive results into a game with formulas that proceeds according to fixed rules.” “Hilbert’s mathematics may be a pretty game with formulas, more amusing even than chess; but what bearing does it have on cognition, since its formulas admittedly have no material meaning by virtue of which they could express intuitive truths?” In defense of the formalist philosophy, one must point out that it is only for the purposes of proving consistency, completeness, and other properties that mathematics is reduced to meaningless formulas. As for mathematics as a whole, even the formalists reject the idea that it is simply a game; they regard it as an objective science.

和罗素一样，直觉主义者也反对形式主义的存在概念。希尔伯特坚持认为，任何实体的存在，都由引入该实体的数学分支的一致性保证。直觉主义者不能接受这种存在观。一致性并不能确保纯粹存在性定理为真。伊曼努尔·康德两百年前在《纯粹理性批判》中就已提出这个论点：“以概念的逻辑可能性（即概念本身不矛盾）代替事物的先验可能性（即有一个对象与概念对应），只能欺骗头脑简单的人，并使他们感到满足。”

Like Russell, the intuitionists objected to the formalist concept of existence. Hilbert had maintained that the existence of any entity was guaranteed by the consistency of the branch of mathematics in which it is introduced. This notion of existence is unacceptable to the intuitionists. Consistency does not ensure the truth of purely existential theorems. The argument had already been made two hundred years ago by Immanuel Kant in his Critique of Pure Reason: For to substitute the logical possibility of the concept (namely, that the concept does not contradict itself) for the transcendental possibility of things (namely, that an object corresponds to the concept) can deceive and leave satisfied only the simple-minded.”

20世纪20年代，形式主义者与直觉主义者之间展开了激烈的论战。1923年，布劳威尔猛烈抨击形式主义者。他说，公理化、形式主义的处理当然可能避免矛盾，但这样不会得到任何具有数学价值的东西。“一个错误的理论，即使不能用任何足以驳倒它的矛盾加以否定，仍然是错误的；正如犯罪行为，不论有无法庭能够阻止它，仍然是犯罪。”在1912年阿姆斯特丹大学的一次演讲中，他还讽刺地说：“对于数学严密性应当到哪里寻找这个问题，双方给出不同的答案。直觉主义者说，在人的理智中；形式主义者说，在纸上。”

A fiery dialogue between the formalists and intuitionists took place in the 1920s. In 1923, Brouwer blasted away at the formalists. Of course, he said, axiomatic, formalistic treatments may avoid contradictions, but nothing of mathematical value will be obtained in this way. An incorrect theory, even if it cannot be rejected by any contradiction that would refute it, is nevertheless incorrect, just as a criminal act is nonetheless criminal whether or not any court could prevent it.” Sarcastically he also remarked in an address of 1912 at the University of Amsterdam, “To the question, where shall mathematical rigor be found, the two parties give different answers. The intuitionist says, in the human intellect; the formalist says, on paper.”

希尔伯特则反过来指责布劳威尔和外尔，企图把一切不合他们心意的东西扔掉，并以独裁的方式颁布禁令。在1925年的论文中，他称直觉主义为对科学的背叛。然而，正如外尔指出的，他在自己的元数学中，却把原则限制在本质上属于直觉主义的原则之内。

Hilbert in turn charged Brouwer and Weyl with trying to throw overboard everything that did not suit them and dictatorially promulgating an embargo. In his paper of 1925, he called intuitionism a treason against science. Yet in his metamathematjcs, as Weyl pointed out, he limited his principles to essentially intuitionistic ones.

对形式主义的另一项批评，针对的是元数学的原则。这些原则据说应该人人都能接受，但作出选择的却是形式主义者。为什么他们的直觉应当成为试金石？为什么不采用直觉主义对整个数学的处理方法？一个方法是否可以在元数学中使用，最终检验当然在于它是否令人信服，可是，要令谁信服呢？

Still another criticism of formalism is addressed to the principles of metamathematics. They are supposed to be acceptable to all. But the formalists did the choosing. Why should their intuition be the touchstone? Why not the intuitionist approach to all of mathematics? The ultimate test of whether a method is admissible in metamathematics must of course be whether it is convincing, but convincing to whom?

虽然形式主义者无法回应所有批评，但到1930年，他们已有一项有力的论据支持自己。这时，罗素和其他逻辑主义者已经同意，逻辑公理不是真理，因此一致性并无保证；直觉主义者也只能主张，他们的直觉的可靠性保证一致性。另一方面，形式主义者却有一套经过深思熟虑的程序来确立一致性，而且在简单体系上的成功，使他们相信能够成功证明算术的一致性，从而证明整个数学的一致性。因此，让我们暂且把他们留在这个相对有利的位置，转而考察另一种与之竞争的数学基础研究方案。

Though the formalists could not meet all the criticisms, they had, as of 1930, one weighty argument in their favor. By this time Russell and his fellow logicists had agreed that the axioms of logic were not truths, so that consistency was not assured, and the intuitionists could maintain only that the soundness of their intuitions guaranteed consistency. The formalists, on the other hand, had a well-thought-through procedure for establishing consistency, and successes with simple systems made them confident that they would succeed with the consistency of arithmetic and thereby all of mathematics. Let us therefore leave them in this relatively advantageous position to consider another rival approach to the foundations of mathematics.

集合论学派的成员最初并未提出一种独特的哲学，但他们逐渐获得了追随者，并形成了明确的纲领。今天完全可以说，这个学派在争取数学家的支持方面，与迄今所描述的三个学派中的任何一个，都同样具有竞争力。

The members of the set-theoretic school did not at the outset formulate a distinct philosophy, but they gradually gained adherents and an explicit program. Today certainly this school may be said to compete as much for favor among mathematicians as any of the three we have thus far described.

集合论学派的起源，可以追溯到戴德金和康托尔的工作。虽然他们主要关注无限集合，但他们也都开始以集合概念为基础，建立甚至普通整数（自然数）的理论。当然，一旦整数建立起来，全部数学就都可以由此推出（第八章）。

One can trace the beginnings of a set-theoretic school to the work of Dedekind and Cantor. Though both were primarily concerned with infinite sets, both also started to found even the ordinary whole numbers (the natural numbers) on the basis of set concepts. Of course, once the whole numbers were established, all of mathematics could then be derived (Chapter VIII).

当康托尔集合论本身的矛盾——最大基数和最大序数的矛盾——以及罗素悖论、理查德悖论等涉及集合的矛盾为人所知时，一些数学家认为，这些悖论源于以相当不正式的方式引入集合。康托尔大胆引入了激进的观念，但其表述颇为松散。他在1884年、1887年和1895年，给出了各种用语言表达的集合定义。他的集合观，实质上是我们直觉或思维中任何确定的、可区分的对象的汇集。另一种定义是：如果对每个对象x，我们都知道它是否属于某个集合，那么这个集合就被定义了。这些定义含糊不清，康托尔对集合论的整个表述，今天常被称为朴素集合论。因此，集合论者认为，经过仔细选择的公理基础会消除集合论的悖论，正如几何和数系的公理化解决了那些领域中的逻辑问题一样。

When the contradictions in Cantor’s set theory proper, those of the largest cardinal and the largest ordinal, and the contradictions such as Russell’s and Richard’s, which involve sets, became known, some mathematicians believed that these paradoxes were due to the rather informal introduction of sets. Cantor had boldly introduced radical ideas but his presentation was rather loose. He gave various verbal definitions of a set in 1884,1887, and 1895. His notion of a set was essentially any collection of definite, distinguishable objects of our intuition or thought. Alternatively, a set was defined whenever, for each object x, we know whether or not x belongs to the set. These definitions are vague and Cantor’s entire presentation of set theory is often described today as naive. Hence the set-theorists thought that a carefully selected axiomatic foundation would remove the paradoxes of set theory, just as the axiomatization of geometry and of the number system had resolved logical problems in those areas.

虽然逻辑主义的数学研究方案中包含集合论，但集合论者更愿意直接通过公理研究它。集合论的公理化，最先由恩斯特·策梅洛在1908年的一篇论文中开展。他也认为，悖论产生的原因是康托尔没有限制集合的概念。因此，策梅洛希望清楚而明确的公理能阐明集合是什么意思，以及集合应当具有哪些性质。具体说来，策梅洛试图限制可能的集合的大小。他没有哲学基础，只是谋求避免矛盾。他的公理体系包含未定义的基本概念——集合，以及一个集合包含在另一个集合中的关系。这些概念和已定义的概念，都应满足公理中的陈述。除非公理允许，不应使用集合的任何性质。公理规定了无限集合的存在，以及集合的并、子集的形成等运算。策梅洛也使用选择公理。

Though set theory is incorporated in the logistic approach to mathematics, the set-theorists preferred to approach it directly through axioms. The axiomatization of set theory was first undertaken by Ernst Zermelo in a paper of 1908. He, too, believed that the paradoxes arose because Cantor had not restricted the concept of a set. Zermelo therefore hoped that clear and explicit axioms would clarify what is meant by a set and what properties sets should have. In particular, Zermelo sought to limit the size of possible sets. He had no philosophical basis but sought only to avoid the contradictions. His axiom system contained the undefined fundamental concepts of set and the relation of one set being included in another. These and the defined concepts were to satisfy the statements in the axioms. No properties of sets were to be used unless granted by the axioms. In the axioms, the existence of infinite sets and such operations as the union of sets and the formation of subsets were provided for. Zermelo also used the axiom of choice.

数年之后，1922年，亚伯拉罕·A.弗兰克尔（1891—1965）改进了策梅洛的公理体系。策梅洛没有区分集合的性质和集合本身，而是把两者当作同义词使用。弗兰克尔在1922年作出了这种区分。集合论者最常使用的公理体系，被称为策梅洛－弗兰克尔体系。两人都预先采用了当时已有的、更精细、更明确的数理逻辑，却没有具体说明逻辑原则。他们把这些原则看作数学范围之外的东西，并像1900年以前的数学家使用逻辑那样，放心地加以应用。

Zermelo’s system of axioms was improved some years later (1922) by Abraham A. Fraenkel (1891-1965). Zermelo had failed to distinguish the property of a set and the set itself. These were used synonymously. The distinction was made by Fraenkel in 1922. The system of axioms used most commonly by set-theorists is known as the Zermelo-Fraenkel system. Both men presupposed the refined and sharper mathematical logic available in their time, but did not specify the logical principles. These they regarded as outside the pale of mathematics and to be confidently applied much as mathematicians applied logic before 1900.

我们来看看策梅洛－弗兰克尔集合论中的一些公理。这里容许我们用文字形式陈述它们。

Let us note some of the axioms of the Zermelo-Fraenkel set theory. We shall allow ourselves the liberty of stating them in verbal form.

1. 如果两个集合具有相同的成员，它们就是同一个集合。（从直觉上说，

1. Two sets are identical if they have the same members. (Intuitively

这定义了集合的概念。）2. 空集存在。3. 如果x和y是集合，那么无序对{x,y}也是集合。4. 一个由集合构成的集合的并，是一个集合。

this defines the notion of a set.) 2. The empty set exists. 3. If x and y are sets, then the unordered pair {x,y} is a set. 4. The union of a set of sets is a set.

5. 无限集合存在。（这条公理允许超限基数。它至关重要，因为它超出了经验。）

5. Infinite sets exist. (This axiom permits transfinite cardinals. It is crucial because it goes beyond experience.)

6. 凡能在该理论的语言中形式化的性质，都可以用来定义集合。

6. Any property that can be formalized in the language of the theory can be used to define a set.

7. 可以形成任何集合的幂集；也就是说，任何给定集合的所有子集的汇集，是一个集合。（这一过程可以无限重复；即把任何给定集合的所有子集构成的集合

7. One can form the power set of any set; that is, the collection of all subsets of any given set is a set. (This process can be repeated indefinitely; that is, consider the set of all subsets of any given set

看作一个新集合，这个集合的幂集又是一个新集合。）8. 选择公理。9. x不属于x。

as a new set; the power set of this set is a new set.) 8. The axiom of choice. 9. x does not belong to x.

这些公理特别值得注意的是，它们不允许考虑一个无所不包的集合，因而想必能够避免悖论。但它们足以推出古典分析所需的集合论的全部性质。在集合论基础上建立自然数，是很容易完成的。康托尔在1885年就已断言，纯数学可以归结为集合论；事实上，怀特海和罗素做到了这一点，尽管他们处理集合的方式复杂得多。从数的数学又可推出全部数学，其中包括几何，只要把几何建立在解析几何之上。因此，集合论可以作为全部数学的基础。*

What is especially noteworthy about these axioms is that they do not permit the consideration of an all-inclusive set and so presumably avoid the paradoxes. Yet they are adequate to imply all the properties of set theory needed for classical analysis. The development of the natural numbers on the basis of set theory can readily be carried out. Cantor had in 1885 asserted that pure mathematics was reducible to set theory, and in fact this was done by Whitehead and Russell, even though their approach to sets was far more complicated. And from the mathematics of number all of mathematics follows, including geometry if it is founded on analytic geometry. Hence set theory serves as a foundation for all of mathematics.*

*后来，哥德尔（1940年）和贝尔奈斯（1937年）修改了策梅洛－弗兰克尔体系，以区分集合与类。哥德尔和贝尔奈斯简化了1925年冯·诺伊曼提出的一个版本。集合可以属于其他集合。所有集合都是类，但并非所有类都是集合。类不能属于更大的类。集合与类的这种区别意味着，不允许极其庞大的汇集属于其他类。这样，康托尔的那些不一致的集合就被消除了。策梅洛－弗兰克尔体系中的任何定理，也都是哥德尔－贝尔奈斯体系中的定理，反之亦然。事实上，集合论公理体系有许多变体，但没有标准可以判定，为什么应当偏爱某一种而不选其他种。

*Later Godel (1940) and Bernays (1937) modified the Zermelo-Fraenkel system to distinguish sets and classes. Godel and Bernays simplified a 1925 version due to von Neumann. Sets can belong to other sets. All sets are classes but not all classes are sets. Classes cannot belong to larger classes. This distinction between sets and classes means that no monstrously large collections are allowed to belong to other classes. Thus Cantor’s inconsistent sets were eliminated. Any theorem in the Zermelo-Fraenkel system is a theorem in the Godel-Bernays system and conversely. In fact, there are many variations on the systems of axioms for set theory. But there is no criterion for preferring one over the others.

再说一遍，在集合论公理化的情形中，避免矛盾的希望，寄托于限制所允许的集合类型，同时又允许足够多的集合，为分析的基础服务。集合论公理避免了悖论，至少迄今还无人能在该理论内部推导出悖论。策梅洛宣称，一个悖论也推导不出来。后来的集合论者过去和现在都毫不怀疑地相信，任何悖论都推导不出来，因为策梅洛和弗兰克尔精心建立了一个集合层次，避免了早期关于集合及其性质的工作中的松散性。然而，公理化集合论的一致性尚未得到证明。不过，集合论者并未对此深感忧虑。对于这个尚未解决的一致性问题，庞加莱以他惯常的讥讽口吻说道：“我们在畜群周围围了一道篱笆，以保护它们免受狼的侵袭，但我们不知道，是否已有一些狼被圈在篱笆里面。”

To repeat, the hope of avoiding contradictions rests in the case of the axiomatization of set theory on restricting the types of sets that are admitted while admitting enough to serve the foundations of analysis. The axioms of set theory avoid the paradoxes to the extent that as yet no one has been able to derive them within the theory. Zermelo declared that none can be derived. The later set-theorists were and are convinced beyond a shadow of a doubt that none can be derived because Zermelo and Fraenkel had carefully built up a hierarchy of sets that avoided the looseness in earlier work on sets and their properties. However, the consistency of axiomatized set theory has not been demonstrated. But the set-theorists have not been seriously concerned. Apropos of this open problem of consistency, Poincare with one of his customary snide remarks said, “We have put a fence around the herd to protect it from the wolves but we do not know whether some wolves were already enclosed within the fence.”

和其他学派一样，集合论者也得到了批评的“关照”。许多人抨击他们使用选择公理。其他批评者则反对集合论者没有明确说明其逻辑基础。本世纪的头十年，人们就已经开始研究逻辑本身及其与数学的关系，而集合论者对逻辑原则却相当随意。当然，有些人认为他们对一致性的信心很天真，就像康托尔在发现困难之前那样天真（第九章）。还有一种批评认为，集合论公理颇为任意而人为。它们是为避免悖论而设计的，但其中一些并不自然，也不以直觉为基础。既然连集合论者也预先假定逻辑原则，为什么不从算术本身开始呢？

As in the cases of the other schools, the set-theorists were favored with criticism. The use of the axiom of choice was attacked by many. To other critics, the set-theorists’ failure to be specific about their logical foundations was objectionable. Already in the first decade of this century, logic itself and its relationship to mathematics were under investigation, whereas the set-theorists were rather casual about the logical principles. Of course, their confidence about consistency was regarded by some as naive, as naive as Cantor himself had been until he discovered difficulties (Chapter IX). Still another criticism has been that the axioms of set theory are rather arbitrary and artificial. They were designed to avoid the paradoxes, but some are not natural or based on intuition. Why not then start with arithmetic itself since the logical principles are presupposed even by the set-theorists?

尽管如此，某些数学家现在还是把策梅洛－弗兰克尔集合论公理作为理想的基础，用以建立全部数学。这是构建分析和几何最一般、最根本的理论。事实上，正如其他数学研究方案随着各自领袖不断发展和推进其哲学而获得追随者一样，集合论方案也获得了追随者。有些逻辑主义者，例如威拉德·范·奥曼·蒯因，愿意接受集合论。虽然还有许多重大事件尚待叙述，但在此我们应当指出：一群杰出而备受尊敬的数学家，以尼古拉·布尔巴基这个集体笔名活动，从1936年开始着手详细证明大多数数学家相信必然为真的一件事，即如果接受策梅洛－弗兰克尔集合论公理，尤其是贝尔奈斯和哥德尔的修正版，以及一些逻辑原则，就可以在其上建立全部数学。不过，对布尔巴基学派来说，逻辑也从属于数学本身的公理。逻辑并不支配数学是什么，也不支配数学家做什么。

Nevertheless, the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms of set theory are now used by some mathematicians as the desirable foundation on which to build all of mathematics. It is the most general and fundamental theory on which to build analysis and geometry. In fact, just as the other approaches to mathematics gained adherents as the respective leaders continued to develop and advance their philosophies, so did the set-theoretical approach. Some logicists, for example, Willard Van Orman Quine, would settle for set theory. Though many significant events have yet to be narrated, we should note in the present context that a group of prominent and highly respected mathematicians operating under the collective pseudonym of Nicholas Bourbaki undertook in 1936 to demonstrate in great detail what most mathematicians believed must be true, namely, that if one accepts the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms of set theory, in particular Bernay’s and Godel’s modification, and some principles of logic, one can build up all of mathematics on it. But to the Bourbakists, too, logic is subordinate to the axioms of mathematics proper. It does not control what mathematics is or what mathematicians do.

布尔巴基学派在《符号逻辑杂志》1949年的一篇文章中，表达了他们对于逻辑的立场：“换句话说，就我们数学家而言，逻辑不多不少，就是我们所使用语言的语法；这种语言必须先存在，才能构建其语法。”数学未来的发展可能要求修改逻辑。引入无限集合时就曾发生这种情况，而且正如我们讨论非标准分析时将会看到的，它还会再次发生。*因此，布尔巴基学派摒弃弗雷格、罗素、布劳威尔和希尔伯特。他们使用选择公理和排中律，尽管是借助希尔伯特的一种技术手段推导出它们。布尔巴基团体不为一致性问题费心。对此，他们说：“我们只须指出，这些困难可以通过一种消除所有异议的方式克服，并且使推理的正确性无可怀疑。”过去曾出现矛盾，而且已经克服，未来也将如此。“二十五个世纪以来，数学家一直在纠正自己的错误，并看到他们的科学因此更加丰富，而不是更加贫乏；这使他们有权泰然面对未来。”*见第十二章。布尔巴基学派在发展集合论方案的过程中，已经出版了约三十卷著作。

The Bourbakists expressed their position on logic in an article in the Journal for Symbolic Logic (1949): “In other words, logic, so far as we mathematicians are concerned, is no more and no less than the grammar of the language which we use, a language which had to exist before the grammar could be constructed.” Future developments in mathematics may call for modifications of the logic. This had happened with the introduction of infinite sets and, as we shall see when we discuss non-standard analysis,'- it would happen again. Thus, the Bourbaki school renounces Frege, Russell, Brouwer, and Hilbert. It uses the axiom of choice and the law of excluded middle, though it derives them by using a technical device of Hilbert’s. The Bourbaki group does not bother with the problem of consistency. On this issue, the Bourbakists say, “We simply note that these difficulties can be surmounted in a way which obviates all the objections and allows no doubt as to the correctness of the reasoning.” Contradictions have arisen in the past and have been surmounted. This will be true of the future. “For twenty-five centuries mathematicians have been correcting their errors, and seeing their science enriched and not impoverished in consequence; and this gives them ' See Chapter XII. the right to contemplate the future with equanimity.” The Bourbakists have put forth about thirty volumes in their development of the set-theoretic approach.

因此，到1930年，已有四种各自独立、彼此不同而且多少互相冲突的数学研究方案被提出；毫不夸张地说，各种观点的支持者正在彼此交战。再也不能只说一个数学定理得到了正确证明。到1930年，还必须补充说明，是按谁的标准判定它正确。数学的一致性这个推动新方案产生的主要问题，根本没有解决，除非把直觉主义者所说人的直觉保证一致性的立场算在内。

Thus by 1930, four separate, distinct, and more or less conflicting approaches to mathematics had been expounded, and the proponents of the several views were, it is no exaggeration to say, at war with each other. No longer could one say that a theorem of mathematics was correctly proven. By 1930 one had to add by whose standards it was deemed correct. The consistency of mathematics, the major problem which motivated the new approaches, was not settled at all if one excepts the intuitionist position that man’s intuition guarantees consistency.

这门科学在1800年时，尽管逻辑发展存在缺陷，却被赞颂为完美的科学：它以不会出错、不容质疑的推理确立结论；它的结论不仅不会出错，而且是关于我们宇宙的真理，按一些人的说法，甚至是任何可能宇宙中的真理。如今，它不但失去了对真理的声索，还因基础学派之间的冲突，以及对正确推理原则的不同断言而蒙受污损。人类理性的骄傲正在遭受酷刑。

The science which in 1800, despite the failings in its logical development, was hailed as the perfect science, the science which establishes its conclusions by infallible, unquestionable reasoning, the science whose conclusions are not only infallible but truths about our universe and, as some would maintain, truths in any possible universe, had not only lost its claim to truth but was now besmirched by the conflict of foundational schools and assertions about correct principles of reasoning. The pride of human reason was on the rack.

数学家埃里克·T.贝尔这样描述1930年的状况：

The state of affairs in 1930 has been described by the mathematician Eric T. Bell:

经验使大多数数学家懂得，许多在一代数学家看来坚实而令人满意的东西，在下一代更稳定的审视之下，很可能化为蛛网……如果知识意味着对数学基础达成一种合理而普遍的共识，那么这种知识似乎并不存在……只要直截了当地展示事实，就足以确立一个具有人类意义的论点：同样有能力的专家，对于任何稍稍明示或暗示自身具有普遍性、一般性或说服力的推理，即使在其最简单的方面，过去存在分歧，现在仍然存在分歧。

Experience has taught most mathematicians that much that looks solid and satisfactory to one mathematical generation stands a fair chance of dissolving into cobwebs under the steadier scrutiny of the next. . . . Knowledge in any sense of a reasonably common agreement on the fundamentals of mathematics seems to be non-existent. . . . The bald exhibition of the facts should suffice to establish the one point of human significance, namely, that equally competent experts have disagreed and do now disagree on the simplest aspects of any reasoning which makes the slightest claim, implicit or explicit, to universality, generality, or cogency.

未来会带来什么呢？正如我们将看到的，未来带来了更多严重的问题。

What could the future bring? As we shall see, the future brought many more grievous problems.

第十二章 灾难

XII. Disasters

为了炼成作祟强大的魔咒，像地狱的浓汤沸腾冒泡。加倍，加倍，劳苦和烦恼；火焰燃烧，锅中起泡。

For a charm of powerful trouble, Like a hell-broth boil and bubble. Double, double toil and trouble; Fire burn and caldron bubble.

莎士比亚，《麦克白》

Shakespeare, Macbeth

回顾起来，可以说1930年的数学基础状况尚可忍受。已知的悖论已经解决，尽管各学派采用的方式各有特点。诚然，对于什么是正确的数学，已经不再存在一致意见，但数学家可以采用自己喜欢的方案，然后按照那种方案的原则继续创造。

In retrospect, one could say that the state of the foundations of mathematics in 1930 was tolerable. The known paradoxes had been resolved, albeit in a manner peculiar to the several schools. True, there was no longer any unanimity about what was correct mathematics but a mathematician could adopt the approach that appealed to him. He could then proceed to create in accordance with the principles of that approach.

然而，两个问题仍使数学的良心感到不安。压倒一切的问题是确立数学的一致性，正是希尔伯特在1900年巴黎演讲中提出的那个问题。虽然已知悖论已经解决，但发现新悖论的危险始终存在。第二个问题就是所谓完备性。一般来说，完备性意味着，一个分支的公理足以确立任何涉及该分支概念的有意义断言的正确或错误。

However, two problems continued to trouble the mathematical conscience. The overriding problem was to establish the consistency of mathematics, the very problem Hilbert had posed in his Paris speech of 1900. Though the known paradoxes had been resolved, the danger that new ones might be discovered was ever present. The second problem was what has been called completeness. Generally, completeness means that the axioms of any branch are adequate to establish the correctness or falsity of any meaningful assertion that involves the concepts of that branch.

在非常初等的层次上，完备性问题就是：欧几里得几何中的一个合理猜想，例如三角形的各条高交于一点，能否根据欧几里得公理证明（或否证）。在更高的层次上，在超限数领域，连续统假设（第九章）就是一个例子。完备性要求它能够根据超限数理论的基础公理得到证明或否证。同样，完备性要求哥德巴赫猜想——每个偶数都是两个素数之和——能根据数论公理得到证明或否证。完备性问题实际上还包括许多其他命题，数学家数十年乃至数百年都未能证明它们。

On a very elementary level, the problem of completeness amounts to whether a reasonable conjecture of Euclidean geometry, for example, that the altitudes of a triangle meet in a point, can be proven (or disproven) on the basis of Euclid’s axioms. On a more advanced level and in the realm of transfinite numbers, the continuum hypothesis (Chapter IX) serves as an example. Completeness would require that it be provable or disprovable on the basis of the axioms underlying the theory of transfinite numbers. Similarly, completeness would require that Goldbach’s hypothesis—every even number is the sum of two primes—be provable or disprovable on the basis of the axioms of the theory of numbers. The problem of completeness actually included many other propositions whose proofs had defied mathematicians for decades and even centuries.

对于一致性和完备性问题，各学派采取的态度略有不同。罗素确实已经放弃了对逻辑主义方案所使用的逻辑公理之真理性的信念，并承认其可归约性公理的人为性（第十章）。他的类型论避免了已知悖论，罗素也相当有信心，认为它避免了所有可能的悖论。不过，信心是一回事，证明是另一回事。完备性问题他并未着手处理。

With respect to the problems of consistency and completeness, the several schools had adopted somewhat different attitudes. Russell had indeed abandoned his belief in the truth of the logical axioms used in the logistic approach and had confessed to the artificiality of his axiom of reducibility (Chapter X). His theory of types avoided the known paradoxes, and Russell was rather confident that it avoided all possible ones. Nevertheless, confidence is one thing and proof is another. The completeness problem he did not tackle.

虽然集合论者相信，他们的方案不会产生新的矛盾，但缺乏对这一信念的证明。他们关心完备性，却不把它放在首位。直觉主义者也对一致性问题漠不关心。他们确信，人类心灵接受的直觉本身就是一致的，形式证明没有必要，甚至与他们的哲学无关。至于完备性，他们相信人的直觉足够强大，能够判断几乎任何有意义命题的真伪，尽管有些命题可能不可判定。

Though the set-theorists were confident that no new contradictions could arise in their approach, proof of this belief was lacking. Completeness was a concern but not a primary one. The intuitionists, too, were indifferent to the problem of consistency. They were convinced that the intuitions accepted by the human mind were eo ipso consistent, and formal proof was unnecessary and even irrelevant to their philosophy. As for completeness, human intuition, they believed, was powerful enough to decide the truth or falsity of almost any meaningful proposition, though some might be undecidable.

然而，以希尔伯特为首的形式主义者并未自满。在20世纪初曾为解决一致性问题作过一些有限的努力之后，希尔伯特在1920年重新着手研究这一问题以及完备性问题。

However, the formalists, led by Hilbert, were not complacent. After some limited efforts in the early 1900s to resolve the problem of consistency, in 1920 Hilbert returned to this problem and to the problem of completeness.

在他的元数学中，他已经概述了证明一致性的方案。至于完备性，希尔伯特在1925年的文章《论无穷》中，重新表达了他在1900年巴黎演讲中所说的大致相同的观点。在后一次演讲中，他说：“每个明确的数学问题，都必然能够得到精确的解决。”1925年，他扩充了这一断言：

In his metamathematics he had outlined the approach to proof of consistency. As for completeness, in his article of 1925, “On the Infinite,” Hilbert reexpressed essentially what he had said in his Paris speech of 1900. In the latter he said, “Every definite mathematical problem must necessarily be susceptible of an exact settlement.” In 1925 he amplified this assertion:

作为如何处理基础问题的一个例子，我想选择每个数学问题都可以解决这一命题。我们都坚信这一点。毕竟，当我们致力于一个数学问题时，最吸引我们的事情之一，正是我们内心总能听到这样的呼唤：问题就在这里，寻找解答吧；你可以通过纯粹思考找到它，因为在数学中不存在ignorabimus［我们将无法知道］。

As an example of the way in which fundamental questions can be treated I would like to choose the thesis that every mathematical problem can be solved. We are all convinced of that. After all, one of the things that attract us most when we apply ourselves to a mathematical problem is precisely that within us we always hear the call: here is the problem, search for the solution; you can find it by pure thought, for in mathematics there is no ignorabimus [we shall not know].

在1928年博洛尼亚国际大会的一次演讲中，希尔伯特批评了较早的完备性证明，因为它们使用了他的元数学不允许的逻辑原则；但他非常相信自己的体系是完备的：“我们的理性并不拥有任何秘密技艺，而是按照完全明确、能够陈述的规则行事；这些规则保证了其判断的绝对客观性。”他说，每位数学家都坚信，每个明确的数学问题都必定能够解决。在1930年的文章《自然知识与逻辑》中，他说：“在我看来，孔德未能找到不可解决的问题，真正的原因在于，这样的问题并不存在。”

At the International Congress of 1928 in Bologna, Hilbert, in an address, criticized older proofs of completeness because they used principles of logic that are not allowed in his metamathematics, but he was very confident that his own system was complete: “Our reason does not carry any secret art but proceeds by quite definite and stateable rules which are the guarantee of the absolute objectivity of its judgment.” Every mathematician, he said, shares the conviction that each definite mathematical problem must be capable of being solved. In his 1930 article, Natural Knowledge and Logic,” he said, “The real reason for Comte s failure to find an unsolvable problem is, in my opinion, that an unsolvable problem does not exist.”

在1927年宣读、1930年发表的论文《数学基础》中，希尔伯特进一步阐述了1905年的一篇论文。谈到用以确立一致性和完备性的元数学方法（证明论）时，他断言：

In “The Foundations of Mathematics,” a paper read in 1927 and published in 1930, Hilbert elaborated on one he wrote in 1905. Referring to his metamathematical method (proof theory) of establishing consistency and completeness, he affirmed:

通过这种为数学提供基础的新方法，我们可以恰当地称之为证明论，我追求一个重要目标：我希望一劳永逸地消除以目前形式提出的数学基础问题，办法是把每个数学命题变成一个可以具体展示并严格推导的公式，从而重新塑造数学的推导与推理，使其不可动摇，同时又能充分描绘整个科学。我相信，凭借我的证明论，我能够完全达到这一目标，即使在它充分发展之前，还必须完成大量工作。

With this new way of providing a foundation for mathematics, which we may appropriately call a proof theory, I pursue a significant goal, for I should like to eliminate once and for all the questions regarding the foundations of mathematics, in the form in which they are now posed, by turning every mathematical proposition into a formula that can be concretely exhibited and strictly derived, thus recasting mathematical derivations and inferences in such a way that they are unshakable and yet provide an adequate picture of the whole science. I believe I can attain this goal completely with my proof theory, even if a great deal of work must still be done before it is fully developed.

显然，希尔伯特相信，他的证明论能够解决一致性和完备性问题。

Clearly Hilbert was confident that his proof theory would settle the questions of consistency and completeness.

到1930年，已经得到若干关于完备性的结果。希尔伯特本人构建了一个略显人为的体系，只涵盖算术的一部分，并确立了它的一致性和完备性。其他人很快又得到了类似的有限结果。例如，命题演算这样相对简单的公理体系，被证明是一致的，甚至是完备的。其中有些证明由希尔伯特的学生完成。1930年，库尔特·哥德尔（1906—1978），后来成为高等研究院教授，证明了涵盖命题及命题函数的一阶谓词演算的完备性。*这些结果使形式主义者欢欣鼓舞。希尔伯特相信，他的元数学、他的证明论，将成功确立全部数学的一致性和完备性。

By 1930, several results on completeness had been obtained. Hilbert himself had constructed a somewhat artificial system which covered only a portion of arithmetic and had established its consistency and completeness. Other such limited results were soon obtained by other men. Thus relatively trivial axiomatic systems such as the propositional calculus were proven to be consistent and even complete. Some of these proofs were made by students of Hilbert. In 1930, Kurt Godel (1906-1978), later a professor at the Institute for Advanced Study, proved the completeness of the first order predicate calculus which covers propositions and propositional functions.* These results delighted the formalists. Hilbert was confident that his metamathematics, his proof theory, would succeed in establishing consistency and completeness for all of mathematics.

但就在次年，哥德尔又发表了一篇论文，打开了潘多拉的盒子。这篇《〈数学原理〉及相关体系中的形式不可判定命题》（1931年）包含两个惊人的结果。对数学界而言，更具毁灭性的断言是：任何一个足够广泛、甚至只要能包含整数算术的数学体系，其一致性就不能由几个基础学派——逻辑主义者、形式主义者和集合论者——所采用的逻辑原则来确立。这尤其适用于形式主义学派，因为希尔伯特有意把元数学的逻辑原则限制为连直觉主义者也能接受的那些原则，所以可用的逻辑工具更少。这个结果促使赫尔曼·外尔说：上帝存在，因为数学无疑是一致的；魔鬼也存在，因为我们无法证明这种一致性。

But in the very next year Godel published another paper that opened up a Pandora’s box. This paper, “On Formally Undecidable Propositions of Principia Mathematica and Related Systems” (1931), contained two startling results. To the mathematical world, the more devastating assertion was that the consistency of any mathematical system that is extensive enough to embrace even the arithmetic of whole numbers cannot be established by the logical principles adopted by the several foundational schools, the logicists, the formalists, and the set-theorists. This applies especially to the formalist school because Hilbert had deliberately limited his metamathematical logical principles to those acceptable even to the intuitionists and so fewer logical tools were available. This result prompted Hermann Weyl to say that God exists because mathematics is undoubtedly consistent and the devil exists because we cannot prove the consistency.

哥德尔的上述结果，是他另一个同样惊人的结果的推论；后者称为哥德尔不完备性定理。它断言：如果任何足以包含整数理论的形式理论T是一致的，那么T就是不完备的。*这意味着，存在一个有意义的数论陈述，姑且称之为S，在该理论中，既不能证明S，也不能证明非S。可是，S和非S必有一个为真；因此，就存在一个为真却不可证明、因而不可判定的数论陈述。虽然哥德尔对于所涉及的公理体系的类别说得不够明确，但他的定理确实适用于罗素－怀特海体系、策梅洛－弗兰克尔体系、希尔伯特的数论公理化体系，事实上适用于一切广泛接受的公理体系。看来，一致性的代价是不完备性。更令人难堪的是，某些不可判定的陈述，可以通过超越上述形式体系所使用逻辑的论证，也就是推理规则，证明为真。

The above result of Godel’s is a corollary of his other equally startling result, which is called Godel’s incompleteness theorem. It states that, if any formal theory T adequate to embrace the theory of whole numbers is consistent, then T is incomplete.* This means that there is a meaningful statement of number theory, let us call it S, such that neither S nor not S is provable in the theory. Now either S or not S is true; there is, then, a true statement of number theory which is not provable and so is undecidable. Though Godel was not too clear on the class of axiom systems involved, his theorem does apply to the Russell-Whitehead system, the Zermelo-Fraenkel system, Hilbert’s axiomatization of number theory, and in fact to all widely accepted axiom systems. Apparently the price of consistency is incompleteness. To add insult to injury, some of the undecidable statements can be shown to be true by arguments, that is, rules of reasoning, that transcend the logic used in the formal systems just mentioned.

*它也是一致的，而且其公理是独立的。这是由希尔伯特及其他人证明的。

*It is also consistent and its axioms are independent. This was shown by Hilbert and other men.

不难想象，哥德尔并非轻易得出这些惊人结果。他的整体方案，是把数与例如逻辑主义和形式主义数学方案中的每个符号以及符号序列相联系。然后，他也给构成证明的任何命题或命题集，赋予一个哥德尔数。

As one might expect, Godel did not obtain his amazing results readily. His overall scheme was to associate numbers with each symbol and sequence of symbols of, for example, the logistic and formalistic approaches to mathematics. Then to any proposition or set of propositions constituting a proof, he also attached a Godel number.

具体说来，他的算术化是给数学概念赋予自然数。给1赋予1，给等号赋予2，给希尔伯特的否定符号赋予3，给加号赋予5，其他符号也同样处理。因此，对1=1这一符号组合，他得到数的符号1、2、1。不过，哥德尔赋予公式1=1的，不是符号1、2、1，而是一个仍能显示各组成数的单一数。他取前三个素数2、3、5，形成21·32·51=90。因此，他给1=1赋予数90。注意，90总能唯一分解为21·32·51，从而可以恢复符号

Specifically his arithmetization consisted in assigning natural numbers to mathematical concepts. 1 is assigned 1. To the equals sign, he assigned 2; to Hilbert s negation symbol, he assigned 3; to the plus sign he assigned 5, and similarly for the other symbols. Thus for the collection of symbols 1 = 1, he had the number symbols 1, 2, 1. However, Godel now assigned to the formula 1 = 1, not the symbols 1, 2, 1, but a single number which nevertheless still showed the component numbers. He took the first three prime numbers, 2, 3, 5, and formed 21 · 32 · 51 = 90. So to 1 = 1 he assigned the number 90. Note that 90 can always be decomposed uniquely to 21 · 32 · 51, so that we can recover the symbols

1、2、1。

1, 2, 1.

哥德尔给他所考察体系的每个公式赋予一个数，也给构成证明的整个公式序列赋予一个数。这个数的指数是各公式的数。它们本身不是素数，而是附在素数上。因此，2900·390可以是某个证明的数。这个证明包含编号为900的公式和编号为90的公式。因此，可以从一个证明的数重构该证明中的公式。

To each formula of the systems he considered, Godel assigned a number. And to an entire sequence of formulas which constitute a proof, he likewise assigned a number. The exponents of such a number are the numbers of formulas. They are not themselves prime but are attached to primes. Thus 2900 • 390 can be the number of a proof. This proof contains the formula 900 and the formula 90. Hence from the number of a proof, we can reconstruct the formulas of the proof.

*这个结果也适用于二阶谓词演算（第八章）。不完备性并不使那些可以证明的定理失效。

"This result applies also to the second order predicate calculus (Chapter VIII). Incompleteness does not invalidate those theorems that can be proved.

然后，哥德尔证明，对于他所考察的形式体系中的公式，元数学的有关概念也能用数表示。这样，元数学中的每个断言，都被赋予一个哥德尔数。这个数是某个元数学陈述的数，同时也是某个算术陈述的数。因此，元数学也被“映射”进算术。

Then Godel showed that the concepts of metamathematics about the formulas of the formal systems he considered are also representable by numbers. Thereby each assertion in metamathematics has a Godel number assigned to it. This number is the number of a metamathematical statement. It is also a number of some arithmetical statement. Thus metamathematics is also “mapped” into arithmetic.

哥德尔用这些算术术语，展示了如何构造一个算术断言G；用文字表达的元数学语言来说，它声称，哥德尔数为某个m的陈述不可证明。但G作为一个符号序列，其哥德尔数正是m。因此，G说它自己不可证明。然而，如果整个算术断言G可以证明，它就断言自身不可证明；而如果G不可证明，它断言的恰好就是这一点，因此它不可证明。不过，由于这个算术断言或者可证明、或者不可证明，它所属的形式体系如果一致，就不完备。尽管如此，算术陈述G为真，因为它是一个关于整数的陈述，可以通过比形式体系所允许的更具直觉性的推理来确立。

In these arithmetical terms Godel showed how to construct an arithmetical assertion G that says, in the verbal metamathematical language, that the statement with Godel number m, say, is not provable. But G, as a sequence of symbols, has the Godel number m. Thus, G says of itself that it is not provable. But if the entire arithmetical assertion G is provable, it asserts that it is not provable, and if G is not provable it affirms just that and so is not provable. However, since the arithmetical assertion is either provable or not provable, the formal system to which the arithmetical assertion belongs, if consistent, is incomplete. Nevertheless, the arithmetical statement G is true because it is a statement about integers that can be established by more intuitive reasoning than the formal systems permit.

下面的例子也可以显示哥德尔方案的实质。如果考虑“这个句子不是真的”这一陈述，就会出现矛盾。因为如果整个句子为真，那么按它的断言，它为假；如果整个句子为假，那么它为真。哥德尔用“不可证明”替代“假”，使句子变为“这个句子不可证明”。现在，如果该陈述不可证明，那么它所说的就是真的。另一方面，如果该句可证明，它就不是真的；或者，根据标准逻辑，如果它为真，它就不可证明。因此，该句为真，当且仅当它不可证明。结果不是矛盾，而是一个不可证明或不可判定的真陈述。

The essence of Godel’s scheme may also be seen from the following example. If one considers the statement, “This sentence is not true,” we have a contradiction. For if the entire sentence is true, then, as it asserts, it is false; and if the entire sentence is false, then it is true. Godel substituted unprovable for false so that the sentence reads, “This sentence is unprovable.” Now if the statement is not provable, then what it says is true. If, on the other hand, the sentence is provable, it is not true or, by standard logic, if true, it is not provable. Hence the sentence is true if and only if it is not provable. Thus the result is not a contradiction but a true statement which is unprovable or undecidable.

在展示了他的不可判定陈述之后，哥德尔构造了一个算术陈述A，表示元数学陈述“算术是一致的”，并证明A蕴涵G。因此，如果A可证明，G也可证明。但由于G不可判定，A就不可证明。它是不可判定的。这个结果确立了：任何可以转译进算术体系的方法或逻辑原则集，都不可能证明一致性。

After exhibiting his undecidable statement Godel constructed an arithmetical statement A that represents the metamathematical statement “Arithmetic is consistent,” and he proved that A implies G. Hence if A were provable, G would be provable. But since G is undecidable, A is not provable. It is undecidable. This result establishes the impossibility of proving consistency by any method or set of logical principles that can be translated into the system of arithmetic.

似乎可以通过增加逻辑原则，或给形式体系增加一条数学公理，避免不完备性。但哥德尔的方法表明，如果增加的陈述也能通过他给符号和公式编号的方案，用算术术语表达，那么仍然能够形成一个不可判定陈述。换句话说，只有通过不能“映射”进算术的推理原则，才可能避免不可判定陈述并证明一致性。作一个略嫌不严谨的类比：如果推理原则和数学公理用日语表达，哥德尔的算术化用英语表达，那么只要日语能够译成英语，哥德尔的结果就会成立。

It would seem that incompleteness could be avoided by adding to the logical principles or by adding a mathematical axiom to the formal system. But Godel’s method shows that,, if the additional statement is also expressible in arithmetical terms by his scheme of assigning numbers to the symbols and formulas, then an undecidable statement can still be formulated. Put otherwise, undecidable statements can be avoided and consistency proved only by means of principles of reasoning that cannot be “mapped” into arithmetic. To use a somewhat loose analogy, if the principles of reasoning and mathematical axioms were in Japanese and the Godel arithmetization were in English, then as long as the Japanese could be translated into English, the Godel results would obtain.

因此，哥德尔不完备性定理断言：任何能够以哥德尔所用方式之类的方法进行算术化的数学与逻辑公理体系，都不足以囊括甚至这一个体系的全部真理，更不用说全部数学，因为任何这样的公理体系都是不完备的。存在属于这些体系的有意义陈述，却无法在体系内部证明它们。不过，仍可通过非形式的论证表明它们为真。公理化所能达到的目标存在局限，这一结果与19世纪末那种数学与公理化分支的汇集完全重合的看法，形成鲜明对比。哥德尔的结果给全面公理化以致命打击。公理方法的这种不足，本身并不是矛盾，却令人惊讶，因为数学家，特别是形式主义者，原来期望任何真陈述都必能在某种公理体系的框架内确立。因此，布劳威尔指出直觉上确定的东西少于古典数学所证明的东西，而哥德尔则表明，直觉上确定的东西超出了数学证明的范围。正如保罗·贝尔奈斯所说，今天，与其推荐公理化，不如警告人们不要过高评价它，后者更明智。当然，上述论证并不排除新的证明方法可能超越基础学派所接受的逻辑原则所允许范围的可能性。

Thus Godel’s incompleteness theorem asserts that no system of mathematical and logical axioms that can be arithmetized in some manner such as Godel used is adequate to encompass all the truths of even that one system, to say nothing about all of mathematics, because any such axiom system is incomplete. There exist meaningful statements that belong to these systems but cannot be proved within the systems. They can nevertheless be shown to be true by non-formal arguments. This result, that there are limitations on what can be achieved by axiomatization, contrasts sharply with the late nineteenth-century view that mathematics is coextensive with the collection of axiomatized branches. Godel s result dealt a death blow to comprehensive axiomatization. This inadequacy of the axiomatic method is not in itself a contradiction, but it is surprising because mathematicians, the formalists in particular, had expected that any true statement could certainly be established within the framework of some axiomatic system. Thus, while Brouwer made clear that what is intuitively certain falls short of what is proved in classical mathematics, Godel showed that what is intuitively certain extends beyond mathematical proof. As Paul Bernays has said, it is less wise today to recommend axiomatics than to warn against an overevaluation of it. Of course, the above arguments do not exclude the possibility that new methods of proof may go beyond what the logical principles accepted by the foundational schools permit.

哥德尔的两个结果都令人震撼。无法证明一致性，最直接地给希尔伯特的形式主义哲学以致命打击，因为他原计划在元数学中完成这样的证明，并相信会成功。然而，这场灾难远远超出了希尔伯特纲领。哥德尔关于一致性的结果说，在任何数学研究方案中，我们都不能凭借稳妥的逻辑原则证明一致性。已经提出的方案无一例外。数学在本世纪本来或许还能声称的一项独特性质，即其结果的绝对确定性或有效性，如今再也不能声称了。更糟的是，既然一致性无法证明，数学家就冒着胡言乱语的风险，因为任何一天都可能发现矛盾。如果真发生这种情况，而矛盾又无法解决，那么全部数学都将毫无意义。因为两个互相矛盾的命题中，必有一个为假，而所有数理逻辑学家所采用的蕴涵概念，叫作实质蕴涵（第八章），允许假命题蕴涵任何命题。因此，数学家是在毁灭的威胁下工作的。不完备性定理是另一重打击。这里也直接涉及希尔伯特，但该定理适用于所有形式的数学研究方案。

Both of Godel’s results were shattering. The inability to prove consistency dealt a death blow most directly to Hilbert’s formalist philosophy because he had planned such a proof in his metamathematics and was confident it would succeed. However, the disaster extended far beyond Hilbert’s program. Godel’s result on consistency says that we cannot prove consistency in any approach to mathematics by safe logical principles. No one of the approaches that had been put forth was excepted. The one distinguishing feature of mathematics that it might have claimed in this century, the absolute certainty or validity of its results, could no longer be claimed. Worse, since consistency cannot be proved, mathematicians risked talking nonsense because any day a contradiction could be found. If this should happen and the contradiction were not resolvable, then all of mathematics would be pointless. For, of two contradictory propositions, one must be false, and the logical concept of implication adopted by all the mathematical logicians, called material implication (Chapter VIII), allows a false proposition to imply any proposition. Hence mathematicians were working under a threat of doom. The incompleteness theorem was another blow. Here, too, Hilbert was directly involved, but the theorem applies to all formal approaches to mathematics.

虽然一般数学家不像希尔伯特那样自信地表态，但他们确实期望解决任何明确的问题。事实上，例如证明费马最后“定理”的努力，到1930年已经产生数百篇篇幅很长、内容深刻的论文。这个定理断言，当n大于2时，没有整数满足xn+yn=zn。也许所有这些努力都是徒劳的，因为这个断言很可能不可判定。

Though mathematicians generally had not expressed themselves so confidently as Hilbert had, they certainly expected to solve any clear-cut problem. Indeed, the efforts to prove, for example, Fermat’s last “theorem,” which asserts that there are no integers that satisfy xn + yn = zn when n is greater than 2, had even by 1930 produced hundreds of long and deep papers. Perhaps all of these efforts were in vain because the assertion may very well be undecidable.

哥德尔不完备性定理，在一定程度上否定了排中律。我们相信，一个命题非真即假；在现代数学基础中，这意味着，根据逻辑规律以及该命题所属特定学科的公理，它或者可证明，或者可否证。但哥德尔表明，有些命题既不可证明，也不可否证。这为基于其他理由反对这些规律的直觉主义者提供了论据。

Godel’s incompleteness theorem is to an extent a denial of the law of excluded middle. V7e believe a proposition is true or false, and in modern foundations this means provable or disprovable by the laws of logic and any axioms of the particular subject to which the proposition belongs. But Godel showed that some are neither provable or disprovable. This is an argument for the intuitionists who argued against the laws on other grounds.

如果不同于哥德尔的方案，能够证明某个体系包含一个不可判定命题，那么就有可能证明一致性，因为按照前面关于实质蕴涵的论证，如果存在矛盾，每个命题都可以证明。但迄今还没有做到这一点。

There is a possibility of proving consistency if one can show, unlike Gddel’s approach, that a system contains an undecidable proposition, for, by the argument noted earlier, concerning material implication, if there were a contradiction, every proposition could be proved. But thus far this has not been done.

希尔伯特不相信自己失败了。他是一个乐观主义者，对人的理性和理解力的力量抱有无限信心。这种乐观给了他勇气和力量，却使他不能承认可能存在不可判定的数学问题。对希尔伯特来说，数学是一个领域，在其中研究者除了自身能力以外，找不到任何界限。

Hilbert was not convinced that he had failed. He was an optimist. He had unbounded confidence in the power of man’s reason and understanding. This optimism gave him courage and strength, but it barred him from granting that there could be undecidable mathematical problems. For Hilbert, mathematics was a domain in which the researcher could find no bounds other than his own personal power.

哥德尔1931年的结果，发表于希尔伯特与保罗·贝尔奈斯所著的一部数学基础的重要著作第一卷写作之后、第二卷写作之前；第一卷实际出版于1934年，第二卷出版于1939年。因此，在第二卷序言中，作者同意，必须扩充元数学的推理方法。他们把超限归纳法包括了进来。*希尔伯特认为，这些新原则在直觉上可能仍然可靠，并能普遍获得接受。他坚持这一方向，却没有产生新的结果。

Godel’s 1931 results were published between the writing of the first volume (actually published in 1934) and the second volume (1939) of a basic work on foundations by Hilbert and Paul Bernays. Hence in the preface to the second volume the authors agreed that one must enlarge the methods of reasoning in metamathematics. They included transfinite induction.* These new principles, Hilbert thought, might still be intuitively sound and universally acceptable. He persisted in this direction but produced no new results.

关键的1931年之后的发展，只使局面更加复杂，也进一步挫败了任何界定数学以及何为正确结果的尝试。其中一个发展虽然相对次要，至少也应该提及。希尔伯特学派成员格哈德·根岑（1909—1945），确实放宽了希尔伯特元数学允许的证明方法，例如使用超限归纳法，并在1936年成功确立了数论和分析的某些受限部分的一致性。

Developments after the crucial year of 1931 have only complicated the picture and have further frustrated any attempt to define mathematics and what correct results are. One such development, though relatively minor, should at least be mentioned. Gerhard Gentzen (1909-1945), a member of Hilbert’s school, did loosen the methods of proof allowed in Hilbert’s metamathematics, for example, by using transfinite induction, and managed in 1936 to establish the consistency of number theory and restricted portions of analysis.

一些希尔伯特学派成员为根岑的一致性证明辩护，并接受它。这些形式主义者说，根岑的工作并未超出容易接受的逻辑界限。因此，要为形式主义辩护，就必须从有穷的布劳威尔式逻辑，转向超限的根岑式逻辑。反对根岑方法的人认为，所谓“可接受”的逻辑竟然可以如此复杂，令人惊讶；而且，如果我们怀疑算术的一致性，那么使用同样可疑的元数学原则，并不能消除疑虑。甚至在根岑使用超限归纳法之前，它就已经引起争议，一些数学家还努力在可能的地方把它从证明中排除。它不是一条在直觉上令人信服的原则。正如外尔所说，这类原则降低了有效推理的标准，以至何者可信都变得含糊。
