Gentzen’s consistency proof is defended and accepted by some Hilbertians. These formalists say that Gentzen’s work does not exceed the limits of readily acceptable logic. Thus to defend formalism one has to go from finitary Brouwerian logic to the transfinite Gentzenian logic. Opponents of Gentzen’s method argue that it is amazing how sophisticated “acceptable” logic can be and that, if we are in doubt about the consistency of arithmetic, then our doubts will not be relieved by using a metamathematical principle which is as doubtful. The issue of transfinite induction had been controversial even before Gentzen’s use of it, and some mathematicians had made efforts to eliminate it from proofs wherever possible. It is not an intuitively convincing principle. As Weyl put it, such principles lower the standard of valid reasoning to the point where what is trustworthy becomes vague.

*通常的数学归纳法证明一个定理对所有有限的正整数为真。超限归纳法使用相同方法，但将其扩展到超限基数的良序集合。

!' The usual mathematical induction proves that a theorem is true for all finite positive integers. Transfinite induction uses the same method but extends it to the well ordered sets of transfinite cardinal numbers.

哥德尔不完备性定理引出了一些值得提及的附带问题。既然在任何具有相当复杂程度的数学分支中，都存在既不能证明也不能否证的断言，就出现了这样一个问题：能否判定某个特定断言是否可证明或可否证？文献中称它为判定问题。它要求有效的程序，也许是计算机器使用的那种程序，使人能够在有限步骤内判定一个陈述或一类陈述的可证明性（真或假）。

The incompleteness theorem of Godel has given rise to subsidiary problems that are worthy of mention. Since in any branch of mathematics of any appreciable complexity, there are assertions that can be neither proved nor disproved, the question does arise whether one can determine if any particular assertion can be proved or disproved. In the literature this question is known as the decision problem. It calls for effective procedures, perhaps such as computing machines employ, which enable one to determine in a finite number of steps the provability (truth or falsity) of a statement or a class of statements.

为了把判定程序的概念具体化，我们来看几个简单的例子。判定一个整数是否整除另一个整数，可以使用除法过程；如果没有余数，答案就是肯定的。相同过程也可用于回答一个多项式是否整除另一个多项式。同样，要判定方程ax+by=c，其中a、b、c为整数，是否有x、y的整数解，也有明确的方法。

Just to concretize the notion of a decision procedure, let us consider some trivial examples. To decide whether one whole number divides another exactly, we can use the process of division and if there is no remainder the answer is yes. The same process applies to answer the question of whether one polynominal divides exactly into another. Similarly, to decide whether the equation ax + by = c, wherein a, b, and c are integers, has integral solutions for x and y, there is a clear-cut method.

恰好，希尔伯特在1900年巴黎国际大会的演讲中，提出了一个很有趣的问题，即他的第十问题，涉及丢番图方程；他问，能否给出一种有效程序，判定这类方程是否有整数解。因此，虽然ax+by=c这类方程属于丢番图方程，因为每个方程有两个未知数而只有一条方程，并且解必须是整数，但希尔伯特的丢番图问题更一般。无论如何，判定问题远比希尔伯特所提出的问题复杂，但研究判定问题的人喜欢提到希尔伯特的问题，因为只要对希尔伯特提出的问题得到了结果，这一事实本身就赋予结果以地位。

It so happens that in his talk at the International Congress of 1900 in Paris, Hilbert had raised a very interesting problem, his tenth, concerning Diophantine equations, and had asked whether one could give an effective procedure to determine whether such equations are solvable in whole numbers. Thus, whereas the class of equations ax + by = c consists of Diophantine equations because each involves two unknowns with but one equation and the solutions must be integers, Hilbert s Diophantine problem was more general. In any case the decision problem is a vastly more complicated one than Hilbert s problem presents, but those working on the decision problem like to refer to Hilbert’s problem because the very fact that one has results on a problem posed by Hilbert grants status to the result.

普林斯顿大学教授阿隆佐·丘奇（1903—1995），把有效程序的概念定义为递归函数，或者可以说，可计算函数的概念。我们来看一个递归性的简单例子。如果定义f(1)=1，f(n+1)=f(n)+3，那么f(2)=f(1)+3，也就是1+3，即4。进一步，f(3)=f(2)+3，也就是4+3，即7。这样就可以依次计算f(n)的各个值。函数f(x)称为递归函数。丘奇的递归性概念更一般，但归根到底就是可计算性。

The notion of what an effective procedure is, was defined by Alonzo Church (1903-1995), a professor at Princeton University, to be that of a recursive function or, one might say, a computable function. Let us consider a simple example of recursiveness. If'one defines f( 1) to be 1 and f(n + 1) to be f(n) + 3, then f(2) = f( 1) + 3, or 1 + 3, or 4. Further, f(3) is f(2) + 3, or 4 + 3, or 7. And so we can compute the successive values of f{n). The function f(x) is said to be recursive. Church’s notion of recursiveness was more general but amounts to computability.

丘奇在1936年利用他新发展的递归函数概念，表明一般情况下不可能有判定程序。因此，给定一个具体断言，并不总能找到一种算法来判定它可证明还是可否证。在某个特定情况下，可能找到一个证明，但没有办法事先检验能否找到这样的证明。因此，数学家可能浪费多年去证明不可证明的东西。对于希尔伯特第十问题，尤里·马季亚谢维奇在1970年证明，不存在一种算法，能够判定是否有整数满足相关的丢番图方程。某个问题未必不可判定；但没有有效程序——在今天大多数数学家看来，这意味着一种递归程序，不一定是上面描述的那一种——能够事先告诉我们它是否可解。

Church in 1936, using his newly developed notion of recursive function, showed that in general no decision procedure was possible. Thus, given a specific assertion, one cannot always find an algorithm to determine whether it is provable or disprovable. In any particular case one might find a proof, but no advance test of whether such a proof can be found is available. Thus, mathematicians might waste years in trying to prove what is not provable. In the case of Hilbert’s tenth problem, Yuri Matyasevich proved in 1970 that there is no algorithm to determine whether or not integers satisfy the relevant Diophantine equations. The problem may not be undecidable; but no effective procedure, which means to most mathematicians today a recursive procedure (not necessarily the one described above), can tell us in advance whether it is solvable.

不可判定命题与没有判定程序的问题之间的区别，有些微妙，却是明确的。不可判定命题是在特定公理体系中不可判定的；任何有重要意义的公理结构中，都存在这样的命题。例如，欧几里得平行公设无法根据其他欧几里得公理判定。另一个例子是这样一个断言：实数是满足通常实数公理性质的最小集合。

The distinction between undecidable propositions and problems for which no decision procedure is available is somewhat subtle but sharp. The undecidable propositions are undecidable in a particular system of axioms, and they exist in any axiomatic structure of significance. Thus Euclid’s parallel postulate is not decidable on the basis of the other Euclidean axioms. Another example is the assertion that the real numbers are the smallest set satisfying the usual axiomatic properties of the real numbers.

尚未解决的问题可能是可判定的，但并不总能事先知道。用直尺和圆规三等分角的问题，至少在数百年间，可能曾被错误地认为不可判定。但结果证明三等分是不可能的。丘奇定理说，不可能事先判定一个命题可证明还是可否证。它可能是其中一种，也可能两者皆非，从而不可判定；但这不像已知不可判定命题的情形那样显而易见。哥德巴赫猜想，即每个偶数是两个素数之和，目前尚未证明。它最终可能被发现，根据数的公理是不可判定的；但目前它并非明显不可判定，而哥德尔的例子却是。因此，或许有一天它会被证明或被否证。

Problems that have not been solved may be decidable but this cannot always be known in advance. The problem of trisecting an angle with straightedge and compass might, at least for centuries, have been regarded erroneously as undecidable. But trisection turned out to be impossible. Church s theorem states that it is impossible to decide in udvcince whether a proposition is provable or disprovable. It may be either. It may also be neither and so undecidable, but this is not apparent as in the case of known undecidable propositions. Goldbach’s hypothesis that every even number is the sum of two primes is at present unproved. It may turn out to be undecidable on the basis of the axioms of number, but it is not now evidently undecidable whereas Godel’s examples are. Hence some day it may be proved or disproved.

哥德尔关于不完备性以及无法证明一致性的工作，给数学家造成的冲击还未被消化，大约十年之后，新的冲击又威胁着数学的发展进程。又是哥德尔，发起了另一系列研究；其结果使什么是可靠的数学、数学能够沿什么方向发展的问题，陷入更大的混乱。我们可以回想，本世纪初开创的一种数学方案，是把数学建立在集合论之上（第十一章），为此发展了策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理体系。

The shocks to mathematicians that Godel’s work on incompleteness and the inability to prove consistency caused had not been absorbed when, about ten years later, new shocks threatened the course of mathematics. Again it was Godel who launched another series of investigations that resulted in throwing into still greater confusion the question of what sound mathematics is and what directions it can take. We may recall that one of the approaches to mathematics initiated early in the century was to build mathematics on set theory (Chapter XI), and for this purpose the Zermelo-Fraenkel system of axioms was developed.

在《选择公理与广义连续统假设同集合论公理的一致性》（1940年）中，哥德尔证明：如果不含选择公理的策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理体系是一致的，那么添入这条公理所得的体系也是一致的；也就是说，这条公理不可否证。同样，康托尔的猜想，即连续统假设——ℵ0与2ℵ0（它就是c，即所有实数的基数）之间不存在基数，或者说，不存在基数小于2ℵ0的不可数实数集合——甚至广义连续统假设*，也与策梅洛－弗兰克尔体系一致，即使该体系包含选择公理。换句话说，这些断言不可否证。为了证明这些结果，哥德尔构建了使这些断言成立的模型。

In The Consistency of the Axiom of Choice and of the Generalized Continuum Hypothesis with the Axioms of Set Theory (1940), Godel proved that, if the Zermelo-Fraenkel system of axioms without the axiom of choice is consistent, then the system obtained by adjoining this axiom is consistent; that is, the axiom cannot be disproved. Likewise, Cantor’s conjecture, the continuum hypothesis—that there is no cardinal number between ℵ0 and 2ℵ0 (which is the same as c, the cardinal number of all real numbers), or that there is no non-denumerable set of real numbers that has a cardinal number less than 2ℵ0—(and even the generalized continuum hypothesis)is consistent with the Zermelo-Fraenkel system even if the axiom of choice is included. In other words these assertions cannot be disproved. To prove his results Godel constructed models in which these assertions hold.

选择公理和连续统假设这两个断言的一致性，多少令人安心。于是，使用它们至少可以和使用其他策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理一样放心。

The consistency of these two assertions, the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis, was somewhat reassuring. One could use them, then, at least as confidently as one could use the other Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms.

*广义连续统假设说，一个集合的所有子集构成的集合，若原集合的基数是ℵn，则其基数，即2ℵn，是ℵn+1。康托尔曾证明

*The generalized continuum hypothesis says that the set of all subsets of a set that has the cardinal number ℵn, that is, 2ℵn, is ℵn+1. Cantor had proved that

2ℵn>ℵn.

2ℵn>ℵn.

但接下来的发展击碎了数学家可能已有的自满。哥德尔的结果并未排除这样一种可能：选择公理和连续统假设中的一个或两个，可以根据其他策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理证明。至少选择公理不能据此证明的想法，早在1922年就有人提出。那一年及随后数年，几个人，包括弗兰克尔本人，都给出了选择公理独立性的证明，但每个人都发现，必须在策梅洛－弗兰克尔体系中加入某条辅助公理，才能完成证明。后来其他几个人的证明，也受到大致相同的质疑。哥德尔在1947年猜想，连续统假设也独立于策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理和选择公理。

But the complacency of mathematicians, if they had become complacent, was shattered by the next development. Godel’s results did not exclude the possibility that either or both of the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis could be proved on the basis of the other Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms. The thought that at least the axiom of choice cannot be proved on this basis was voiced'as far back as 1922. In that year and in subsequent years, several men, including Fraenkel himself, gave proofs that the axiom of choice is independent, but each found it necessary to add some subsidiary axiom to the Zermelo-Fraenkel system in order to make the proof. Later proofs by several men were subject to about the same objection. Godel conjectured in 1947 that the continuum hypothesis is also independent of the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms and the axiom of choice.

随后，1963年，斯坦福大学数学教授保罗·科恩（1934—2007）证明：如果其他策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理一致，那么选择公理和连续统假设都独立于它们；也就是说，这两个断言都不能根据其他策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理证明。此外，即使在策梅洛－弗兰克尔体系中保留选择公理，连续统假设仍不能证明（当然，广义连续统假设也不能证明）。（然而，不含选择公理、但含广义连续统假设的策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理，确实蕴涵选择公理。）这两个独立性结果意味着，在策梅洛－弗兰克尔体系中，选择公理和连续统假设是不可判定的。特别就连续统假设而言，科恩的结果意味着，在ℵ0与2ℵ0即c之间，可以有一个超限数，尽管并不知道哪个对象集合可能具有这样的超限数。

Then in 1963, Paul Cohen (1934-2007), a professor of mathematics at Stanford University, proved that both the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis are independent of the other Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms if the latter are consistent; that is, the two assertions cannot be proved on the basis of the other Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms. Moreover, even if the axiom of choice is retained in the Zermelo-Fraenkel system, the continuum hypothesis (and certainly then the generalized continuum hypothesis) could not be proved. (Flowever, the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms without the axiom of choice but with the generalized continuum hypothesis do imply the axiom of choice.) The two independence results mean that in the Zermelo-Fraenkel system the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis are undecidable. In particular, for the continuum hypothesis Cohen’s result means that there can be a transfinite number between ℵ0 and 2ℵ0 or c, even though no set of objects is known which might have such a transfinite number.

科恩的方法称为力迫法，在原则上与其他独立性证明并无不同。我们可以回想，要证明欧几里得平行公理独立于欧几里得几何的其他公理，就要找出一个解释或模型，它满足其他公理，却不满足待考察的那条公理。*必须知道这个模型是一致的，否则它也可能满足待考察的公理。科恩的证明改进了弗兰克尔、哥德尔及其他人先前的证明，因为他只使用策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理，没有任何辅助条件。虽然此前已有选择公理独立性的证明，尽管不那么令人满意，但在科恩的工作之前，连续统假设的独立性还是一个悬而未决的问题。

In principle Cohen’s method, called the forcing method, was no different from other independence proofs. We may recall that to show the Euclidean parallel axiom is independent of the other axioms of Euclidean geometry, one finds an interpretation or model which satisfies the other axioms but does not satisfy the one in question.* The model must be known to be consistent, else it may also satisfy the axiom in question. Cohen’s proof improved on earlier ones of Fraenkel, Godel, and others, in that he used only the Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms with no subsidiary conditions. Whereas there had been earlier proofs, though less satisfactory, of the independence of the axiom of choice, the independence of the continuum hypothesis was an open question before Cohen’s work.

*群论中乘法的交换公理独立于群的其他公理。有满足交换公理的群模型，例如通常的正整数和负整数，也有不满足交换公理的模型，例如四元数。

"The commutative axiom of multiplication in group theory is independent of the other axioms of a group. There are models of groups which do satisfy it, as, for example, the ordinary positive and negative integers, and there are models that do not, for example, quaternions.

因此，如果把数学建立在集合论之上（甚至建立在逻辑主义或形式主义基础上），可以采取几种立场。可以避免使用选择公理和连续统假设。这一决定会限制能够证明的定理。《数学原理》并未把选择公理列为逻辑原则，却在某些定理的证明中明确说明使用了它。事实上，它在现代数学中具有基础地位。也可以采用其中任意一条或两条公理，还可以否定其中任意一条或两条。要否定选择公理，可以假定，即使对于可数个集合组成的族，也不存在明确的选择。要否定连续统假设，可以假定2ℵ0=ℵ2，或2ℵ0=ℵ3。事实上，科恩正是这样做的，并给出了一个模型。

Thus, if one builds mathematics on set theory (or even on the logistic or formalist bases), one can take several positions. One can avoid using the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis. This decision would restrict the theorems that can be proved. Principia Mathematica does not include the axiom of choice among its logical principles but does use it in the proofs of some theorems where it is explicitly stated. It is, in fact, basic in modern mathematics. Alternatively, one can adopt either one or both of the axioms. And one can deny either one or both. To deny the axiom of choice one can assume that even for a countable collection of sets there is no explicit choice. To deny the continuum hypothesis one can assume 2ℵ0 = ℵ2 or 2ℵ0 = ℵ3. This was, in fact, done by Cohen and he gave a model.

于是就存在多种数学。集合论（不论其他数学基础）可以沿许多方向发展。此外，可以只对有限多个集合使用选择公理，或对可数多个集合使用，当然也可以对任意多个集合使用。数学家对于这条公理，已经采取了这些立场中的每一种。

There are then many mathematics. There are numerous directions in which set theory (apart from other foundations of mathematics) can go. Moreover, one can use the axiom of choice for only a finite number of sets, or a denumerable number of sets, or of course for any number of sets. Mathematicians have taken each of these positions on the axiom.

随着科恩的独立性证明，数学陷入了与非欧几里得几何创立时一样令人不安的困境。我们知道（第八章），欧几里得平行公理独立于其他欧几里得公理这一事实，使构建几种非欧几里得几何成为可能。科恩的结果提出了这样一个问题：对于这两条公理的许多可能版本，数学家应当作何选择？即使只考虑集合论方案，选择的多样性也令人困惑。

With Cohen’s independence proofs, mathematics reached a plight as disturbing as at the creation of non-Euclidean geometry. As we know (Chapter VIII), the fact that the Euclidean parallel axiom is independent of the other Euclidean axioms made possible the construction of several non-Euclidean geometries. Cohen’s results raise the issue: which choice among the many possible versions of the two axioms should mathematicians make? Even if one considers only the set-theoretic approach, the variety of choices is bewildering.

决定采用许多选择中的哪一种，不能轻率，因为每一种情形都有正面的和负面的后果，都是如此。如前所述，不使用其中任何公理，也就是说，既不肯定也不否定，就会严重限制能够证明的内容，并迫使我们排除现有数学中许多被视为基础的东西。甚至要证明任何无限集合S都有一个可数无限子集，也需要选择公理。需要选择公理的那些定理，在现代分析、拓扑学、抽象代数、超限数理论及其他领域中，都是根本性的。因此，不接受这条公理，就束缚了数学的手脚。

The decision as to which of the many choices to adopt cannot be made lightly because there are both positive and negative consequences in each case. To refrain from using either axiom, that is, to avoid any affirmation or denial would, as noted, limit severely what can be proved and force exclusion of much that has been regarded as basic in the existing mathematics. Even to prove that any infinite set S has a denumerable or countable infinite subset requires the axiom of choice. The theorems that require the axiom of choice are fundamental in modern analysis, topology, abstract algebra, the theory of transfinite numbers, and other areas. Thus, not to accept the axiom hobbles mathematics.

另一方面，采用选择公理，可以证明一些至少可以说违背直觉的定理。其中一个称为巴拿赫－塔尔斯基悖论。可以这样描述它：给定任意两个实心球，一个与棒球一样大，另一个与地球一样大，棒球和地球都可以分成有限多个互不重叠的小实心块，使一个球的每一部分都与另一个球的唯一一部分全等。也可以这样陈述这一悖论：可以把整个地球分成小块，只须重新排列这些小块，就能组成一个棒球大小的球体。1914年发现的一个特殊情形是，一个球面可以分成两部分，然后重新组装成两个完整球面，每个的半径都与原球面相同。这些悖论与20世纪初集合论中遇到的悖论不同，并不是矛盾。它们是集合论公理和选择公理的逻辑后果。

On the other hand by adopting the axiom of choice one can prove theorems which to say the least defy intuition. One of these is known as the Banach-Tarski paradox. One may describe this in the following way: Given any two solid spheres, one the size of a baseball and the other the size of the earth, both the ball and the earth can be divided into a finite number of non-overlapping little solid pieces, so that each part of one is congruent to one and only one part of the other. Alternatively, one can state the paradox thus: One can divide the entire earth up into little pieces and merely by rearranging them make up a sphere the size of a ball. A special case of this paradox discovered in 1914 is that a sphere’s surface may be decomposed into two parts which can be reassembled to give two complete spherical surfaces, each of the same radius as the original sphere. These paradoxes, unlike the ones encountered in set theory of the early 1900s, are not contradictions. They are logical consequences of the axioms of set theory and the axiom of choice.

否定一般的选择公理，会产生更奇怪的后果。一个也许对专业人士更有意义的技术结果是，每个直线上的集合都是可测的。或者说，既然选择公理蕴涵不可测集合的存在，就可以通过假定每个直线上的集合都可测来否定选择公理。超限基数也会出现其他奇怪后果。至于连续统假设，这里我们进入未知领域，无论肯定还是否定它，迄今都不知道有什么重大后果。不过，如果假定2ℵ0=ℵ2，那么每个实数集合都是可测的。还可以推导出许多其他新结论，但它们并不关键。

Stranger consequences result from denial of the general axiom of choice. One technical result, perhaps more meaningful to professionals, is that every linear set is measurable. Or, since the axiom of choice implies the existence of non-measurable sets, one can deny the axiom of choice by assuming that every linear set is measurable. Other strange consequences hold for transfinite cardinal numbers. As for the continuum hypothesis, here one ventures into the unknown and, whether one affirms or denies it, significant consequences are not known as yet. But if one assumes that 2ℵ0 = ℵ2, then every set of real numbers is measurable. One can also derive many other new conclusions. But they are not crucial.

正如关于平行公理的工作导致几何分道扬镳一样，科恩关于这两条集合公理的工作，导致尤其以集合论为基础的全部数学走向多重分岔，尽管它也影响其他基础方案。它为数学开启了几个可能的方向，却没有提供任何明显的理由，使人偏爱某个方向而不选另一个。实际上，自科恩1963年的工作以来，人们又发现许多在策梅洛－弗兰克尔集合论中不可判定的命题；因此，使用基本的策梅洛－弗兰克尔公理，再加上一个或多个不可判定命题，所能作出的选择之繁多，令人迷惑。选择公理与连续统假设的独立性证明，相当于告诉建筑者，只要稍微修改计划，他就能建成一座城堡，而不是一幢办公楼。

Just as the work on the parallel axiom led to the parting of the ways for geometry, so Cohen’s work on these two axioms about sets leads to a manifold parting of the ways for all of mathematics based especially on set theory, though it also affects other foundational approaches. It opens up several directions that mathematics can take but provides no obvious reason for preferring one over another. Actually, since Cohen’s work of 1963, many more propositions undecidable in the Zermelo-Fraenkel set theory have been discovered so that the variety of choices one can make using the basic Zermelo-Fraenkel axioms and one or more of the undecidable propositions is bewildering. The independence proofs of the axiom of choice and the continuum hypothesis amount to showing a builder that by changing his plans slightly he can build a castle instead of an office building.

当前的集合论研究者希望，能以某种可靠方式修改集合论公理，从而确定选择公理、连续统假设，或两者，能否从数学家广泛接受的一组公理中推出。在哥德尔看来，这些可能性肯定应该能够实现。已有大量努力，但迄今没有成功。也许有一天，人们会就应使用什么公理达成共识。

Current workers in set theory hope that they can modify the axioms of set theory in some sound fashion so as to determine whether the axiom of choice or the continuum hypothesis or both can be deduced from a set of axioms widely accepted by mathematicians. In Godel’s opinion, these possibilities should surely be realizable. The efforts have been numerous but thus far unsuccessful. Perhaps some day there will be a consensus on what axioms to use.

使数学家迷惑的，不只是哥德尔、丘奇和科恩的工作。随着岁月流逝，他们的烦恼越来越多。利奥波德·勒文海姆（1878—约1940）于1915年开始的研究，由托拉尔夫·斯科伦（1887—1963）在1920至1933年的一系列论文中简化并完成，揭示了数学结构中的新缺陷。现在所谓勒文海姆－斯科伦理论的实质是这样：假设为一个数学分支，或为作为整个数学基础的集合论，建立逻辑公理和数学公理。最切题的例子是整数的公理组。原意是让这些公理完全刻画正整数，而且只刻画整数。但令人惊讶的是，人们发现能找到差异极大的解释——模型——却仍满足这些公理。因此，整数集合虽然可数，或者用康托尔的记号说，只有ℵ0个整数，却存在包含与所有实数一样多的元素、甚至在超限意义上更大集合的解释。反过来的现象也会发生。也就是说，假定采用一个集合理论的公理体系，原意是让这些公理允许、乃至刻画不可数的集合族，但仍能找到一个满足该公理体系的可数集合族，以及其他与原意迥然不同的超限解释。事实上，每个一致的公理体系都有一个可数模型。

Godel’s, Church’s, and Cohen’s works were not the only ones to bewilder mathematicians. Their troubles were multiplied during the passing years. The research begun in 1915 by Leopold Lowenheim (1878-c. 1940), and simplified and completed by Thoralf Skolem (1887- 1963) in a series of papers from 1920 to 1933, disclosed new flaws in the structure of mathematics. The substance of what is now known as the Lowenheim-Skolem theory is this. Suppose one sets up axioms, logical and mathematical, for a branch of mathematics or for set theory as a foundation for all of mathematics. The most pertinent example is the set of axioms for the whole numbers. One intends that these axioms should completely characterize the positive whole numbers and only the whole numbers. But, surprisingly, one discovers that one can find interpretations—models—that are drastically different and yet satisfy the axioms. Thus, whereas the set of whole numbers is countable, or, in Cantor s notation, there are only X0 of them, there are interpretations that contain as many elements as the set of all real numbers, and even sets larger in the transfinite sense. The converse phenomenon also occurs. That is, suppose one adopts a system of axioms for a theory of sets and one intends that these axioms should permit and indeed characterize non-denumerable collections of sets. One can, nevertheless, find a countable (denumerable) collection of sets that satisfies the system of axioms and other transfinite interpretations quite different from the one intended. In fact, every consistent system of axioms has a countable model.

这意味着什么？假定一个人列出一张特征表，自认为这些特征刻画美国人，而且只刻画美国人。但令人惊讶的是，有人发现一种动物，它具备表上的所有特征，同时又具有与美国人完全不同的特征。换句话说，设计用来刻画唯一一类数学对象的公理体系，并未达到目的。哥德尔不完备性定理告诉我们，一组公理不足以证明它本意所涵盖的数学分支中的全部定理；勒文海姆－斯科伦定理则告诉我们，一组公理允许的解释，比原来想要的解释多出许多，而且本质上不同。公理不能限制解释或模型。因此，数学现实无法毫无歧义地纳入公理体系。*

What does this mean? Suppose one were to set down a list of the features which, he believes, characterize Americans and only Americans. But, surprisingly, someone discovers a species of animal which possesses all the characteristics on the list but also totally different features from Americans. In other words, axiom systems that are designed to characterize a unique class of mathematical objects do not do so. Whereas Godel’s incompleteness theorem tells us that a set of axioms is not adequate to prove all the theorems belonging to the branch of mathematics that the axioms are intended to cover, the Lowenheim-Skolem theorem tells us that a set of axioms permits many more essentially different interpretations than the one intended. The axioms do not limit the interpretations or models. Hence mathematical reality cannot be unambiguously incorporated in axiomatic systems.*

非预期解释之所以可能，一个原因是每个公理体系都包含未定义术语。以前，人们认为公理隐含地“定义”了这些术语。但公理并不足够。因此，必须以某种目前还无法预见的方式，改变未定义术语的概念。

One reason that unintended interpretations are possible is that each axiomatic system contains undefined terms. Formerly, it was thought that the axioms “defined” these terms implicitly. But the axioms do not suffice. Hence the concept of undefined terms must be altered in some as yet unforeseeable way.

勒文海姆－斯科伦定理与哥德尔不完备性定理一样惊人。它是对公理方法的又一次打击；从1900年直到近年，公理方法似乎一直是唯一可靠的方案，而且逻辑主义者、形式主义者和集合论者至今仍然使用它。

The Lowenheim-Skolem theorem is as startling as Godel’s incompleteness theorem. It is another blow to the axiomatic method which from 1900 even to recent times seemed to be the only sound approach, and is still the one employed by the logicists, formalists, and set-theorists.

勒文海姆－斯科伦定理也不是完全意外。哥德尔不完备性定理确实说，每个公理体系都是不完备的。存在不可判定命题。假设p是一个这样的命题。那么，p和非p都不能由公理推出，它是独立的。因此，可以采用一个更大的公理体系，即原公理组加p，或原公理组加非p。这两个公理体系不会是范畴的，因为它们的解释不可能同构。也就是说，不完备性蕴涵非范畴性。但勒文海姆－斯科伦定理以强得多、或更根本的方式否定范畴性。它确立了：无需增加任何新公理，一个给定公理体系就存在迥然不同的解释或模型。当然，必然存在不完备性，否则不可能有迥然不同的解释。某个解释中的某个有意义陈述必定不可判定，否则它就会在两个解释中都成立。

The Lowenheim-Skolem theorem is not totally surprising. Godel’s incompleteness theorem does say that every axiomatic system is incomplete. There are undecidable propositions. Suppose p is one such proposition. Then neither p nor not p follows from the axioms. It is independent. Hence one could adopt a larger system of axioms, the original set and p, or the original set and not p. These two axiom systems would not be categorical because the interpretations could not be isomorphic. That is, incompleteness implies non-categoricalness. But the Lowenheim-Skolem theorem denies categoricalness in a far stronger or more radical way. It establishes the existence of interpretations or models of a given axiom system that, without adding any new axiom, are radically different. Of course, incompleteness must be present, else radically different interpretations would not be possible. Some meaningful statement of one interpretation must be undecidable, else it would hold in both interpretations.

*较早的教科书确曾“证明”基本体系是范畴的；也就是说，任何基本公理体系的所有解释都是同构的——它们本质上相同，只是术语不同。但这些“证明”并不严密，因为其中使用了希尔伯特元数学不允许的逻辑原则，而且当时公理基础的表述不如今天谨慎。没有任何公理组是范畴的，尽管希尔伯特和其他人作过“证明”。

*Oider texts did “prove” that the basic systems were categorical; that is, all the interpretations of any basic axiom system are isomorphic—they are essentially the same but differ in terminology. But the “proofs” were loose in that logical principles were used that are not allowed in Hilbert’s metamathematics and the axiomatic bases were not as carefully formulated then as now. No set of axioms is categorical, despite “proofs” by Hilbert and others.

斯科伦在思考自己的结果之后，于1923年的一篇论文中，贬低了作为集合论基础的公理方法。甚至冯·诺伊曼也在1925年承认，他自己以及其他集合论公理体系的公理，带有“非现实性的印记……不存在集合论的范畴公理化……既然不存在一个不预先假定集合论的数学、几何等公理体系，那么当然也不会有范畴的无限公理体系”。他接着说，这种情况“在我看来，是支持直觉主义的一个论据”。

After contemplating his own result, Skolem in a paper of 1923 deprecated the axiomatic method as a foundation for set theory. Even von Neumann agreed in 1925 that the axioms of his own and other axiom systems for set theory bore “the stamp of unreality. . . . No categorical axiomatization of the theory of sets exists. . . . Since there exists no axiom system for mathematics, geometry, etc., which does not assume the theory of sets, so will there certainly be no categorical axiomatic infinite systems.” This circumstance, he continued, “appears to me to be an argument for intuitionism.”

数学家试图通过回顾非欧几里得几何的历史来使自己平静。在与平行公理斗争许多世纪之后，罗巴切夫斯基和鲍耶建立了非欧几里得几何，黎曼又指出另一种非欧几里得几何。数学家起初倾向于以多种理由否定这些新几何，其中一个理由是它们必定不一致。然而，后来作出的解释表明，它们是一致的。例如，黎曼的双椭圆几何原本打算用于通常平面中的图形，却被解释为涉及球面上的图形，这与最初的意图很不相同（第八章）。不过，这个模型或解释的发现受到欢迎，因为它证明了一致性。此外，它并未造成黎曼原意中的对象——点、直线、平面、三角形等——与解释中这些对象的数量差异。用数学语言说，这两种解释是同构的。然而，勒文海姆－斯科伦定理所涵盖的公理体系的解释并不同构；它们迥然不同。

Mathematicians have tried to calm themselves by recalling the history of non-Euclidean geometry. When after many centuries of struggle with the parallel axiom, Lobatchevsky and Bolyai produced their non-Euclidean geometry and Riemann pointed at another such geometry, mathematicians at first were inclined to dismiss these new geometries on several grounds, one being that they must be inconsistent. However, interpretations made later showed that they were consistent. For example, Riemann’s double elliptic geometry, though intended to apply to figures in the ordinary flat plane, was interpreted to refer to figures on the surface of a sphere, a quite different interpretation from the one originally intended (Chapter VIII). However, the discovery of this model or interpretation was welcomed. It proved consistency. Moreover, it did not introduce a discrepancy between the number of objects, points, lines, planes, triangles, etc. intended by Riemann and those in the interpretation. The two interpretations, in the language of mathematics, were isomorphic. However, the interpretations of axiom systems covered by the Lowenheim-Skolem theorem are not isomorphic; they are drastically different.

庞加莱谈到数学的抽象性时，曾说数学是给不同事物取同一个名字的艺术。例如，群的概念表示整数、加法下的矩阵以及几何变换的性质*。勒文海姆－斯科伦定理支持庞加莱的说法，却背离了其含义。群公理本来就不打算规定所有解释具有相同的规模和性质——群公理不是范畴的，如果去掉平行公理，欧几里得几何也不是——而勒文海姆－斯科伦定理适用的公理体系，原本打算指定一个特定解释；发现它们也适用于完全不同的解释，就挫败了它们的目的。

Poincare, referring to the abstractness of mathematics, once said that mathematics is the art of giving the same name to different things. Thus, the notion of a group represents properties* of the whole numbers, matrices under addition, and geometric transformations. The Lowenheim-Skolem theorem supports Poincare’s statement but controverts its meaning. Whereas the group axioms were not intended to specify that all interpretations were of the same extent and character—the group axioms are not categorical nor is Euclidean geometry if we omit the parallel axiom—the axiom systems to which the Lowenheim-Skolem theorem applies were intended to specify one particular interpretation, and the discovery that they apply to radically different ones confounds their purpose.

诸神想毁灭谁，先使谁发疯。也许诸神不确定哥德尔、科恩、勒文海姆和斯科伦的工作是否足以奏效，于是又启动了一项发展，更可能把数学家推过崩溃的边缘。莱布尼茨在他的微积分方案中，引入了称为无穷小的量（第六章）。对莱布尼茨来说，无穷小是不为零、却小于0.1、0.01、0.001、……以及任何其他正数的量。此外，他主张，可以像普通数一样对这些无穷小进行运算。它们是理想元素或虚构物，却很有用。事实上，两个这样的无穷小之商，在莱布尼茨看来就是导数，即微积分的基本概念。莱布尼茨也把无穷大的数当作普通数使用。

Whom the gods would destroy they first make mad. Perhaps because the gods were not sure that the work of Godel, Cohen, and Lowenheim and Skolem would do the trick, they set in motion one more development that would be more likely to send mathematicians over the brink. In his approach to the calculus, Leibniz introduced quantities called infinitesimals (Chapter VI). An infinitesimal for Leibniz was a quantity not zero but smaller than .1, .01, .001, •••, and any other positive number. Moreover, he maintained, one could operate with such infinitesimals as one operates with ordinary numbers. They were ideal elements or fictions, but they were useful. In fact, the quotient of two such infinitesimals was for Leibniz the derivative, the fundamental concept of the calculus. Leibniz also used infinitely large numbers as ordinary numbers.

整个18世纪，数学家都在与无穷小概念搏斗，按照任意甚至不合逻辑的规则使用它们，最后把它们当作无稽之谈而抛弃。柯西的工作不仅驱逐了它们，而且消除了对它们的任何需要。不过，无穷小能否获得合法地位的问题仍不断出现。当约斯塔·米塔格－莱夫勒（1846—1927）问康托尔，在有理数与实数之间是否可能有其他种类的数时，康托尔坚决回答没有。1887年，他发表了一个证明，说明无穷小在逻辑上不可能；这个证明主要依赖所谓阿基米德公理，它断言，给定任何实数a，都存在整数n，使na大于任何另一个给定实数b。皮亚诺也发表了一个证明，论证无穷小不存在。伯特兰·罗素在《数学原则》（1903年）中赞同这一结论。

Throughout the eighteenth century, mathematicians struggled with the concept of infinitesimals, used them in accordance with arbitrary and even illogical rules, and ended up by rejecting them as nonsense. Cauchy’s work not only banished them but disposed of any need for them. However, the issue of whether infinitesimals can be legitimized kept cropping up. When Gosta Mittag-Leffler (1846-1927) asked Cantor if there might be other kinds of numbers between the rationals and the reals, Cantor answered emphatically with a no. In 1887 he published a proof of the logical impossibility of infinitesimals that depended essentially on what is called the Archimedean axiom, which asserts that, given any real number a, there is a whole number n such that na is larger than any other given real number b. Peano, too, published a proof that demonstrated the non-existence of infinitesimals. Bertrand Russell in his Principles of Mathematics (1903) agreed with this conclusion.

然而，即使是真正伟大人物的信念，也不应轻易接受。在亚里士多德时代及此后很长时期，许多思想家把地球是球形的观念当作胡说而否定，因为住在球体另一面的人会头朝下悬在空中。但球形最终被证明是正确概念。同样，尽管有证明认为必须驱逐莱布尼茨的无穷小，一些人仍坚持尝试建立这些实体的逻辑理论。

However, the convictions of even truly great men should not be accepted too readily. In Aristotle’s days and long thereafter, the notion that the earth is spherical was dismissed by many thinkers as nonsense because people living on the opposite side of the sphere would have their heads hanging in the air. Yet sphericity proved to be the proper concept. Likewise, despite the proofs that Leibniz’s infinitesimals must be banished, a number of men persisted in trying to build up a logical theory of such entities.

保罗·杜布瓦－雷蒙、奥托·施托尔茨和费利克斯·克莱因，确实认为基于无穷小的一致理论是可能的。事实上，克莱因指出了为得到这种理论必须放弃的那条实数公理，即阿基米德公理。斯科伦本人在1934年开始引入不同于普通实数的新数——超整数，并确立了它们的一些性质。几位数学家一系列论文的最终成果，是创建了一种使无穷小合法化的新理论。最重要的贡献者是亚伯拉罕·鲁滨逊

Paul du Bois-Reymond, Otto Stolz, and Felix Klein did think that a consistent theory based on infinitesimals was possible. In fact, Klein identified the very axiom of real numbers, the Archimedean axiom, that would have to be abandoned to obtain such a theory. Skolem himself in 1934 began the introduction of new numbers—hyperintegers—which were different from the ordinary real numbers, and he established some of their properties. The culmination of a series of papers by several mathematicians was the creation of a new theory which legitimizes infinitesimals. The most important contributor was Abraham Robinson

（1918—1974）。

(1918–1974).

这个新体系称为非标准分析，引入超实数，包括原有的实数和无穷小。无穷小的定义几乎和莱布尼茨的一样：正无穷小是小于任何普通正实数而大于零的数；同样，负无穷小是大于任何负实数而小于零的数。这些无穷小是固定的数，不是莱布尼茨意义上的变量，也不是趋于零的变量，后者是柯西有时使用这个词的含义。此外，非标准分析引入新的无穷大的数，它们是无穷小的倒数，却不是康托尔的超限数。每个有限超实数r都具有x+a的形式，其中x是普通实数，a是无穷小。

The new system, called non-standard analysis, introduces hyperreal numbers, which include the old real numbers and infinitesimals. An infinitesimal is defined practically as Leibniz did; that is, a positive infinitesimal is a number less than any ordinary positive real number but greater than zero and, similarly, a negative infinitesimal is greater than any negative real number but less than zero. These infinitesimals are fixed numbers, not variables in Leibniz’s sense nor variables which approach zero, which is the sense in which Cauchy sometimes used the term. Moreover, non-standard analysis introduces new infinite numbers, which are the reciprocals of the infinitesimals but not the transfinite numbers of Cantor. Every finite hyperreal number r is of the form x + a where x is an ordinary real number and a is an infinitesimal.

有了无穷小概念，就可以说两个超实数无限接近。这只意味着它们的差是无穷小。每个超实数也无限接近某个（普通）实数，二者之差是一个无穷小。我们可以像对普通实数那样对超实数进行运算。*

With the notion of infinitesimal, one can speak of two hyperreal numbers being infinitely close. This means merely that their difference is an infinitesimal. Every hyperreal number is also infinitely close to an (ordinary) real number, the difference being an infinitesimal. We can operate with the hyperreals just as we operate with the ordinary real numbers.*

利用这个新的超实数系，可以引入取值为普通实数或超实数的函数。用这些数，可以重新定义函数的连续性。例如，若x−a为无穷小时，f(x)−f(a)也为无穷小，则f(x)在x=a处连续。也可以用超实数定义导数及其他微积分概念，并证明分析的全部结果。最重要的是，利用超实数体系，我们能够使一种此前被斥为含糊甚至无稽之谈、因而遭到驱逐的微积分方案变得精确。†

With this new hyperreal number systerp, we can introduce functions whose values may be ordinary or hyperreal numbers. In terms of these numbers, we can redefine the continuity of a function. Thus f(x) is continuous at x = a if f(x) - f(a) is an infinitesimal when x - a is. We can use the hyperreals to define also the derivative and other calculus concepts and prove all the results of analysis. The major point is that with the system of hyperreals we can give precision to an approach to the calculus that had previously been banished as unclear and even nonsense.t

使用这个新数系会增强数学的力量吗？目前，通过这种手段还没有产生任何重要的新结果。重要的是，又一条新路已经开启，一些数学家将热切地沿它前进；事实上，非标准分析的书籍已经开始出现。其他人则会基于这样或那样的理由谴责这种新分析。物理学家松了一口气，因为他们明知无穷小已被柯西驱逐，却仍为了方便继续使用它们。

Will the use of this new number system increase the power of mathematics? At the present time, no new results of any consequence have been produced through this means. What is significant is that another new road has been opened up which some mathematicians will travel eagerly; in fact, books on non-standard analysis are already appearing. Others will condemn the new analysis on one ground or another. Physicists are relieved because they continued to use infinitesimals as a convenience even though they knew that infinitesimals had been banished by Cauchy.

1900年以来数学基础的发展令人迷惑，数学的现状反常而可悲。真理的光芒不再照亮前进道路。原先那唯一的、普遍受到赞赏和接受的数学整体，其证明虽然有时需要修订，却被看作可靠推理的顶峰；如今，取而代之的是互相冲突的数学方案。除逻辑主义、直觉主义和形式主义基础外，仅集合论方案就提供许多选项。甚至在其他学派内部，也可能存在分歧乃至冲突的立场。例如，直觉主义哲学内部的构造主义运动，分裂出许多小团体。在形式主义内部，必须选择可以采用哪些元数学原则。非标准分析虽然不是某个学派的学说，却为分析提供另一种方案，也可能导致分歧甚至冲突的观点。至少，原来被认为不合逻辑、应当驱逐的东西，如今被某些学派接受为逻辑上可靠。

The developments in the foundations of mathematics since 1900 are bewildering, and the present state of mathematics is anomalous and deplorable. The light of truth no longer illuminates the road to follow. In place of the unique, universally admired and universally accepted body of mathematics whose proofs, though sometimes requiring emendation, were regarded as the acme of sound reasoning, we now have conflicting approaches to mathematics. Beyond the logicist, intuitionist, and formalist bases, the approach through set theory alone gives many options. Some divergent and even conflicting positions are possible even within the other schools. Thus the constructivist movement within the intuitionist philosophy has many splinter groups. Within formalism there are choices to be made about what principles of metamathematics may be employed. Non-standard analysis, though not a doctrine of any one school, permits an alternative approach to analysis which may also lead to diverging and even conflicting views. At the very least what was considered to be illogical and to be banished is now accepted by some schools as logically sound.

*若使用实数通常的公理性质，康托尔和皮亚诺的证明是正确的。为了容许超实数，必须改变的性质，就是上述阿基米德公理。R*，即超实数系，在通常意义上是非阿基米德的。但如果我们允许超实数系中的数a*具有无穷倍数，它就是阿基米德的。

' The proofs of Cantor and Peano are correct if one uses the usual axiomatic properties of real numbers. The property that must be altered to allow hyperreal numbers is the axiom of Archimedes described above. R*, the system of hyperreals, is non-Archimedean in the usual sense. But it is Archimedean if we allow infinite multiples of a number a* of the system of hyperreal numbers.

†例如，在非标准分析中，无穷小之商dy/dx存在于体系R*中；对于y=x2，dy/dx为2x+dx，其中dx是一个无穷小。也就是说，dy/dx是一个超实数。但导数是这个超实数的标准部分，即2x。同样，定积分是无限多个无穷小之和的标准部分，求和项的个数本身是一个非标准自然数。

fFor example, in non-standard analysis the quotient of infinitesimals dy/dx exists in the system R*, and dy/dx for y = x2 is 2x + dx where dx is an infinitesimal. That is, dy/dx is a hyperreal number. But the derivative is the standard part of this hyperreal number, namely, 2x. Similarly, the definite integral is the standard part of a sum of an infinite number of infinitesimals, the number of summands being itself a non-standard natural number.

消除可能的矛盾、确立数学结构一致性的努力，迄今已经失败。对于应当接受公理方案——如果接受，又应采用哪些公理——还是接受非公理的直觉主义方案，已经没有一致意见。流行的数学概念，即把数学视为各自以自身公理组为基础的结构汇集，不足以包含数学应当包含的全部东西，另一方面又包含了超出其应有范围的东西。现在，分歧甚至扩展到推理方法。排中律不再是不容质疑的逻辑原则；存在性证明若不允许计算所确立存在的量，无论是否使用排中律，都成为争论焦点。因此，必须放弃推理无懈可击的声称。显然，多种选择将产生不同的数学整体。近来的基础研究突破了边界，却只遇到一片荒野。

The efforts to eliminate possible contradictions and establish the consistency of the mathematical structures have thus far failed. There is no longer any agreement on whether to accept the axiomatic approach—or, if so, with which axioms—or the non-axiomatic intuitionist approach. The prevalent concept of mathematics as a collection of structures each based on its own set of axioms is inadequate to embrace all that mathematics should embrace, and on the other hand embraces more than it should. Disagreement now extends even to the methods of reasoning. The law of excluded middle is no longer an unquestionable principle of logic, and existence proofs which do not permit calculation of the quantities whose existence is being established, whether or not the proofs use the law of excluded middle, are bones of contention. The claim therefore to impeccable reasoning must be abandoned. Clearly, different bodies of mathematics will result from the multiplicity of choices. The recent research on foundations has broken through frontiers only to encounter a wilderness.

从1931年起，当我们描述的这些结果使逻辑主义者、形式主义者和集合论者心碎时，唯一还能保持几分镇定和自得的数学家，是直觉主义者。所有这些令智力巨人殚精竭虑的逻辑符号和原则的游戏，在他们看来都毫无意义。数学的一致性是明确的，因为直觉意义保证它。至于选择公理和连续统假设，它们是不可接受的，布劳威尔在1907年就已这样说过。不完备性以及不可判定命题的存在，不仅没有使他们不安，他们还可以理直气壮地说：我早就告诉过你们。然而，甚至直觉主义者也不愿把1900年前建立、却不满足其标准的全部数学内容都删去。他们断言，通过排中律来确立数学实体的存在是不可接受的；只有那些允许把所断言存在的量计算到任意所需精度的构造，才令人满意。因此，他们仍在为构造性的存在性证明而努力。

The only mathematicians who could retain some composure and smugness from 1931 on, during which time the results we have described were breaking the hearts of the logicists, formalists, and set-theorists, were the intuitionists. All the play with logical symbols and principles which taxed the minds of intellectual giants was to them nonsense. The consistency of mathematics was clear because the intuitive meaning guaranteed it. As for the axioms of choice and the continuum hypothesis, they were unacceptable, and Brouwer had said as much in 1907. Incompleteness and the existence of undecidable propositions not only did not disturb them, they could justifiably say I told you so. However, even the intuitionists were unwilling to expunge all of those portions of mathematics erected before 1900 that did not satisfy their standards. They had affirmed that it was unacceptable to establish the existence of mathematical entities by use of the law of excluded middle, and that only constructions that permitted one to calculate as accurately as one wishes the quantity whose existence is being affirmed are satisfactory. Hence they are still struggling with constructive existence proofs.

简言之，没有哪个学派有权声称自己代表数学。不幸的是，正如阿伦德·海廷在1960年指出的，1930年以来，友好合作的精神已被不可调和的争斗精神取代。

In short, no school has the right to claim that it represents mathematics. And unfortunately, as Arend Heyting remarked in 1960, since 1930 the spirit of friendly cooperation has been replaced by a spirit of implacable contention.

1901年，伯特兰·罗素说：“现代数学最主要的胜利之一，在于发现了数学究竟是什么。”今天，这些话使我们感到天真。除了当今各学派对于什么可被接受为数学存在差异之外，还可以预期未来会出现更多差异。现有学派关心的是为现有数学辩护。但只要看看希腊人的数学、17世纪的数学和19世纪的数学，就会看到戏剧性而根本性的变化。几个现代学派试图为1900年的数学辩护，它们可能适用于2000年的数学吗？直觉主义者确实把数学看作不断成长、发展的东西。但他们的“直觉”能否产生或提出历史上尚未发展出来的东西？甚至在1930年，肯定也不是如此。因此，看来数学基础将总是需要修订。

In 1901, Bertrand Russell said, “One of the chiefest triumphs of modern mathematics consists in having discovered what mathematics really is.” These words strike us as naive today. Beyond the differences in what is accepted as mathematics today by the several schools, one may expect more in the future. The existing schools have been concerned with justifying the existing mathematics. But if one looks at the mathematics of the Greeks, of the seventeenth century, and of the nineteenth century one sees dramatic and drastic changes. The several modern schools seek to justify the mathematics of 1900. Can they possibly serve for the mathematics of the year 2000? The intuitionists do think of mathematics as growing and developing. But would their “intuitions” ever generate or give forth what had not been historically developed? Certainly this was not true even in 1930. Hence it seems that revisions of the foundations will always be needed.

用一个故事最能概括本世纪与数学基础有关的发展。在莱茵河畔，一座美丽的城堡已屹立数百年。城堡的地窖里，住在那里的勤劳蜘蛛织起一张错综复杂的网。有一天，刮起大风，毁坏了蛛网。蜘蛛拼命工作，修补损坏。它们以为，支撑城堡的正是它们的蛛网。

The developments in this century bearing on the foundations of mathematics are best summarized in a story. On the banks of the Rhine, a beautiful castle had been standing for centuries. In the cellar of the castle, an intricate network of webbing had been constructed by industrious spiders who lived there. One day a strong wind sprang up and destroyed the web. Frantically the spiders worked to repair the damage. They thought it was their webbing that was holding up the castle.

第十三章 数学的孤立

XIII. The Isolation of Mathematics

我已决心只放弃抽象几何，也就是说，放弃研究那些只用于锻炼心智的问题，以便研究另一种以解释自然现象为目标的几何。

I have resolved to quit only abstract geometry, that is to say, the consideration of questions that serve only to exercise the mind, and this, in order to study another kind of geometry, which has for its object the explanation of the phenomena of nature.

勒内·笛卡尔

Rene Descartes

数学史充满辉煌成就，却也是一部灾难记录。真理的丧失当然是头等悲剧，因为真理是人最珍贵的财富，即使失去一个，也值得悲伤。人类推理的这一壮丽橱窗所展示的结构，绝非完美，而是被缺陷损坏，随时可能发现灾难性矛盾；认识到这一点，又是对数学地位的一次打击。但这些并非令人忧虑的唯一理由。过去一百年研究所采取的方向，使数学家产生严重疑虑，并引发分歧。大多数数学家已经退出现实世界，专心研究数学内部产生的问题。他们放弃了科学。这种方向变化，常被描述为从应用数学转向纯数学。但“纯粹”和“应用”这两个词，尽管我们仍将使用，并不能充分描述已经发生的事情。

The history of mathematics is crowned with glorious achievements but is also a record of calamities. The loss of truth is certainly a tragedy of the first magnitude, for truths are man’s dearest possessions and a loss of even one is cause for grief. The realization that the splendid showcase of human reasoning exhibits a by no means perfect structure but one marred by shortcomings and vulnerable to the discovery of disastrous contradictions at any time is another blow to the stature of mathematics. But these are not the only grounds for distress. Grave misgivings and cause for dissension among mathematicians stem from the direction which research of the past one hundred years has taken. Most mathematicians have withdrawn from the world to concentrate on problems generated within mathematics. They have abandoned science. This change in direction is often described as the turn to pure as opposed to applied mathematics. But these terms pure and applied, though we shall use them, do not quite describe what has been happening.

数学过去是什么？对过去的几代人而言，数学首先是人类为研究自然而创造的最精妙的工具。数学的主要概念、广泛的方法以及几乎全部主要定理，都是在这项工作中得出的。科学曾是数学的命脉与养料。数学家愿意与物理学家、天文学家、化学家和工程师合作，从事科学事业。事实上，在17、18世纪以及19世纪的大部分时期，数学与理论科学的区别很少被提及。许多主要数学家在天文学、力学、流体力学、电学、磁学和弹性理论方面的工作，远比他们在数学本身的工作伟大。数学同时是科学的女王和婢女。

What had mathematics been? To past generations, mathematics was first and foremost man’s finest creation for the investigation of nature. The major concepts, broad methods, and almost all the major theorems of mathematics were derived in the course of this work. Science had been the life blood and sustenance of mathematics. Mathematicians were willing partners with physicists, astronomers, chemists, and engineers in the scientific enterprise. In fact, during the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries and most of the nineteenth, the distinction between mathematics and theoretical science was rarely noted. And many of the leading mathematicians did far greater work in astronomy, mechanics, hydrodynamics, electricity, magnetism, and elasticity than they did in mathematics proper. Mathematics was simultaneously the queen and the handmaiden of the sciences.

我们已经叙述（第一至第四章），从希腊时代起，人们如何长期接续努力，从自然手中夺取它的数学秘密。这种献身于自然研究的态度，并不把全部应用数学限制为物理问题的求解。伟大的数学家常常超越眼前的科学问题。由于他们伟大，而且充分理解数学的传统作用，他们能够辨认出最终会在科学事业中显示重要性，或能阐明那些已成为自然研究工具的概念的研究方向。例如，庞加莱（1854—1912）多年致力于天文学，最著名的著作是三卷本《天体力学》；他认识到，有必要研究微分方程的新课题，最终可能推进天文学。

We have related (Chapters I—IV) the long succession of efforts from Greek times onward to wrest from nature its mathematical secrets. This devotion to the study of nature did not limit all applied mathematics to the solution of physical problems. The great mathematicians often transcended the immediate problems of science. Because they were great and fully understood the traditional role of mathematics, they could discern directions of investigation which would prove significant in the scientific enterprise or shed light on the concepts already instrumental in the investigation of nature. Thus Poincare (1854-1912), who devoted many years to astronomy and whose most celebrated work is the three-volume Celestial Mechanics, saw the need to pursue new themes in differential equations that might ultimately advance astronomy.

有些数学研究使一个已经证明有用的学科更加充实或完整。如果同一类型的微分方程出现在几种应用中，当然应当研究这种一般类型，或者发现改进的、一般的求解方法，或者尽可能了解整个解的类别。数学的一个特点是，正是它的抽象性，使它能够表示十分不同的物理事件。例如，水波、声波和无线电波，都由同一个偏微分方程表示，它实际上就叫波动方程。波动方程最初产生于声波研究；进一步研究方程本身所得的额外数学知识，可能有助于解决比如无线电波研究中出现的问题。由现实世界问题激发的丰富创造织锦，可以通过认识不同情境中相同的数学结构及其共同抽象基础，得到加强和阐明。

Some mathematical investigations round out or complete a subject which has been shown to be useful. If the same type of differential equation occurs in several applications, certainly the general type should be investigated either to discover an improved or general method of solution or to learn as much as possible about the entire class of solutions. It is characteristic of mathematics that its very abstractness enables it to represent quite diverse physical happenings. Thus, water waves, sound waves, and radio waves are all represented by one partial differential equation, known, in fact, as the wave equation. The additional mathematical knowledge gained by further investigation of the wave equation itself, which first arose in the investigation of sound waves, might prove useful in questions that arise in the investigation, say, of radio waves. The rich fabric of creations inspired by problems of the real world can be strengthened and illuminated by the recognition of identical mathematical structures in dissimilar situations and their common abstract basis.

柯西最先着手建立微分方程的存在性定理，目的是保证物理问题的数学表述确有解，使人可以放心地寻找那个解。因此，虽然这项工作完全是数学的，却具有更深一层的物理意义。康托尔的无限集合工作确实引出许多纯数学研究，但最初的动机，是回答关于极其有用的傅里叶级数这种无穷级数的未决问题。

The establishment of existence theorems of differential equations, first undertaken by Cauchy, was intended to guarantee that the mathematical formulations of physical problems do have a solution, so that one could confidently seek that solution. Hence, though this work is totally mathematical, it does have ulterior physical significance. Cantor’s work on infinite sets, which did lead to many investigations in pure mathematics, was motivated at the outset by his desire to answer open questions about the enormously useful infinite series called Fourier series.

数学的发展提示、甚至要求研究独立于科学的问题。我们已经看到（第八章），19世纪的数学家认识到许多概念含糊、论证松散。注入严密性的广泛运动本身，当然不是研究科学问题，随后各学派重建基础的尝试也不是。所有这些工作虽然致力于数学本身，却无疑是回应整个数学结构的迫切需要。

The development of mathematics has suggested and even demanded the pursuit of problems independent of science. We saw (Chapter VIII) that nineteenth-century mathematicians had recognized the vagueness of many concepts and the looseness of their arguments. The movement to instill rigor, an extensive one, was certainly not in itself the pursuit of scientific problems, nor were the subsequent attempts of the several schools to rebuild the foundations. All of this work, though devoted to mathematics proper, was certainly a response to urgent needs of the entire mathematical structure.

简言之，有许多纯粹数学的研究，是为了充实或巩固旧领域，甚至探索有望成为应用研究所必需的新领域。所有这些工作方向，都可以视为广义的应用数学。

In short, there are many purely mathematical investigations that round out or shore up old areas, or even explore new areas that give promise of being essential to the pursuit of applications. All of these directions of work can be regarded as applied mathematics in the broad sense.

那么，一百年前是否没有为数学自身而创造、与应用全无关系的数学呢？有的。最突出的是数论。虽然对毕达哥拉斯学派来说，研究整数就是研究物质对象的构成（第一章），但数论很快因其自身而引起兴趣，成为费马的主要研究课题。射影几何由文艺复兴艺术家为实现绘画的真实感而开创，随后吉拉尔·笛沙格和帕斯卡加以研究，以提供更好的欧几里得几何方法；到19世纪，它成了一种纯粹审美兴趣，尽管那时人们也因它与非欧几里得几何的重要联系而研究它。许多其他课题的研究，只因为数学家觉得有趣或具有挑战性。

Was there then before one hundred years ago no mathematics created for its own sake, with no relevance at all to applications? There was. The outstanding example is the theory of numbers. Though for the Pythagoreans the study of whole numbers was the study of the constitution of material objects (Chapter I), the theory of numbers soon became of interest for its own sake—a major subject with Fermat. Projective geometry, initiated by Renaissance artists to achieve realism in painting and taken up by Girard Desargues and Pascal to provide superior methodology in Euclidean geometry, became in the nineteenth century a purely aesthetic interest, though even then pursued also because it has important connections with non-Euclidean geometry. Many other themes were studied solely because mathematicians found them interesting or challenging.

不过，与科学完全无关的纯数学并非主要关切。它是一种爱好，是从科学提出的远为重要、更引人入胜的问题中暂时转移注意的消遣。费马虽是数论的奠基人，却把大部分精力用于创建解析几何、研究微积分问题以及光学（第六章）。他试图使帕斯卡和惠更斯对数论感兴趣，却没有成功。17世纪很少有人对这门学科感兴趣。

However, pure mathematics totally unrelated to science was not the main concern. It was a hobby, a diversion from the far more vital and intriguing problems posed by the sciences. Though Fermat was the founder of the theory of numbers, he devoted most of his efforts to the creation of analytic geometry, to problems of the calculus, and to optics (Chapter VI). He tried to interest Pascal and Huygens in the theory of numbers but failed. Very few men of the seventeenth century took any interest in that subject.

欧拉确实用过一些时间研究数论。但欧拉不仅是18世纪最卓越的数学家，也是最卓越的数学物理学家。他的工作范围，从解决物理问题的深刻数学方法，例如微分方程求解，一直到天文学、流体运动、船只与船帆设计、炮术、地图绘制、乐器理论和光学。

Euler did devote some time to the theory of numbers. But Euler was not only the supreme mathematician of the eighteenth century; he was the supreme mathematical physicist. His work ranged from deep mathematical methodologies for solving physical problems, such as the solution of differential equations, to astronomy, the motion of fluids, the design of ships and sails, artillery, map-making, the theory of musical instruments, and optics.

拉格朗日也花过一些时间研究数论，但他同样把一生的大部分时间献给分析，即对应用至关重要的数学（第三章）；他的杰作是《Mécanique analytique》（《分析力学》），将数学应用于力学。事实上，1777年他抱怨说：“算术研究耗费了我最多的心力，却也许最没有价值。”高斯也在数论中作出了杰出的工作。他的《Disquisitiones arithmeticae》（《算术研究》，1801年）是一部经典。如果只注意高斯这部作品，或许会相信他是纯数学家。但他的主要努力是在应用数学方面（第四章）。费利克斯·克莱因在其19世纪数学史中，把《算术研究》称为高斯青年时代的作品。

Lagrange also spent some time on the theory of numbers but he, too, devoted most of his life to analysis, the mathematics vital to applications (Chapter III), and his masterpiece was Mecanique analytique (Analytical Mechanics), the application of mathematics to mechanics. In fact, in 1777 he complained that “The arithmetical researches are those which have cost me most trouble and are perhaps the least valuable.” Gauss, too, did masterful work in the theory of numbers. His Disquisition.es aritbmeticae (Arithmetical Dissertations, 1801) is a classic. If one were to note just this work of Gauss, one might be convinced that Gauss was a pure mathematician. But his major efforts were in applied mathematics (Chapter IV). Felix Klein in his history of nineteenth-century mathematics refers to the Disquisitiones as a work of Gauss’s youth.

高斯晚年虽重返数论，但显然不把它视为最重要的学科。证明费马最后“定理”的问题，常被摆到他面前；该定理说，当n大于2时，没有整数满足xn+yn=zn。但高斯在1816年3月21日给威廉·奥尔伯斯的信中写道，费马猜想是一个孤立的定理，因此没什么趣味。他补充说，有许多这样的猜想，既不能证明也不能否证；他忙于其他事务，没有时间从事《算术研究》中那类工作。他确实希望，也许能根据自己完成的其他工作证明费马猜想，但那也将是最没有趣味的推论之一。

Though Gauss did return to the theory of numbers in his later years, he clearly did not regard this subject as most important. The problem of proving Fermat’s last “theorem,” that no integers satisfy xn + yn = zn when n is greater than 2, was often thrown at him. But Gauss in a letter to Wilhelm Olbers of March 21, 1816 wrote that the Fermat hypothesis was an isolated theorem and so had little interest. He added that there are many such conjectures that can neither be proved nor disproved and he was so busy with other matters that he did not have time for the type of work he had done in his Disquisitiones. He did hope that perhaps the Fermat hypothesis might be proven on the basis of other work he had done, but it would be one of the least interesting corollaries.

高斯的说法“数学是科学的女王，算术是数学的女王。她常常屈尊为天文学及其他自然科学服务，但在任何情况下，首位都是她应得的”，常被引用来说明他偏爱纯数学。但高斯毕生的工作并不支持这一说法；他可能是在偶然一刻说出它的。他的座右铭是：“自然，你是我的女神，我的服务受你的规律约束。”讽刺的是，他对数学与自然相符的极端谨慎，通过非欧几里得几何的工作，最终产生了深刻而戏剧性的后果：否定数学规律的真理性。对于1900年前创造的全部数学，可以作这样一个概括：有一些纯数学，却没有纯数学家。

Gauss’s statement, “Mathematics is the queen of the sciences, and arithmetic is the queen of mathematics. She often condescends to render service to astronomy and other natural sciences, but under all circumstances the first place is her due,” is often quoted to show his preference for pure mathematics. But Gauss’s lifework does not bear out this statement; he may have made it in an off moment. His motto was “Thou, nature, art my goddess: to thy laws my services are bound.” It is ironic that his extraordinary scrupulousness about the accord of mathematics with nature proved, through his work on non-Euclidean geometry, to have the profound and dramatic consequence of discrediting the truth of mathematical laws. Apropos of all the mathematics created prior to 1900, one can make the broad generalization that there was some pure mathematics but no pure mathematicians.

几项发展从根本上改变了数学家对自身工作的态度。首先是认识到，数学不是关于自然的一组真理（第四章）。高斯在几何中阐明了这一点，而四元数和矩阵的创建，迫使人们认识到，即使普通数的数学也并非先验地适用；亥姆霍兹进一步明确了这一点。数学的适用性虽仍完美无缺，但寻求真理已不能为数学努力提供正当理由。

Several developments altered radically the mathematicians’ attitude toward their own work. The first was the realization that mathematics is not a body of truths about nature (Chapter IV). Gauss had made this clear in geometry, and the creation of quaternions and matrices forced the realization, which Helmholtz drove home, that even the mathematics of ordinary number is not a priori applicable. Though the applicability of mathematics remained flawless, the search for truths no longer justified mathematical efforts.

此外，非欧几里得几何和四元数这类重要发展，虽出于物理考虑，却似乎与自然不符，然而其成果已被证明能够应用。人们认识到，人为创造的东西，和那些似乎内在于自然设计的东西一样，都显示出非凡的适用性；这很快成了支持一种全新数学方案的论据。为什么未来心灵的自由创造不能同样如此？因此，许多数学家得出结论，不必研究现实世界的问题。完全由人心中涌出的观念编造的人为数学，肯定会有用。事实上，不受拘泥于物理事件的阻碍，纯粹思想可能做得更好。人的想象力摆脱任何限制之后，可能创造出更强大的理论，而这些理论也会应用于理解和驾驭自然。

Moreover, such vital developments as non-Euclidean geometry and quaternions, though motivated by physical considerations, were seemingly at variance with nature, and yet the resulting creations had proved applicable. The realization that even man-made creations, as well as what seemed inherent in the design of nature, proved to be extraordinarily applicable soon became an argument for a totally new approach to mathematics. Why should this not happen with future free creations of the mind? Hence, many mathematicians concluded, it was not necessary to undertake problems of the real world. Man-made mathematics, concocted solely from ideas springing up in the human mind, would surely prove useful. In fact, pure thought, unhindered by adherence to physical happenings, might do far better. Human imagination, freed of any restrictions, might create even more powerful theories that would also find application to the understanding and mastery of nature.

还有几种力量促使数学家脱离现实世界。数学与科学的巨大扩展，使同时精通两个领域困难得多。此外，过去巨人们研究过的科学未决问题，困难得多。为什么不坚持纯数学，使研究更容易呢？

Several other forces have influenced mathematicians to break from the real world. The vast expansion of mathematics and science has made it far more difficult to be at home in both fields. Moreover, the open problems of science, worked on by giants of the past, are far more difficult. Why not stick to pure mathematics and make research easier?

另一个因素诱使许多数学家处理纯数学问题。科学问题很少得到完全解决。人们得到越来越好的近似，却没有最终解。基本问题，例如三体问题，即太阳、地球及月亮这样的三个物体的运动，每个都以引力吸引另外两个，仍未解决。正如弗朗西斯·培根所说，自然的精妙远超人的才智。另一方面，纯数学允许明确而有限定的问题，可以获得完整解答。明确的问题自有吸引力，与复杂性和深度无穷无尽的问题不同。甚至迄今少数未被攻克的问题，如哥德巴赫猜想，也有诱人的简明表述。

Another factor induced many mathematicians to tackle problems of pure mathematics. Problems of science are rarely solved in toto. Better and better approximations are achieved but not a final solution. Basic problems—for example the three-body problem, that is, the motion of three bodies such as the sun, earth, and its moon, each attracting the other two with the force of gravitation—are still unsolved. As Francis Bacon remarked, the subtlety of nature is far greater than human wit. On the other hand, pure mathematics permits clear-cut, circumscribed problems to which complete solutions can be attained. There is a fascination to clear-cut problems as opposed to problems of never-ending complexity and depth. Even the few that have thus far resisted conquest, such as Goldbach’s hypothesis, possess a simplicity of statement that is enticing.

从事纯数学问题的另一个诱因，是大学等机构要求数学家发表研究的压力。应用问题既要求广博的科学知识，也要求数学知识，而且未决问题更困难，因此自己创造问题、解决能够解决的东西，要容易得多。教授不仅选择容易解决的纯数学问题，也把这类问题分配给博士生，使他们能迅速写出论文。而且，教授更容易帮助他们克服遇到的困难。

Another inducement to take up problems of pure mathematics is the pressure on mathematicians from institutions such as universities to publish research. Since applied problems require vast knowledge in science as well as in mathematics and since the open ones are more difficult, it is far easier to invent one’s own problems and solve what one can. Not only do professors select problems of pure mathematics that are readily solved but they assign such problems to their doctoral students so that they can produce theses quickly. Also, the professors can more readily help them overcome any difficulties they encounter.

现代纯数学所采取方向的几个例子，也许能说明纯粹课题与应用课题的区别。一个领域是抽象。哈密顿引入四元数时，心中有物理应用；此后其他数学家认识到可以有许多种代数，就着手研究所有可能的代数，无论是否具有潜在适用性。这个工作方向今天在抽象代数领域蓬勃发展。

A few examples of the direction modern pure mathematics has taken may make clear the distinction between pure and applied themes. One area is abstraction. After Hamilton introduced quaternions, for which he had physical applications in mind, other mathematicians, recognizing that there can be many algebras, undertook to pursue all possible algebras whether or not they had potential applicability. This direction of work flourishes today in the field of abstract algebra.

纯数学的另一个方向是推广。圆锥曲线——椭圆、抛物线和双曲线——用二次方程进行代数表示。有几种三次方程表示的曲线对应用有用。推广却立即跳到方程为n次的曲线，并详细研究其性质，尽管这些曲线很可能永远不会出现在自然现象中。

Another direction of pure mathematics is generalization. The conic sections—ellipse, parabola, and hyperbola—are represented algebraically by equations of the second degree. A few curves represented by equations of the third degree are useful for applications. Generalization jumps at once to curves whose equations are of the nth degree and studies their properties in detail even though none of these curves is ever likely to appear in natural phenomena.

仅仅因为能够写出具有这些特征的研究论文，而进行推广和抽象，通常对应用毫无价值。事实上，大多数这类论文，都致力于用更一般、更抽象的措辞或新术语，重新表述先前已用更具体、更明确的语言表达过的东西。这种重新表述并未给要应用数学的人增加力量或洞见。术语大量繁殖，大多是人为的，与物理观念无关，却自称暗示新观念，这当然不是贡献，反而妨碍数学的使用。它是新语言，而不是新数学。

Generalization and abstraction undertaken solely because research papers characterized by them can be written are usually worthless for application. In fact, most of these papers are devoted to a reformulation in more general or more abstract terms or in new terminology of what had previously existed in more concrete and specific language. And this reformulation provides no gain in power or insight to one who would apply the mathematics. The proliferation of terminology, largely artificial and with no relation to physical ideas but purporting to suggest new ideas, is certainly not a contribution but rather a hindrance to the use of mathematics. It is new language but not new mathematics.

纯数学研究采取的第三个方向是专门化。欧几里得考察并回答的是素数是否无穷多个的问题，而现在，“自然”的问题却是任何连续七个整数中是否有素数。毕达哥拉斯学派引入了亲和数概念。如果一个数的因子之和等于另一个数，两个数就亲和。例如284和220是亲和数。数论中最优秀的人物之一伦纳德·迪克森，提出了亲和三元数组的问题。“如果三个数中每一个的真因子之和，等于另外两个数之和，我们就说它们组成亲和三元数组。”他提出寻找这种三元数组的问题。另一个例子涉及强力数。强力数是正整数，若能被素数p整除，也能被p2整除。是否存在正整数（1和4除外），能以无限多种方式表示成两个互素强力数之差？

A third direction that pure mathematical research has taken is specialization. Whereas Euclid considered and answered the question of whether there is an infinity of prime numbers, now it is “natural” to ask whether there is a prime number in any seven consecutive integers. The Pythagoreans had introduced the notion of amicable numbers. Two numbers are amicable if the sum of the divisors of one number equals the other. Thus 284 and 220 are amicable. Leonard Dickson, one of the best men in the theory of numbers, introduced the problem of amicable triple numbers. “We shall say that three numbers form an amicable triple if the sum of the proper divisors of each one equals the sum of the remaining two numbers,” and he raised the question of finding such triples. Still another example concerns powerful numbers. A powerful number is a positive integer which, if divisible by a prime p, is also divisible by p2. Are there positive integers (other than 1 and 4) which are representable in an infinite number of ways as the difference of two relatively prime powerful numbers?

选择这些专门化的例子，是因为容易陈述和理解，但它们未能充分体现这类问题的复杂性与深度。不过，专门化已如此普遍，问题已如此狭窄，以致曾被错误地用来描述相对论的话——全世界只有十来个人懂它——确实适用于大多数专门领域。

These examples of specialization, chosen because they are easy to state and comprehend, do not do justice to the complexity and depth of such problems. However, specialization has become so widespread and the problems so narrow that what was once incorrectly said of the theory of relativity, namely, that only a dozen men in the world understood it, does apply to most specialties.

专门化扩展得如此严重，以尼古拉·布尔巴基为笔名活动的杰出数学家学派，也觉得必须提出批评；这个学派当然并不致力于应用数学：

The spread of specialization has become so great that the school of major mathematicians operating under the pseudonym of Nicolas Bourbaki, a school certainly not devoted to applied mathematics, felt obliged to be critical:

许多数学家在数学领域的一角安营扎寨，并不打算离开；他们不仅几乎完全忽视与自己专门领域无关的东西，而且无法理解在遥远角落工作的同事所用的语言和术语。即使在受过最广泛训练的人中，也没有谁不会在广阔数学世界的某些区域感到迷失；像庞加莱或希尔伯特那样，在几乎每个领域都留下自身天才印记的人，即使在成就最大的人物中，也属于极少数例外。

Many mathematicians take up quarters in a corner of the domain of mathematics, which they do not intend to leave; not only do they ignore almost completely what does not concern their special field, but they are unable to understand the language and the terminology used by colleagues who are working in a corner remote from their own. Even among those who have the widest training, there are none who do not feel lost in certain regions of the immense world of mathematics; those who, like Poincare or Hilbert, put the seal of their genius on almost every domain, constitute a very great exception even among the men of greatest accomplishment.

专门化的代价是不结果实。它很可能需要精湛技艺，却很少提供重要意义。

The price of specialization is sterility. It may well call for virtuosity but rarely does it offer significance.

抽象、推广和专门化，是纯数学家开展的三类活动。第四类是公理化。毫无疑问，19世纪末的公理化运动有助于巩固数学基础，尽管它没有成为解决基础问题的最终答案。但随后许多数学家着手对新建的公理体系作微不足道的修改。有些人证明，重新措辞可以把公理表述得更简单。另一些人证明，把措辞复杂化，就能把三条公理压缩成两条。还有人选择新的未定义术语，相应改写公理，却得到相同的定理整体。

Abstraction, generalization, and specialization are three types of activity undertaken by pure mathematicians. A fourth is axiomatics. There is no question that the axiomatic movement of the late nineteenth century was helpful in shoring up the foundations of mathematics, even though it did not prove to be the last word in settling foundational problems. But many mathematicians then undertook trivial modifications of the newly created axiom systems. Some could show that by rewording an axiom, it could be stated more simply. Others showed that by complicating the wording three axioms might be encompassed in two. Still others chose new undefined terms and by recasting the axioms accordingly arrived at the same body of theorems.

如前所述，并非所有公理化都没有价值。但能够作出的细小修改，总体上无关紧要。解决真实问题需要发挥人的最佳能力，因为必须正面应对问题；公理化却允许各式各样的自由。它根本上是人对深刻结果的组织，但选择这一组公理而非另一组，或选择十五条而非二十条，几乎无关紧要。事实上，甚至著名数学家也花时间研究的许多变体，已被斥为“摆弄公设的小把戏”。

Not all axiomatization, as we have noted, is worthless. But the minor modifications that can be made are on the whole insignificant. Whereas the solution of real problems demands the best of human capabilities because the problems must be faced, axiomatics permits all sorts of liberties. It is fundamentally man’s organization of deep results, but whether he chooses one set of axioms rather than another or fifteen instead of twenty is almost immaterial. In fact, the numerous variations to which even prominent mathematicians devoted time have been denounced as “postulate piddling.”

本世纪最初几十年，人们把如此多时间精力用于公理化，以致赫尔曼·外尔在1935年，虽充分认识公理化的价值，却抱怨公理化的果实已采尽，并呼吁回到有实质内容的问题。他指出，公理化只是使有实质内容的数学精确化、组织化；它是一种编目或分类功能。

So much time and effort were devoted to axiomatics in the first few decades of this century that Hermann Weyl in 1935, though fully conscious of the value of axiomatization, complained that the fruits of axiomatization were exhausted and pleaded for a return to problems of substance. Axiomatics, he pointed out, merely gives precision and organization to substantial mathematics; it is a cataloguing or classifying function.

不能把所有抽象、推广、专门问题和公理化都称为纯数学。我们已经指出，其中一些工作以及基础研究的价值。必须考察工作的动机。纯数学的特征，是与直接或潜在应用无关。纯数学的精神是：问题就是问题，就是问题。一些纯数学家论证说，任何数学发展都可能有用，没人能预见未来的实际应用。然而，一个数学课题就像一块含油土地。地表的黑色水洼可能提示应在某处勘探石油；若发现石油，土地的价值就确立了。土地已证实的价值，使进一步钻探具有依据；只要钻探地点不离最初发现地点太远，就可期望找到更多石油。当然，也可以因为远处更容易钻探而选一个很遥远的地点，并仍声称会发现石油。但人的努力和创造力有限，因而应当投入有良好希望的冒险。如果目标是潜在应用，那么正如伟大的物理化学家约西亚·威拉德·吉布斯所说，纯数学家可以随心所欲，但应用数学家至少必须部分神志清醒。

One cannot characterize all abstractions, generalizations, specialized problems, and axiomatics as pure mathematics. We have pointed out the value of some of this work as well as of foundational studies. One must look into the motivation for the work. What is characteristic of pure mathematics is its irrelevance to immediate or potential application. The spirit of pure mathematics is that a problem is a problem is a problem. Some pure mathematicians argue that there is potential usefulness in any mathematical development and no one can foresee its actual future application. Nevertheless, a mathematical theme is like a piece of oil-bearing land. Dark puddles on the surface may suggest that a particular spot be explored for oil and, if this is discovered, the value of the land is established. The proven worth of the land warrants further drilling in the expectation that more oil will be found if the drilling sites are not too far removed from the location of the original strike. Of course, one might choose a very distant site because the drilling is easier there and still claim that he will strike oil. But human effort and ingenuity are limited and should therefore be devoted to good risks. If potential application is the goal, then as the great physical chemist Josiah Willard Gibbs remarked, the pure mathematician can do what he pleases but the applied mathematician must be at least partially sane.

对纯数学，即为数学自身而作的数学的批评，早在弗朗西斯·培根的《学术的进展》（1620年）中就能找到。他在其中反对那种“与物质及自然哲学公理完全割裂”的纯粹、神秘而自足的数学，它只用来“满足人心附带的铺陈和沉思的欲望”。他理解应用数学的价值：

Criticism of pure mathematics, mathematics for its own sake, can be found as far back as Francis Bacon’s The Advancement of Learning (1620). There he objected to pure, mystic, and self-sufficient mathematics that was “entirely severed from matter and from axioms of natural philosophy” and served only “to satisfy [an] appetite for expatiation and meditation [which were] incidental to the human mind.” He understood the value of applied mathematics:

因为若无数学的帮助和介入，自然的许多部分既不能以充分的精妙加以发现，也不能以充分的清晰加以论证，更不能以充分的灵巧加以应用；透视、音乐、天文学、宇宙地理学、建筑、机械以及其他一些学科，都属此类……因为物理学每天不断进步，并发展出新的公理，它将在许多事情上需要数学的新帮助，因此混合［应用］数学的分支也将越来越多。

For many parts of nature can neither be invented with sufficient subtlety, nor demonstrated with sufficient perspicuity, nor accommodated to use with sufficient dexterity without the aid and intervention of mathematics, of which sort are perspective, music, astronomy, cosmography, architecture, machinery and some others. . . . For as physics advances farther and farther every day and develops new axioms, it will require fresh assistance from mathematics in many things, and so the parts of mixed [applied] mathematics will be more numerous.

培根时代，数学家关注物理研究，无须催促。但今天，脱离科学已经是事实。过去一百年，一边是坚守古老而光荣的数学活动动机的人，这些动机迄今提供了实质内容和富有成果的课题；另一边是顺风而行、研究自己心血来潮之物的人，双方发生了分裂。今天，数学家与物理科学家各走各的路。较新的数学创造很少有应用。此外，数学家与科学家不再互相理解；由于高度专门化，数学家甚至不理解其他数学家，这也算不上什么安慰。

In Bacon’s time the concern of mathematicians with physical studies needed no prompting. But today the break from science is factual. In the last one hundred years, a schism has developed between those who would cleave to the ancient and honorable motivations for mathematical activity, the motivations which have thus far supplied the substance and fruitful themes, and those who sailing with the wind investigate what strikes their fancy. Today mathematicians and physical scientists go their separate ways. The newer mathematical creations have little application. Moreover, mathematicians and scientists no longer understand each other, and it is little comfort that, because of the intense specialization, mathematicians do not even understand other mathematicians.

偏离“现实”、为数学自身而研究数学，几乎从一开始就引起争论。傅里叶在经典著作《热的解析理论》（1822年）中，热情赞颂把数学应用于物理问题：

The divergence from “reality,” the study of mathematics for its own sake, provoked controversy almost from the outset. In his classic work The Analytical Theory of Heat (1822), Fourier waxed enthusiastic about the application of mathematics to physical problems:

对自然的深入研究，是数学发现最丰饶的源泉。这种研究不仅提供明确目标的好处，也具有排除含糊问题和无用计算的好处。它是构建分析本身、发现那些最重要且科学必须永远保存的观念的手段。根本观念就是那些表示自然事件的观念……

The profound study of nature is the most fertile source of mathematical discoveries. This study offers not only the advantages of a well determined goal but the advantage of excluding vague questions and useless calculations. It is a means of building analysis itself and of discovering the ideas which matter most and which science must always preserve. The fundamental ideas are those which represent the natural happenings. . . .

它的首要特点是清晰；它没有表达混乱观念的符号。它把最不同的现象汇集起来，发现把它们联系起来的隐藏类比。如果物质因极其稀薄而逃避我们的感知，如空气和光；如果对象位于浩瀚空间中离我们很远的地方；如果人想理解天体在相隔许多世纪的连续时期中的运行；如果引力和热力在实心球体内部、永远无法到达的深处作用，数学分析仍能把握这些现象的规律。它使它们呈现出来并可被度量，仿佛是人类理性的一种能力，注定用以弥补生命的短暂与感官的不完善。更值得注意的是，它研究所有现象时都遵循相同方法，用同一语言解释它们，仿佛要证实宇宙设计的统一与简单，并更鲜明地显示支配一切自然物质的不变秩序。

Its chief attribute is clarity; it has no symbols to express confused ideas. It brings together the most diverse phenomena and discovers hidden analogies which unite them. If matter evades us, such as the air and light, because of its extreme thinness, if objects are located far from us in the immensity of space, if man wishes to understand the performance of the heavens for the successive periods which separate a large number of centuries, if the forces of gravity and of heat be at work in the interior of a solid globe at depths which will be forever inaccessible, mathematical analysis can still grasp the laws of these phenomena. It renders them present and measurable and seems to be a faculty of the human reason destined to make up for the brevity of life and for the imperfection of the senses; and what is more remarkable still, it follows the same method in the study of all phenomena; it interprets them by the same language as if to attest the unity and simplicity of the plan of the universe and to make still more manifest the immutable order which rules all natural matter.

卡尔·古斯塔夫·雅各布·雅可比（1804—1851）虽然在力学和天文学方面做过第一流的工作，却反对这种在他看来至多是片面宣言的说法。他在1830年7月2日给阿德里安－马里·勒让德写道：“傅里叶确实认为，数学的主要目标是公共效用以及自然现象的解释；但像他这样的科学家应该知道，科学唯一的目标是人类精神的荣誉；在这个基础上，一个［数论］问题与一个行星体系的问题，同样有价值。”

Though Carl Gustav Jacob Jacobi (1804-1851) had done first-class work in mechanics and in astronomy, he took issue with what he regarded as at best a one-sided declaration. He wrote to Adrien-Marie Legendre on July 2, 1830: “It is true that Fourier has the opinion that the principal object of mathematics is public utility and the explanation of natural phenomena; but a scientist like him ought to know that the unique object of science is the honor of the human spirit and on this basis a question of [the theory of] numbers is worth as much as a question about the planetary system.”

当然，数学物理学家不赞同雅可比的观点。开尔文勋爵（威廉·汤姆孙，1824—1907）和彼得·格思里·泰特（1831—1901）在1867年主张，最好的数学由应用启发。这会产生“惊人的纯数学定理；那些把自己限制于纯分析或几何，而不让自己被引入物理研究途中那丰富而美丽的数学真理领域的数学家，很少有幸获得这样的定理”。

Of course, the mathematical physicists did not side with Jacobi’s views. Lord Kelvin (William Thomson, 1824-1907) and Peter Guthrie Tait (1831-1901) in 1867 claimed that the best mathematics is suggested by application. This yields “astonishing theorems of pure mathematics, such as rarely fall to the lot of those mathematicians who confine themselves to pure analysis or geometry instead of allowing themselves to be led into the rich and beautiful fields of mathematical truth which lie in the way of physical research.”

许多数学家也痛惜转向纯粹研究的新趋势。1888年，克罗内克写信给对数学、物理和医学都有贡献的亥姆霍兹：“您在合理而有趣的问题上的丰富实践经验，将给予数学家一个新方向和新动力……片面而内向的数学思辨，导向不结果实的领域。”

Many mathematicians also deplored the new trend to pure studies. In 1888 Kronecker wrote to Helmholtz, who had contributed to mathematics, physics, and medicine, “The wealth of your practical experience with sane and interesting problems will give to mathematicians a new direction and a new impetus. . . . One-sided and introspective mathematical speculations lead into sterile fields.”

1895年，当时已是数学界领袖的费利克斯·克莱因，也感到有必要抗议转向抽象纯数学的趋势：

In 1895 Felix Klein, by that time a leader in the mathematical world, also felt the need to protest against the trend to abstract, pure mathematics:

我们不禁感到，在现代思想迅速发展之际，我们的科学有日益孤立的危险。自现代分析兴起以来，数学与理论自然科学之间一直存在密切的相互关系，使双方长久受益；现在，这种关系面临破裂的威胁。

We cannot help feeling that in the rapid development of modern thought our science is in danger of becoming more and more isolated. The intimate mutual relation between mathematics and theoretical natural science which, to the lasting benefit of both sides, existed ever since the rise of modern analysis, threatens to be disrupted.

克莱因在《陀螺的数学理论》（1897年）中，再次谈到这一主题：

In his Mathematical Theory of the Top (1897), Klein returned to this theme:

当前数学科学的迫切需要，是把纯科学与它最重要的应用所在的物理科学分支，再次紧密联系起来，就像在拉格朗日和高斯的工作中已经证明如此富有成果的那种联系。

It is the great need of the present in mathematical science that the pure science and those departments of physical sciences in which it finds its most important applications should again be brought into the intimate association which proved so fruitful in the works of Lagrange and Gauss.

庞加莱在《科学与方法》中，虽曾讽刺19世纪末某些纯逻辑的创造（第八章），却承认公理化、异常的几何和奇特的函数，“向我们展示，当人的心灵越来越摆脱外部世界的专制时，它能够创造什么”。不过，他坚持说：“我们必须把大部分军队引向另一边，即自然这一边。”他在《科学的价值》中写道：

Poincare in his Science and Method, despite his ironic remarks about some of the purely logical creations of the late nineteenth century (Chapter VIII), did grant that axiomatics, unusual geometries, and peculiar functions show us what the human mind can create when it frees itself more and more from the tyranny of the external world.” Nevertheless, he insisted “it is toward the other side, the side of nature that we must direct the bulk of our army.” In The Value of Science, he wrote:

只有完全忘记科学史，才会不记得理解自然的愿望，对数学的发展曾有过最重要、最有益的影响……忘记外部世界存在的纯数学家，就像知道怎样和谐地组合色彩与形状，却缺少模特的画家。他的创造力很快就会枯竭。

It would be necessary to have completely forgotten the history of science not to remember that the desire to understand nature has had on the development of mathematics the most important and happiest influence. . . . The pure mathematician who should forget the existence of the exterior world would be like a painter who knows how to harmoniously combine colors and forms, but who lacked models. His creative power would soon be exhausted.

稍后的1908年，费利克斯·克莱因再次发声。他担心创造任意结构的自由遭到滥用，强调任意结构是“所有科学的死亡”。几何公理“不是任意的，而是合理的陈述，一般由空间感知归纳而来，其精确内容则由适宜性决定”。为非欧几里得公理辩护时，克莱因指出，直观只在一定精度范围内要求欧几里得平行公理。另一次，他指出：“享有自由特权的人，也应承担责任。”克莱因所谓责任，是为自然研究服务。

Somewhat later, in 1908, Felix Klein spoke out again. Fearing that the freedom to create arbitrary structures was being abused, he emphasized that arbitrary structures are “the death of all science.” The axioms of geometry are “not arbitrary but sensible statements which are, in general, induced by space perception and are determined as to their precise content by expediency.” To justify the non-Euclidean axioms Klein pointed out that visualization requires the Euclidean parallel axiom only within certain limits of accuracy. On another occasion he pointed out that “whoever has the privilege of freedom should also bear responsibility.” By responsibility Klein meant service to the investigation of nature.

克莱因晚年已任当时世界数学中心哥廷根大学数学系主任，他觉得必须再作一次抗议。在《19世纪数学的发展》（1925年）中，他回顾傅里叶如何热衷于使用最好的现成数学解决实际问题，并将这与纯数学式的工具精炼和具体观念的抽象化相对比。然后他说：

Toward the end of his life Klein, who was by then the head of the mathematics department at what was the world center of mathematics, the University of Gottingen, felt compelled to make one more protest.
